math-e1-geo1.title: Mazita ezvimiro nemakona
math-e1-geo1.concept: **Pembetatu** ine mativi matatu, **pembe ina** ine mativi mana. **Denderedzwa** rakatenderera uye harina makona.

math-e1-geo2.title: Kuziva zvimiro zvine mativi matatu
math-e1-geo2.concept: Chimiro chebhokisi ndi**cuboid**, chimiro chembiru yakatenderera ndi**cylinder**, chimiro chebhora ndi**sphere**.

math-e1-l1.title: Kuverenga
math-e1-l1.concept: Kana ukaverenga zvinhu uchizvibata chimwe nechimwe, unozoziva kuti zvingani. Kana zvapfuura gumi, zviverenge uchizvisunga mashanu kana gumi.

math-e1-l2.title: Kuwedzera nekubvisa
math-e1-l2.concept: **Kuwedzera (+)** kubatanidza nhamba mbiri, **kubvisa (-)** kubvisa nhamba diki panhamba huru.

math-e1-l3.title: Kuenzanisa hukuru hwenhamba
math-e1-l3.concept: Pakati penhamba mbiri, huru inoratidzwa ne **>**, diki ne **<**. Chiratidzo chinovhurira kunhamba huru.

math-e1-l4.title: Zvimiro zvakasiyana
math-e1-l4.concept: **Pembetatu** ine mativi matatu, **pembe ina** ine mativi mana. **Denderedzwa** rakatenderera uye harina makona.

math-e1-l5.title: Urefu newachi
math-e1-l5.concept: Urefu hunoyerwa ne **cm**. Chigunwe chipfupi chewachi chinoratidza 'awa', chigunwe chirefu chinoratidza 'maminitsi'.

math-e2-dat1.title: Kuronga uye kuratidza netafura negraph
math-e2-dat1.concept: Kana data yakakamurwa nemutemo, yakaverengwa, uye yakaratidzwa ne**tafura** kana **graph**, unogona kuienzanisa nekukasira.
math-e2-dat1.example: A vanhu 3, B vanhu 5, C vanhu 2 → vose vanhu 10

math-e2-geo1.title: Pembetatu nepembe ina
math-e2-geo1.concept: **Pembetatu** ine mativi matatu akaruka nemakona matatu, **pembe ina** ine mativi mana akaruka nemakona mana. Kunyange zvimiro zvakasiyana, nhamba yemativi nemakona inofanana.
math-e2-geo1.example: Pembe ina: mativi mana, makona mana

math-e2-geo2.title: Urefu nenguva
math-e2-geo2.concept: Kana ukaisa pa0 yerula, nhamba iri kuno rimwe divi ndiyo urefu. $1\text{ m}=100\text{ cm}$. Vhiya nhamba inoratidzwa nechigunwe chirefu newachi ne5 kuti uwane maminitsi.

math-e2-l1.title: Kukosha kwechinzvimbo
math-e2-l1.concept: Munhamba ina madhijiti maviri, nhamba iri kuruboshwe iri pa**chinzvimbo chemagumi**, iri kurudyi iri pa**chinzvimbo chemamwe**. Magumi gumi anoita 100.

math-e2-l2.title: Kuwedzera nekubvisa nhamba dzemadhijiti maviri
math-e2-l2.concept: Verenga mamwe nemamwe, magumi nemagumi. Kana huwandu hwapfuura 10, simudzira, uye kana usingagoni kubvisa, kwereta.

math-e2-l3.title: Kusangana nekuvhiya pakutanga
math-e2-l3.concept: Kuwedzera nhamba imwe chete kakawanda kunogona kunyorwa pfupi se**kuvhiya (×)**.

math-e2-l4.title: Urefu nenguva
math-e2-l4.concept: **1m = 100cm**. Pawachi, chigunwe chirefu chinopfuura nhamba imwe zvakaenzana nemaminitsi mashanu.

math-e2-l5.title: Kutsvaga mutemo
math-e2-l5.concept: Kana wawana **mutemo** wekuwedzera kana kudzikira kwenhamba, unogona kuziva nhamba inotevera.

math-e3-ari1.title: Kuwedzera nekubvisa nhamba dzemadhijiti matatu
math-e3-ari1.concept: Verenga uchitanga nenzvimbo yemamwe. Kana huwandu hwapfuura 10, **simudzira** kunzvimbo yepamusoro, uye kana usingagoni kubvisa, **kwereta** kubva panzvimbo yepamusoro.

math-e3-geo1.title: Angle uye Right Angle
math-e3-geo1.concept: Chimiro chinoumbwa nemisoro miviri inotangira papoindi imwe chete tinochidaidza kuti **angle**. Angle ye $90^\circ$ ndiyo **right angle**, diki kupfuura iyoyo ndiyo **acute angle**, hombe kupfuura iyoyo ndiyo **obtuse angle**.

math-e3-geo2.title: Radius neDiameter yeDenderedzwa
math-e3-geo2.concept: Kureba kubva pakati pedenderedzwa kusvika papoindi iri padenderedzwa ndiyo **radius**, mutsetse unopfuura pakati ndiyo **diameter**. Diameter ihuwandu hunoita kaviri radius.

math-e3-l1.title: Kuwanza neKugovanisa
math-e3-l1.concept: Kuwanza kuwedzera nhamba imwe chete kakawanda, uye **kugovanisa** kugovera zvakaenzana. Kana uchiziva tafura yekuwanza, kugovanisa kunova nyore.

math-e3-l2.title: Kuziva Zvikamu
math-e3-l2.concept: Chikamu chizere chakagovaniswa zvakaenzana, chimwe chidimbu chacho tinochiratidza se **fraction**. Nhamba iri pasi ndiyo **denominator**, iri pamusoro ndiyo **numerator**.

math-e3-l4.title: Denderedzwa neAngle
math-e3-l4.concept: **Right angle** ndi 90°. Mudenderedzwa, **diameter** ihuwandu hunoita kaviri **radius**.

math-e3-l5.title: Tafura neGraph
math-e3-l5.concept: Kana mhedzisiro yakaongororwa yakarongwa mutafura, zviri nyore kuona chakawanda kupfuura zvose, chidiki kupfuura zvose, nehuwandu hwose.

math-e4-dat1.title: Kuverenga Line Graph
math-e4-dat1.concept: **Line graph** inoratidza kukosha kunoshanduka nenguva nemadotsi nemitsetse. Mutsetse kana uchikwira zvakawedzera, kana uchiderera zvakaderera.

math-e4-geo1.title: Hukuru hweAngle dzeChimiro
math-e4-geo1.concept: Huwandu hweangle matatu etriangle ndi $180^\circ$, uye huwandu hweangle ina yequadrilateral ndi $360^\circ$.

math-e4-geo2.title: Quadrilateral nePolygon
math-e4-geo2.concept: Kana pair imwe yemativi akatarisana yakafanana (parallel), ndiyo **trapezoid**; kana mapair maviri ese ari parallel, ndiyo **parallelogram**; kana mativi ese mana akaenzana, ndiyo **rhombus**. Mutsetse unobatanidza mavertex asinganyatsobatani ndiyo **diagonal**.

math-e4-l1.title: Nhamba Huru
math-e4-l1.concept: Verenga unyore nhamba huru nechikamu che10000. Nhamba yega yega panzvimbo yayo inoratidza hukuru sezvinoreva **place value**.

math-e4-l2.title: Kuwanza neKugovanisa Nhamba Huru
math-e4-l2.concept: Govanisa nhamba inowanzwa, wanza, wobva wawedzera. Pakugovanisa, fungidzira quotient wobva wacheka.

math-e4-l3.title: Kuwedzera neKubvisa Zvikamu neDecimal
math-e4-l3.concept: Zvikamu zvine denominator imwe chete, wedzera nokubvisa **numerator** chete. Madecimal, verengera uchienzanisa nzvimbo dzedecimal point.

math-e4-l4.title: Madhigirii neChimiro
math-e4-l4.concept: Huwandu hweangle matatu etriangle ndi **180°**, uye huwandu hweangle ina yequadrilateral ndi **360°**.

math-e4-l5.title: Bar Graph neAvhareji
math-e4-l5.concept: Verenga data wobva wawana huwandu nemusiyano. **Avhareji** ndiko kukosha kunowanikwa nekuwedzera zvose wogovanisa nehuwandu hwazvo.

math-e5-dat1.title: Kuwana Avhareji
math-e5-dat1.concept: **Avhareji** ndiko kukosha kunowanikwa nekuwedzera data yose wogovanisa nehuwandu hwema data.

math-e5-dat2.title: Mukana
math-e5-dat2.concept: **Mukana** wekuti chimwe chinhu chiitike unoratidzwa nenhamba iri pakati pe0 (hazvigoneki) ne1 (zvechokwadi). Mukana=(huwandu hwenzira dzinodiwa)÷(huwandu hwenzira dzose).
math-e5-dat2.example: Mabhora A 3, mabhora B 2 → mukana wekuti ndi A $\frac{3}{5}=0.6$

math-e5-geo1.title: Perimeter nenzvimbo
math-e5-geo1.concept: Segonhi: nzvimbo=hurefu×hupamhi, triangle: base×kukwirira÷2, parallelogram: base×kukwirira, trapezoid: (divi repamusoro+divi repazasi)×kukwirira÷2, rhombus: diagonal×diagonal÷2.

math-e5-geo2.title: Congruence ne symmetry
math-e5-geo2.concept: Mifananidzo miviri ine chimiro nehukuru hwakafanana inosanganiswa inonzi **congruent**. Mufananidzo unosangana zvizere kana wapetwa pamutsetse mumwe ndiyo **line-symmetric figure** uye mutsetse iwoyo ndiyo **axis of symmetry**.

math-e5-l1.title: Kuwedzera nekubvisa zvikamu zvine ma denominator akasiyana
math-e5-l1.concept: Kana ma denominator akasiyana, tanga **wazvipa denominator imwechete**. Zvakanaka kushandisa least common multiple yema denominator maviri sedenominator yakafanana.

math-e5-l2.title: Kuwanza madhesimali
math-e5-l2.concept: Bvisa poindi redhesimali wowanza senhamba dzakazara, wobva wadzoreredza poindi redhesimali nenzvimbo dzakawanda sedhesimali dzepamwe chete dzinowanzwa.

math-e5-l3.title: Zvigovanisi nezvakawanda
math-e5-l3.concept: **Chigovanisi** inhamba inogovanisa imwe nhamba zvakakwana, **chakawanda** ndiyo nhamba yakawanikwa nekuwanza imwe nhamba ne 1, 2, 3...

math-e5-l4.title: Nzvimbo nehuwandu
math-e5-l4.concept: Segonhi ndi **hurefu × hupamhi**, triangle ndi **base × kukwirira ÷ 2**, uye huwandu hwe cuboid ndi **hurefu × hupamhi × kukwirira**.

math-e5-l5.title: Ratio nechiyero
math-e5-l5.concept: **Rate** ndiwo mutengo unowanikwa nekugovanisa huwandu hunenge hwaenzaniswa nehuwandu hwekwakatangira. Kuwanza rate ne 100 kunopa **percentage (%)**.

math-e6-ari1.title: Kuverenga kwakasanganiswa kwenhamba dzechisikigo
math-e6-ari1.concept: Kana kuwedzera, kubvisa, kuwanza nekugovanisa zvakasanganiswa, tanga **zviri mukati mebraketi**, wobva **kuwanza nekugovanisa**, uye pakupedzisira **kuwedzera nekubvisa** uchiverenga kubva kuruboshwe.

math-e6-ari2.title: Kukwidza, kudzikisa, kutenderedza
math-e6-ari2.concept: **Kukwidza** kunokwidza zvese zviri pazasi penzvimbo yaunoda, **kudzikisa** kunovasiya zvese. **Kutenderedza** kunokwidza kana nhamba iri pazasi pakarepo iri 5 kana kupfuura, uye kunodzikisa kana iri 4 kana pasi.

math-e6-dat1.title: Band graph ne circle graph
math-e6-dat1.concept: **Band graph** ne **circle graph** zvinotora yose se 100% uye zvinoratidza chiyero chechikamu chimwe nechimwe. Huwandu hwechikamu=yose×chiyero.

math-e6-geo1.title: Circumference nenzvimbo yedenderedzwa
math-e6-geo1.concept: Circumference (denderedzwa) = dhayamita × pi, nzvimbo yedenderedzwa = radius × radius × pi. Pi inenge $3.14$.

math-e6-geo2.title: Cuboid ne cube
math-e6-geo2.concept: Huwandu=hurefu×hupamhi×kukwirira, nzvimbo yepamusoro=(muwayo wenzvimbo dzezviso zvitatu)×2. Cuboid ine zviso 6, mitsetse 12, nemakona 8.

math-e6-l1.title: Kuwanza nekugovanisa zvikamu nemadhesimali
math-e6-l1.concept: Kuwanza zvikamu, wanza ma numerator pamwe chete nema denominator pamwe chete. Kugovanisa zvikamu, wanza ne **reciprocal**.

math-e6-l2.title: Proportions nekugovera nechiyero
math-e6-l2.concept: Mu proportion, **chibereko chenhamba dzemukati = chibereko chenhamba dzekunze**. Kugovanisa yose nechiyero ndiko **kugovera nechiyero**.

math-e6-l3.title: Percentage
math-e6-l3.concept: **Percentage (%)** ndiwo chiyero kana huwandu hwekwakatangira hutorwa se 100. Kuwanza dhesimali ne 100 kunopa %.

math-e6-l4.title: Denderedzwa nemifananidzo yakasimba
math-e6-l4.concept: Circumference yedenderedzwa ndi **dhayamita × 3.14**, nzvimbo yedenderedzwa ndi **radius × radius × 3.14**.

math-e6-l5.title: Mean nekurongwa kwedata
math-e6-l5.concept: **Mean** ndiwo muwayo ÷ huwandu, **median** ndiyo nhamba yepakati, uye **mode** ndiyo nhamba inoonekwa kakawanda zvikuru.

math-el-ai1.title: Data yezvinyorwa nemifananidzo
math-el-ai1.concept: Zvinyorwa zvinomiririrwa se vector yehuwandu hwekuoneka kwemazwi, uye mifananidzo se matrix yemitengo yemapikseri. Kana dot product yema vector ichikura, zvinyorwa zvinofanana.

math-el-ai2.title: Kufungidzira ne optimization
math-el-ai2.concept: Slope ye trend line, mean yezvikwere zvekukanganisa (loss), uye gradient descent $x_{mutsva}=x-\eta f'(x)$ zvinovandudza kufungidzira.

math-el-cul1.title: Mathematics muunyanzvi nekurarama
math-el-cul1.concept: Golden ratio inenge 1.618, inzwi riri octave imwe kumusoro rine frequency kakapetwa kaviri, huwandu hwenzira dzemadhoti matanhatu eBraille ndi $2^6-1=63$, uye majority inhamba inopfuura hafu yeyose.

math-el-cul2.title: Mathematics munharaunda nezvakatipoteredza
math-el-cul2.concept: Tsvaga matambudziko enharaunda nezvakatipoteredza nemathematics uchishandisa mean nechiyero chekuwedzera kwedata. Chiyero chekuwedzera=(huwandu hwakawedzera)÷(mutengo wekutanga)×100.
math-el-cul2.example: Kubva pa 40 kuenda ku 50 → kuwedzera kwe 25%

math-el-econ1.title: Chikwereti, exchange rate, mitero
math-el-econ1.concept: Simple interest=principal×rate×nguva, compound interest ndi principal×(1+rate)^nguva. Exchange rate ndiwo mutengo wechikamu chimwe chemari yekunze, uye mutero unowanikwa nekuwanza mutengo nechiyero.

math-el-econ2.title: Kudiwa nekupiwa ne optimization
math-el-econ2.concept: Equilibrium ndipo panosangana demand ne supply curves. Revenue R=pq yakanyanya ne elasticity zvinowanikwa nemabasa ne derivatives.

math-el-job1.title: Kushandura mayuniti nezvikamu
math-el-job1.concept: 1 m=100 cm, 1 kg=1000 g, awa 1=maminetsi 60. Mutengo wakadzikiswa=mutengo×(1−chiyero chekudzikisa), uye kana ukasanganisa nechiyero a:b, A ndiyo $\frac{a}{a+b}$ yeyose.

math-el-job2.title: Nzvimbo, huwandu hwenzira, chiyero chekuwedzera
math-el-job2.concept: Shandisa nzvimbo kuwana huwandu hwezvinhu zvinodiwa, mutemo wekuwanza kuwana huwandu hwemijaya inogoneka, uye (huwandu hwakawedzera)÷(mutengo wekutanga)×100 kuwana chiyero chekuwedzera.

math-el-res1.title: Nzira dzekutsvaga
math-el-res1.concept: Kutsvaga mumathematics kunoitwa nenzira dzakadai sekutsvaga mumabhuku, kutsvaga mienzaniso, kuedza mumathematics, nekutsvakurudza kwekuvandudza.
math-el-res1.example: Kukanda dhayisi pachako kuti utsvage mutemo → kuedza mumathematics

math-el-res2.title: Matanho ekutsvaga nehunhu hwekutsvakurudza
math-el-res2.concept: Kutsvaga kunoitwa nenzira iyi: kusarudza nyaya → hurongwa → kuita → kuratidza → kufunga. Hunhu hwekutsvakurudza ndiko kutaura kwakabva ruzivo uye kusashandura mhedzisiro.

math-el-sta1.title: Matambudziko e statistics nemasampuli
math-el-sta1.concept: Standard deviation ndiyo ruzi rwechikwere rwe mean yezvikwere zvekuphambuka (variance). Masampuli anotorwa nerandom sampling, stratified sampling, cluster sampling, systematic sampling nezvimwe.

math-el-sta2.title: Kufungidzira nehypothesis testing
math-el-sta2.concept: Margin of error ye 95% confidence interval ndi $1.96\times\frac{σ}{\sqrt{n} }$. Kana mutengo wakakwana we test statistic $z=\frac{\bar{x}-\mu}{σ/\sqrt{n} }$ uchipfuura 1.96, null hypothesis inoramba pa 5% significance level.

math-h1-fnc1.title: Composite nemabasa anopesana
math-h1-fnc1.concept: Composite function $(g\circ f)(x)=g(f(x))$ inoverengwa kubva pabasa remukati. Basa rinopesana ndiro rine $f^{-1}(y)=x$ kana $f(x)=y$.

math-h1-geo1.title: Mifananidzo pa coordinate plane
math-h1-geo1.concept: Nhambwe pakati pemapoindi maviri $\sqrt{(x_2-x_1)^2+(y_2-y_1)^2}$, midpoint ndiyo mean yema coordinates, uye slope ndi $\frac{y_2-y_1}{x_2-x_1}$.

math-h1-geo2.title: Equation yedenderedzwa
math-h1-geo2.concept: Equation yedenderedzwa rine pakati $(a, b)$ uye radius $r$ ndi$(x-a)^2+(y-b)^2=r^2$. Kureba pakati pepoinzi $(x_0,y_0)$ nemutsetse $ax+by+c=0$ ndi$\frac{|ax_0+by_0+c|}{\sqrt{a^2+b^2} }$.

math-h1-l1.title: Kugovanisa polynomials ne remainder theorem
math-h1-l1.concept: Remainder pakugovanisa $P(x)$ ne$x-a$ ndi$P(a)$, uye kana $P(a)=0$, $x-a$ i factor.

math-h1-l2.title: Complex numbers nediscriminant yequadratic equation
math-h1-l2.concept: $i^2=-1$, uye kana discriminant $D=b^2-4ac<0$, equation ine midzi isiri chaiyo. Pa quadratic equation ine real coefficients, midzi isiri chaiyo inouya mumapeya e conjugate complex numbers.

math-h1-l3.title: Quadratic inequalities
math-h1-l3.concept: Verenga mhinduro kubva pagraph ye quadratic function nenzvimbo yayo ne$x$-axis. $(x-a)(x-b)<0$ iri pakati pemidzi miviri, $>0$ iri kunze kwemidzi miviri.

math-h1-l4.title: Permutations ne combinations
math-h1-l4.concept: Kana kurongeka kuchibvunzwa, ndi permutation $_nP_r$, kana kusingabvunzwi, ndi combination $_nC_r$. 'Kana pasina' unobvisa complement kubva pazvose.

math-h1-l5.title: Equations yemitsetse nemadenderedzwa
math-h1-l5.concept: Kureba pakati pepoinzi nemutsetse $\frac{|ax_0+by_0+c|}{\sqrt{a^2+b^2} }$, denderedzwa $(x-a)^2+(y-b)^2=r^2$, tangent iri perpendicular ne radius.
math-h1-l5.example: Slope ye tangent papoinzi $(3,\ 4)$ pa denderedzwa $x^2+y^2=25$ $=-\frac34$

math-h1-mat1.title: Zvinoreva matrices nemashandiro
math-h1-mat1.concept: **Matrix** inhamba dzakarongwa muchimiro che rectangle. Kuwedzera, kubvisa, nekuvhiya ne real number zvinoitwa pazvikamu zviri panzvimbo imwe chete, uye chikamu che (i, j) chechigadzirwa $AB$ ndiko kuwedzerwa kwezvigadzirwa zvezvikamu zvemutsara wechi i we$A$ nenhanho yechi j ye$B$.

math-h1-pol1.title: Factorization ne cubic/quartic equations
math-h1-pol1.concept: Cubic ne quartic equations dzinogadziriswa nekuita **factorization** uchishandisa synthetic division kana substitution, wobva wawana kukosha kunoita kuti factor imwe neimwe ive 0. Pa quadratic factor, tarisa nediscriminant kuti ine midzi chaiyo here.

math-h1-set1.title: Sets ne propositions
math-h1-set1.concept: $n(A\cup B)=n(A)+n(B)-n(A\cap B)$, uye seti ine zvikamu n ine subsets $2^n$. Contrapositive ye proposition 'kana p ndiye q' ine kuti ndechokwadi kana kuti hazvisi chokwadi sepakutanga, asi converse inogona kusava saizvozvo.

math-h2-geo1.title: Triangles ne trigonometric functions
math-h2-geo1.concept: Law of sines $\frac{a}{\sin A}=2R$, law of cosines $c^2=a^2+b^2-2ab\cos C$, nzvimbo yetriangle $\frac12ab\sin C$.

math-h2-geo2.title: Radian measure ne sectors
math-h2-geo2.concept: $180^\circ=\pi$ radians. Arc length ye sector ine radius $r$ ne central angle $\theta$ (radians) ndi$r\theta$, nzvimbo ndi$\frac12r^2\theta$.

math-h2-l1.title: Exponents ne logarithms
math-h2-l1.concept: $\log_a b=x \iff a^x=b$. Huwandu hwe logarithms hunova logarithm yechigadzirwa che arguments, musiyano unova logarithm ye quotient. Exponential growth inoratidzwa ne$a\cdot r^t$.

math-h2-l2.title: Trigonometric Functions
math-h2-l2.concept: $\pi$ radians $=180^\circ$. Zviratidzo zve $\sin,\ \cos,\ \tan$ zvinosiyana mu quadrant yega yega. $y=a\sin bx+c$ ine kukosha kukuru $|a|+c$, uye period $\frac{2\pi}{|b|}$.

math-h2-l4.title: Limit neContinuity yeBasa
math-h2-l4.concept: Kune chimiro che $\frac00$, itai factorization wobva wacheka; kana $x\to\infty$, govanisa neterm ine degree yepamusoro. Kana iri continuous, left limit, right limit nekukosha kwebasa zvese zvakaenzana.

math-h2-l5.title: Differentiation neKushandiswa Kwayo
math-h2-l5.concept: $(x^n)'=nx^{n-1}$. $f'(a)$ ndiyo slope yetangent, uye chiratidzo che $f'$ chinoratidza kukwira, kudzika nema extreme values. Kukurumidza ndiyo derivative yenzvimbo.

math-h2-seq1.title: Huwandu hweSequence ne ∑
math-h2-seq1.concept: $\sum_{k=1}^{n} a_k$ zvinoreva $a_1+a_2+\cdots+a_n$. $\sum k=\frac{n(n+1)}{2}$, $\sum c=cn$, $\sum(a_k+b_k)=\sum a_k+\sum b_k$.

math-h3-cal1.title: Differentiation yeMabasa Akasiyana
math-h3-cal1.concept: Basa rakabatana rinosiyaniswa se (derivative yebasa rekunze)×(derivative yebasa remukati), quotient se $\left(\frac{u}{v}\right)'=\frac{u'v-uv'}{v^2}$. $(e^x)'=e^x$, $(\ln x)'=\frac{1}{x}$, $(\sin x)'=\cos x$, $(\cos x)'=-\sin x$.

math-h3-cnt1.title: Permutation neCombination Dzine Kudzokorora ne Binomial Theorem
math-h3-cnt1.concept: Huwandu hwe **permutation ine kudzokorora**, apo zvinhu zvinoronga mumutsetse uchibvumira kudzokorora, ndiko kuwanza (huwandu hwezvisarudzo) kakawanda kunoenzana nehuwandu hwenzvimbo. Kune permutation ine zvinhu zvakafanana, govanisa factorial yehuwandu hwose nefactorial yezvinhu zvakafanana; **combination ine kudzokorora** ndi $_nH_r={}_{n+r-1}C_r$. Muna $(x+1)^n$, coefficient ye $x^k$ ndi $_nC_k$.

math-h3-geo1.title: Conic Sections
math-h3-geo1.concept: Focus yeparabola $y^2=4px$ ndi $(p,0)$, muellipse $\frac{x^2}{a^2}+\frac{y^2}{b^2}=1$, $c^2=a^2-b^2$, uye muhyperbola, $c^2=a^2+b^2$.

math-h3-geo2.title: Plane Vectors
math-h3-geo2.concept: Hukuru hwevector $(x,y)$ ndi $\sqrt{x^2+y^2}$, dot product ndi $x_1x_2+y_1y_2$, uye kana ma vector maviri akamira pakona yakarurama, dot product ndi 0.

math-h3-l1.title: Indefinite neDefinite Integrals
math-h3-l1.concept: $\int x^n dx=\frac{x^{n+1} }{n+1}+C$, $\int_a^b f(x)dx=F(b)-F(a)$. Kana mugumo wepamusoro nepasi watsinhanwa, chiratidzo chinoshanduka, uye renji inogona kugovaniswa.

math-h3-l2.title: Kushandiswa Kwedefinite Integral
math-h3-l2.concept: Nzvimbo inowanikwa nekuita integral ye $|f(x)|$. Chikamu chegraph chiri pasi pe $x$ axis chinogovaniswa, uye pakati pema curve maviri, integrate (kumusoro)−(kudzika). Integral yekumhanya ndiyo kureba kwakafambwa.

math-h3-l3.title: Geometric Series
math-h3-l3.concept: Kana $|r|<1$, $\sum ar^{n-1}=\frac{a}{1-r}$ inosangana (converges), uye kana $|r|\ge 1$ inosiyana (diverges). Inoshandiswa kune recurring decimals nekufamba kunodzokororwa.

math-h3-l4.title: Conditional probability nekuzvimirira
math-h3-l4.concept: $P(B\mid A)=\frac{P(A\cap B)}{P(A)}$. Kana zvakazvimirira, $P(A\cap B)=P(A)P(B)$, uye mukana wekuedza kwakazvimirira ndi$_nC_k\,p^k(1-p)^{n-k}$.

math-h3-l5.title: Binomial distribution ne normal distribution
math-h3-l5.concept: Mean ye$B(n,p)$ ndi$np$, variance ndi$np(1-p)$. Normal distribution inoitwa standardization ne$Z=\frac{X-m}{\sigma}$, uye iri symmetric pamusoro pe mean.

math-h3-pro1.title: Addition rule yemikana ne complement
math-h3-pro1.concept: $P(A\cup B)=P(A)+P(B)-P(A\cap B)$. Mukana we complement ndi$P(A^c)=1-P(A)$.

math-l1.title: Kuwana kukosha kwemutsara
math-l1.concept: Kuisa nhamba panzvimbo yeavara kunonzi **kuisa (substitution)**. Mhedzisiro yekuverenga mushure mekuisa ndiyo **kukosha kwemutsara**. Kana uchiisa nhamba isina, shandisa mabhureketi kuderedza mhosva.

math-l2.title: Zvivakwa zvekuenzana
math-l2.concept: Kuenzana kwakafanana ne**mudziyo wekuyeresa**. Kana ukawedzera kana kubvisa nhamba imwe chete mativi ose, kana kuvhiya kana kugovanisa (nenhamba isiri 0), mudziyo unoramba wakaenzana.

math-l3.title: Kugadzirisa equation yemutsetse
math-l3.concept: **Tamisa** mazwi ane $x$ kudivi rimwe nenhamba kudivi rakasiyana wozviunganidza. Kana watamisa, chiratidzo chinochinja. Pakupedzisira govanisa nenhamba iri pamberi pe$x$ uye wapedza!

math-l4.title: Kugadzirisa matambudziko neequations
math-l4.concept: Matambudziko enyaya anogadziriswa nenzira iyi: **tora zvinotsvakwa se $x$** → shandura mutsara kuita equation → gadzirisa → tarisa kuti mhinduro inoenderana nemamiriro here.

math-m1-crd1.title: Coordinate plane
math-m1-crd1.concept: Nzvimbo yepoinzi inoratidzwa se (x coordinate, y coordinate). Zviratidzo zvinosarudza quadrant yekutanga kusvika yechina, uye pakuratidza nepamusoro pe x-axis, chiratidzo che y coordinate chinochinja.

math-m1-fac1.title: Prime factorization, greatest common divisor, least common multiple
math-m1-fac1.concept: Kunyora nhamba yekuverenga sechigadzirwa che prime numbers ndiko **prime factorization**. Divisor huru pakati pema divisor akafanana ndiyo **greatest common divisor**, uye multiple diki pakati pema multiple akafanana ndiyo **least common multiple**.

math-m1-geo1.title: Zvivakwa zvemakona nepolygons
math-m1-geo1.concept: Vertical angles akaenzana, uye pamitsetse yakaenzana corresponding angles ne alternate angles akaenzana. Huwandu hwemakona emukati e$n$-gon ndi$180^\circ\times(n-2)$.

math-m1-geo2.title: Kuyera sector nezvimiro zvine mativi matatu
math-m1-geo2.concept: Arc length $=2\pi r\times\frac{a}{360}$, nzvimbo ye sector $=\pi r^2\times\frac{a}{360}$, vhoriyamu ye sphere $=\frac43\pi r^3$, vhoriyamu ye cone $=\frac13\pi r^2h$.

math-m1-neg1.title: Kuverenga nhamba dzakazara ne rational numbers
math-m1-neg1.concept: Kana nhamba mbiri dzine chiratidzo chimwe chete dzakawedzerwa, wedzera absolute values; kana zviratidzo zvakasiyana, wana musiyano we absolute values uise chiratidzo chenhamba huru. Pakuvhiya nekugovanisa, zviratidzo zvakafanana zvinopa +, zvakasiyana zvinopa −.

math-m1-prp1.title: Direct proportion ne inverse proportion
math-m1-prp1.concept: **Direct proportion** ndi y=ax, **inverse proportion** ndi$y=\frac{a}{x}$. Mu direct proportion y÷x inogara yakaenzana, mu inverse proportion x×y inogara yakaenzana.
math-m1-prp1.example: Direct proportion apo x=2 y=6: y=3x

math-m1-sta1.title: Mitengo yemiyero nerelative frequency
math-m1-sta1.concept: **Median** ndiwo mutengo wepakati kana mitengo yarongwa nehukuru, **mode** ndiwo mutengo unoonekwa kakawanda zvikuru. **Relative frequency**=(frequency)÷(frequency yose).

math-m2-geo1.title: Maitiro etriangles nequadrilaterals
math-m2-geo1.concept: Makona maviri epasi etriangle ine mativi akaenzana akaenzana. Muparallelogram, muwayo wemakona maviri akatevedzana ndi $180^\circ$, uye chikamu chinobatanidza ndangariro dzepakati dzemativi maviri etriangle ndi $\frac12$ yedivi rakasara.

math-m2-geo2.title: Kufanana nethiyorimu yaPythagoras
math-m2-geo2.concept: Mifananidzo yakafanana ine chiyero chakaenzana chemativi anoenderana, uye chiyero chenzvimbo ndicho chikwere chechiyero chekufanana. Mu right triangle, $a^2+b^2=c^2$.

math-m2-l1.title: Mitemo yema exponent nema polynomial
math-m2-l1.concept: Pakuwanza ne base imwechete, wedzera ma exponent, uye pasimba resimba, wanza ma exponent. Pa polynomial, unganidza mazwi ane mavara akafanana wobva waverenga.

math-m2-l2.title: Simultaneous linear equations
math-m2-l2.concept: Bvisa mavara mamwe pamaequation maviri kuti uwane mhinduro. Sarudza nzira yekuwedzera nekubvisa kana kupinza zvichienderana nemamiriro.

math-m2-l3.title: Linear inequalities
math-m2-l3.concept: Gadzirisa zvakafanana nemaitiro e equations, asi kana wawanza kana wagovanisa ne negative, mutungamiro we chiratidzo cheinequality unochinja.

math-m2-l4.title: Linear functions negraph
math-m2-l4.concept: Mu $y=ax+b$, $a$ ndiyo slope uye $b$ ndiyo $y$-intercept. Mitsetse yakafanana ine slope imwechete.

math-m2-l5.title: Huwandu hwenzira nemikana
math-m2-l5.concept: Mukana ndi (huwandu hwenzira dzinoitika)÷(huwandu hwenzira dzose). Pazviitiko zvisingatsamirani zvinoitika panguva imwe chete, wanza, uye 'zvishoma kamwe' shandisa chiitiko chinopikisa.

math-m2-lfn1.title: Linear function ne linear equation
math-m2-lfn1.concept: Mu linear function y=ax+b, a ndiyo slope uye b ndiyo y-intercept. Poindi rekusangana kwemagraph maviri ndiyo mhinduro yemaequation maviri akabatanidzwa.

math-m2-rec1.title: Recurring decimals
math-m2-rec1.concept: Dhesimali umo nhamba imwechete inodzokororwa nguva dzose mushure mepoindi redhesimali inonzi **recurring decimal**, uye chikamu chinodzokororwa chinonzi **recurring block**. Kana denominator yechikamu chisingaderedzwi iri 2 kana 5 chete, ndi finite decimal.

math-m3-geo1.title: Amaratio e-trigonometry
math-m3-geo1.concept: Mu right triangle, $\sin A$ ndi (kukwirira)÷(hypotenuse), $\cos A$ ndi (base)÷(hypotenuse), uye $\tan A$ ndi (kukwirira)÷(base).

math-m3-geo2.title: Maitiro edenderedzwa
math-m3-geo2.concept: Kona yakanyorwa pa arc imwe ndi $\frac12$ yekona yepakati. Tangent yakatwasuka ku radius, uye muwayo wemakona akatarisana equadrilateral yakanyorwa mudenderedzwa ndi $180^\circ$.

math-m3-l1.title: Square roots nenhamba dzechokwadi
math-m3-l1.concept: $\sqrt{a}$ ndiyo nhamba isiri negative ine chikwere chakaenzana ne $a$. Budisa maperfect squares ari mukati meradical, uye rationalize radical iri mudenominator.

math-m3-l2.title: Fomula dzekuwanza ne factorization
math-m3-l2.concept: $(a+b)^2=a^2+2ab+b^2$, $(a+b)(a-b)=a^2-b^2$. Factorization kushandisa fomula dzekuwanza zvichidzokera shure.

math-m3-l3.title: Quadratic equations
math-m3-l3.concept: Gadzirisa nekugadzira chimiro $AB=0$ uchishandisa factorization. Discriminant $D=b^2-4ac$ inoratidza huwandu hwemidzi, uye hukama pakati pemidzi ne coefficients hunogona kushandiswawo.

math-m3-l4.title: Quadratic functions negraph
math-m3-l4.concept: Incopho ye $y=a(x-p)^2+q$ ndi $(p,\ q)$, uye chiratidzo che $a$ chinotarisa kwainovhurika. Kana ukachinja kuita perfect square, unogona kuwana incopho.

math-m3-l5.title: Trigonometric ratios
math-m3-l5.concept: Mutatu une kona yakarurama, $\sin A=\frac{\text{divi rinopesana} }{\text{hypotenuse} }$, $\cos A=\frac{\text{divi riri padyo} }{\text{hypotenuse} }$, $\tan A=\frac{\text{divi rinopesana} }{\text{divi riri padyo} }$.

math-m3-sta1.title: Variance ne standard deviation
math-m3-sta1.concept: **Deviation**=(kukosha)−(mean). **Variance** ndiyo mean yemakwere edeviation, uye **standard deviation** ndiyo mudzi wepaviri wakanaka wevariance. Kukosha kukuru, data inopararira kure nemean.

alg_expMaxMin.prompt: Kana renji ye$x$ iri ${s}\le x\le {t}$ , kukosha kukuru kwe function ${f}$ ndekwei? (Nyora sechikamu chisingaderedzwi. Kana iri nhamba yakazara, nyora sanhamba yakazara. Muenzaniso: 3/4)

Kana base iri huru kupfuura $1$, kukosha kwe exponential function kunowedzera sezvo $g$ ichikura; kana iri pasi pe$1$, kunowedzera sezvo $g$ ichideredzwa.

alg_expShiftA.prompt: Kana poinzi rimwe pagraph ye function ${f}$ ri$({p}, {q})$ , kukosha kwe positive number $a$ ($a\ne1$) ndekwei? (Nyora sechikamu chisingaderedzwi. Kana iri nhamba yakazara, nyora sanhamba yakazara. Muenzaniso: 3/4)
hints: Kana waisa makoodinetsi epoinzi mufomula, simba rimwe chete re$a$ rinosara.
Nokuti $a>0$ uye exponent isiri $0$, $a$ inongova imwe chete.

alg_expSum.prompt: Kune nhamba chaiyo $x$, kana ${given}$ , kukosha kwe${ask}$ ndekwei? (Nyora nhamba chete.)

alg_geoSumRatio.prompt: Ngahuwandu hwechikamu chekutanga kusvika chechi $n$ cheshoroni yejiometri $\{a_n\}$ huve $S_n$. Kana $S_{{n1}}={u}$, $S_{{n2}}={v}$, kukosha kwe$S_{{n3}}$ kuri kupi? (nyora nhamba chete)

alg_geoTwoTerms.prompt: Pashoroni yejiometri $\{a_n\}$ ine reshiyo yakajairika yakanaka, kana $a_{{p}}={u}$, $a_{{q}}={v}$, kukosha kwe$a_{{r}}$ kuri kupi? (nyora nhamba chete)

Mamiriro ekuti reshiyo yakajairika yakanaka anoita kuti $r$ ive imwe chete.

alg_geoTwoTermsQ.prompt: Pashoroni yejiometri $\{a_n\}$ ine reshiyo yakajairika yakanaka, kana $a_{{p}}={u}$, $a_{{q}}={v}$, kukosha kwe$a_{{r}}$ kuri kupi? (nyora sechikamu chakapfupikiswa. Kana inhamba yakazara, nyora senhamba yakazara. Muenzaniso: 3/4)
