Mamiriro ekuti reshiyo yakajairika yakanaka anoita kuti $r$ ive imwe chete.

alg_growthYears.prompt: Mari inochengetwa nechikwereti chakawedzerwa chine mwero wegore ${rate}\%$, apo mubereko unowedzerwa kumari yepakutanga gore rimwe nerimwe. Kuwana nhamba yakazara yemakore mushure mawo mari yose inotanga kuva ${k}$ kana kupfuura kakawanda kwemari yepakutanga. Logarithm yakajairika yakapiwa ndi${given}$. (nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Mushure memakore $n$, mari yose ndi$(1+\frac{r}{100})^{n}$ kakawanda kwemari yepakutanga.
Kana ukatora logarithm yakajairika pamativi ose maviri, $n\log(1+\frac{r}{100})\ge\log k$.
alg_growthYears.explanation: Kana ukatora logarithm yakajairika pamativi ose maviri e$({one})^{n}\ge {k}$, $n\ge\frac{{lk}}{{l1}}={q}$, saka nhamba yechisikigo diki $n$ ndi${ans}$.

alg_inverseGraph.prompt: Chimwe chisvitsa pagirafu yefunction inopesana ye${f}$ ndi$({p}, {q})$. Kukosha kwenhamba yakanaka $a$ ($a\ne1$) kuri kupi? (nyora sechikamu chakapfupikiswa. Kana inhamba yakazara, nyora senhamba yakazara. Muenzaniso: 3/4)
hints: Kana girafu yefunction inopesana ichipfuura pachisvitsa $(p, q)$, girafu yefunction yekutanga inopfuura pachisvitsa $(q, p)$.
Isa chisvitsa ichocho mufunction yekutanga kuti uwane ikwesheni ye$a$.
alg_inverseGraph.explanation: Chisvitsa chiri pagirafu yefunction inopesana ndi$({p},{q})$, saka chisvitsa chiri pagirafu yefunction yekutanga ndi$({q},{p})$. ${work}$.

alg_inversePoints.prompt: Zvisvitsa zviviri pagirafu yefunction inopesana ye$f(x)=a^{x}+b$ ($a>1$, $b$ inhamba yakazara) ndi$({p1}, {q1})$, $({p2}, {q2})$. Kukosha kwe$a+b$ kuri kupi? (nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Kana girafu yefunction inopesana ichipfuura pachisvitsa $(p, q)$, girafu ye$f$ inopfuura pachisvitsa $(q, p)$.
Isa zvisvitsa zviviri muna $f$ kuti ugadzire maikwesheni maviri, wobva wabvisa pakati pawo kuti $b$ ibve, uchawana ikwesheni ye$a$. Sarudza mhinduro ine $a>1$.
alg_inversePoints.explanation: Zvisvitsa zviviri pagirafu ye$f$ ndi$({q1},{p1})$, $({q2},{p2})$. ${work}$, saka $a+b={ans}$.

hints: Kana ukashandisa fomula yekushandura hwaro $\log_{a}b=\frac{\log_{c}b}{\log_{c}a}$, malogarithm ari padhuze anopfupikiswa.
Pfupisa chigadzirwa chose kuita logarithm imwe, wobva wanyora nhamba iri mukati semasimba.

alg_logChainQ.prompt: Tsvaga kukosha uku. ${expr}$ (nyora sechikamu chakapfupikiswa. Kana inhamba yakazara, nyora senhamba yakazara. Muenzaniso: 3/4)
hints: Kana ukashandisa fomula yekushandura hwaro $\log_{a}b=\frac{\log_{c}b}{\log_{c}a}$, malogarithm ari padhuze anopfupikiswa.
Pfupisa chigadzirwa chose kuita logarithm imwe, wobva wanyora nhamba iri mukati semasimba.

alg_logDomain.prompt: Nhamba dzose dzizere $x$ dziri mudomain yebasa ${f}$ ndedzipi? (Nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Argument yelogarithm inofanira kunge iri yakanaka, uye zvirimo mukati meradical zvinofanira kunge zviri $0$ kana kupfuura.
Gadzirisa kusaenzana kuti uwane renji ye $x$, wobva wawana nhamba dzizere mukati mayo.
alg_logDomain.explanation: Nokuti ${work}$, nhamba dzizere $x$ dzose pamwe chete ndedzi ${ans}$.

alg_logEquation.prompt: Mhinduro chaiyo $x$ yeequation ${eq}$ ndeipi? (Nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Tanga wacheka mamiriro eargument ${dom}$.
Batanidza huwandu hwemalogarithm kuita logarithm imwe chete, wobva wagadzira equation yequadratic yeargument.
alg_logEquation.explanation: Kubva pamamiriro eargument, ${dom}$. ${work}$, uye yaunoenderana nemamiriro eargument ndi $x={ans}$.

alg_logExpress.prompt: Kana $\log_{2}3=a$, $\log_{2}5=b$, unoratidza kukosha kwe $\log_{2}{N}$ muchimiro che $xa+yb+z$ ($x, y, z$ nhamba dzine chikamu). Kukosha kwe $x+y+z$ ndekupi? (Nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Zvinhu zvekutanga zveargument ${N}$ ndi $2, 3, 5$ chete. Zviratidze sesimba renhamba.
Shandisa $\log_{2}(MN)=\log_{2}M+\log_{2}N$, $\log_{2}M^{k}=k\log_{2}M$, uye shandisa kuti $\log_{2}2=1$.

alg_logExpressQ.prompt: Kana $\log_{2}3=a$, $\log_{2}5=b$, unoratidza kukosha kwe $\log_{2}{N}$ muchimiro che $xa+yb+z$ ($x, y, z$ nhamba dzine chikamu). Kukosha kwe $x+y+z$ ndekupi? (Nyora semuchikamu chakareruka. Kana iri nhamba yakazara, nyora senhamba yakazara. Muenzaniso: 3/4)
hints: Zvinhu zvekutanga zveargument ${N}$ ndi $2, 3, 5$ chete. Zviratidze sesimba renhamba.
Shandisa $\log_{2}(MN)=\log_{2}M+\log_{2}N$, $\log_{2}M^{k}=k\log_{2}M$, uye shandisa kuti $\log_{2}2=1$.

alg_logInequality.prompt: Pane mhinduro dzekusaenzana ${ineq}$, nhamba dzizere $x$ dzose pamwe chete ndedzipi? (Nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Tanga wacheka mamiriro eargument (argument inofanira kunge iri yakanaka).
Kana base iri diki pana $1$, kana ukabvisa logarithm, kwakananga kwechiratidzo chekusaenzana kunoshanduka.
alg_logInequality.explanation: Nokuti ${work}$, nhamba dzizere $x$ dzose pamwe chete ndedzi ${ans}$.

alg_obtuseCount.prompt: Nhamba yechisikigo $x$ inoita kuti pave netriangle ine angle yakatetepa pane mativi ane urefu hwe ${a}$, ${b}$, $x$ ndeyakawanda sei? (Nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Kuti pave netriangle, divi refu kupfuura mamwe rinofanira kunge riri rakapfupika pana huwandu hwemamwe maviri.

Kuti pave neangle yakatetepa, sikweya yedivi refu kupfuura mamwe inofanira kunge iri hombe pana huwandu hwemasikweya emamwe maviri. Govanisa kuita nyaya apo $x$ ndiro divi refu kupfuura mamwe, nenyaya apo divi rine urefu hwe ${b}$ ndiro refu kupfuura mamwe.
alg_obtuseCount.explanation: Nokuti ${work}$, nhamba dzechisikigo $x$ dzose pamwe chete ndedzi ${ans}$.

alg_rationalExp.prompt: Tsvaga kukosha kwekudaro. ${expr}$ (Nyora semuchikamu chakareruka. Kana iri nhamba yakazara, nyora senhamba yakazara. Muenzaniso: 3/4)
hints: Ratidza base sesimba renhamba imwe.
Shandisa mutemo wemasimba $(a^{m})^{n}=a^{m\times n}$ sezvakaita $(c^{q})^{\frac{p}{q}}=c^{p}$, uye shandura simba risina kunaka $a^{-n}=\frac{1}{a^{n}}$.

alg_realRootCount.prompt: Kune nhamba yakazara $n$ ye $2$ kana kupfuura, huwandu hwenhamba chaidzo $x$ dzinoita $x^{n}=A$ tinohudaidza kuti $f(n)$. Kana $A={rad}$, kukosha kwe $f(2)+f(3)+\cdots+f({N})$ ndekupi? (Nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Funga nezvazvo uchigovanisa kuita kana $n$ iri yakaenzana nekana iri isingaenzani.
Zvichienderana nechiratidzo che $A$, kana $n$ yakaenzana $f(n)=2$ kana $0$, uye kana $n$ isingaenzani $f(n)=1$.
alg_realRootCount.explanation: Kana $A$ iri yakanaka, kana $n$ yakaenzana $f(n)=2$, kana $n$ isingaenzani $f(n)=1$; kana $A$ iri isina kunaka, kana $n$ yakaenzana $f(n)=0$, kana $n$ isingaenzani $f(n)=1$. Kana tikaverenga huwandu hwe $n$ dzakaenzana neisingaenzani, ${work}$.

alg_recAffine.prompt: Kana sequence $\{a_n\}$ yatsanangurwa se$a_1={s}$, $a_{n+1}={rule}$ ($n\ge1$), kukosha kwe$a_{{k}}$ ndekwei? (Nyora nhamba chete.)
hints: Wana kukosha kwe$a_2$, $a_3$, $\dots$ uchitevedzana.
Nyora nhamba dzemazwi nekukosha patafura, shandisa mutemo nhanho imwe neimwe kusvika pa$a_{{k}}$. Kana pachaonekwa zvikamu, zvidzikise.

alg_recAffineQ.prompt: Kana sequence $\{a_n\}$ yatsanangurwa se$a_1={s}$, $a_{n+1}={rule}$ ($n\ge1$), kukosha kwe$a_{{k}}$ ndekwei? (Unogona kunyora sedhesimali kana sechikamu se3/4)
hints: Wana kukosha kwe$a_2$, $a_3$, $\dots$ uchitevedzana.
Nyora nhamba dzemazwi nekukosha patafura, shandisa mutemo nhanho imwe neimwe kusvika pa$a_{{k}}$. Kana pachaonekwa zvikamu, zvidzikise.

alg_recParam.prompt: Kana sequence $\{a_n\}$ yatsanangurwa se$a_1={s}$, $a_{n+1}=pa_n+{q}$ ($n\ge1$, $p$ yakanaka) uye $a_3={t}$, kukosha kwe$p$ ndekwei? (Nyora nhamba chete.)
hints: Edza kunyora $a_2$, $a_3$ nekushandisa $p$.
$a_3$ inova quadratic expression ye$p$. Sarudza mhinduro yakanaka.
Edza kunyora nhamba iri mukati meradical se power yenhamba imwe.
Shandisa chivakwa chakakodzera pakati pe$\sqrt[n]{a}\sqrt[n]{b}=\sqrt[n]{a\times b}$, $\frac{\sqrt[n]{a}}{\sqrt[n]{b}}=\sqrt[n]{\frac{a}{b}}$, $\sqrt[m]{\sqrt[n]{a}}=\sqrt[mn]{a}$.

alg_sectorForward.prompt: Kana sector ine radius ${r}$ cm uye central angle ${th}$ ine arc length $a\pi$ cm uye nzvimbo $b\pi$ cm$^{2}$, kukosha kwe$a+b$ ndekwei? (Nyora sechikamu chisingaderedzwi. Kana iri nhamba yakazara, nyora sanhamba yakazara. Muenzaniso: 3/4)
hints: Kana central angle yashandurwa kuita radians, arc length $l=r\theta$, nzvimbo $S=\frac{1}{2}r^{2}\theta$.
Tanga wawana kuti $\theta$ ndiko kangani kwe$\pi$.

alg_sectorPerimArea.prompt: Pane masector maviri ane perimeter ye${P}$ cm uye nzvimbo ye${S}$ cm$^{2}$ (central angle iri pasi pe$2\pi$). Pakati pawo, sector ine radius huru ine radius ye cm ingani? (Nyora nhamba chete.)
hints: Kana radius ari $r$ uye arc length $l$, perimeter ndi$2r+l$, nzvimbo ndi$\frac{1}{2}rl$.
Kana $l$ yabviswa, inova quadratic equation ye$r$.
alg_sectorPerimArea.explanation: Kubva pa$2r+l={P}$, $\frac{1}{2}rl={S}$, kubvisa $l$ kunopa ${work}$, saka radius huru ndi${ans}$ cm.

alg_seqIntTerms.prompt: Kana general term ye sequence $\{a_n\}$ iri $a_n=\frac{{num}}{{den}}$, mazwi ari nhamba dzakazara ari mangani? (Nyora nhamba chete.)
hints: Govanisa numerator ne denominator uchichinja kuita $a_n=k+\frac{c}{n+r}$ ($k$ nhamba yakazara, $c$ constant).
Verenga ma divisor e constant anogona kuva denominator $n+r$ (kune nhamba yekuverenga $n$, $n+r\ge{r1}$).
alg_seqIntTerms.explanation: ${work}$ , saka mazwi ari nhamba dzakazara ari ${ans}$ pamwe chete.

alg_seriesPattern.prompt: Wana kukosha kwehuwandu hunotevera. ${expr}$ (Nyora nhamba chete.)
hints: Tsvaga mutemo, unyore general term $a_k$ seformula ye$k$.
Verenga nemafomula e$\sum k$, $\sum k^{2}$ nezvimwewo (kana zviratidzo zvichichinjana, vaunganidze vaviri vaviri).

alg_sigmaSquare.prompt: Kune sequences mbiri $\{a_n\}$, $\{b_n\}$, kana $\sum_{k=1}^{{n}}a_k^{2}={A}$, $\sum_{k=1}^{{n}}a_kb_k={B}$, $\sum_{k=1}^{{n}}b_k^{2}={C}$, mutengo we $\sum_{k=1}^{{n}}({comb})^{2}$ ndeupi? (Nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Isa chikwere chirevo chiri mubraketi wochiwedzera.
Shandisa linearity ye $\sum$ ($\sum(pa_k+qb_k)=p\sum a_k+q\sum b_k$) kuchitaura nemisumo mitatu yakapiwa.

alg_sigmaSubseq.prompt: Kana izwi rakajairika re sequence $\{a_n\}$ ri $a_n={an}$, mutengo we $\sum_{k=1}^{{m}}a_{{idx}}$ ndeupi? (Nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Chirevo chinopinda panzvimbo ye $n$ mu $a_n$ ndi ${idx}$. Chipinze kuti uite chirevo che $k$.
Shandisa $\sum k=\frac{m(m+1)}{2}$, $\sum k^{2}=\frac{m(m+1)(2m+1)}{6}$, $\sum c=cm$.

alg_sigmaTelescope.prompt: Tsvaga mutengo wemuwayo unotevera. ${expr}$ (Nyora sechikamu chisingaderedzwi. Kana iri nhamba yakazara, nyora nhamba yakazara. Muenzaniso: 3/4)
hints: Edza kuparadzanisa izwi rimwe nerimwe kuita partial fractions. Muenzaniso: $\frac{1}{k(k+1)}=\frac{1}{k}-\frac{1}{k+1}$
Kana wawedzera, mazwi ekutanga nekupedzisira anozvidzikisa pamwe chete, uye anosara ndiwo mashoma ekutanga nekupedzisira chete.

alg_sumToTerm.prompt: Kana muwayo kubva pa izwi rekutanga kusvika pa izwi re $n$ re sequence $\{a_n\}$ uri $S_n={expr}$, mutengo we $a_{1}+a_{{k}}$ ndeupi? (Nyora nhamba chete)
hints: $a_1=S_1$, uye kana $n\ge2$, $a_n=S_n-S_{n-1}$.
Usatora kuti mutengo unowanikwa nekupinza $n=1$ muchirevo che $a_n=S_n-S_{n-1}$ wakaenzana ne $S_1$.

alg_survey.prompt: Nhambwe pakati pemapoindi maviri A, B ndi${d}$ m. Kubva papoindi rimwe C, $\angle CAB=\alpha$, $\angle CBA=\beta$ uye $\sin\alpha={sa}$, $\sin\beta={sb}$ ($\alpha$, $\beta$ ndeacute angles). Nhambwe kubva ku A kusvika ku C ndeyemangani m? (Nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Nekuti $\angle C=180^\circ-\alpha-\beta$, $\sin C=\sin(\alpha+\beta)$.

Kubva ku $\sin(\alpha+\beta)=\sin\alpha\cos\beta+\cos\alpha\sin\beta$, tsvaga cosine ne $\cos=\sqrt{1-\sin^{2}}$. Wobva washandisa law of sines $\frac{\overline{A C}}{\sin\beta}=\frac{\overline{A B}}{\sin C}$.
alg_survey.explanation: Nekuti ${work}$, nhambwe kubva ku A kusvika ku C ndi${ans}$ m.

alg_trigGraphParam.prompt: Kana mutengo mukuru webasa $y=a{fn}\,bx+c$ ($a>0$, $b>0$) uri ${M}$, mutengo mudiki uri ${m}$, uye period iri ${per}$, mutengo wechibereko chemakonsitanti matatu $abc$ ndeupi? (Nyora sechikamu chisingaderedzwi. Kana iri nhamba yakazara, nyora nhamba yakazara. Muenzaniso: 3/4)
hints: Mutengo mukuru ndi $a+c$, mutengo mudiki ndi $-a+c$.
Shandisa kuti period ndi $\frac{2\pi}{b}$ kuti utsvage $b$.

alg_trigIdentity.prompt: Kune nhamba yechokwadi $\theta$, kana ${given}$, mutengo we ${E}$ ndeupi? (Nyora sechikamu chisingaderedzwi. Kana iri nhamba yakazara, nyora nhamba yakazara. Muenzaniso: 3/4)
hints: $\sin^{2}\theta+\cos^{2}\theta=1$. Kana mativi ose maviri echirevo chakapiwa akaitwa masquare, $\sin\theta\cos\theta$ inoonekwa.
Isa chikwere chirevo chakapiwa kuti utsvage mutengo we $\sin\theta\cos\theta$. Kana chirevo chinotsvakwa ichikwere chimwe, chitaure nenzira imwechete uchishandisa $\sin\theta\cos\theta$.

alg_trigPeriod.prompt: Kana period diki yakanaka yebasa ${f}$ iri $k\pi$, mutengo we $k$ ndeupi? (Nyora sechikamu chisingaderedzwi. Kana iri nhamba yakazara, nyora nhamba yakazara. Muenzaniso: 3/4)
hints: Period ye $y=\sin bx$, $y=\cos bx$ ndi $\frac{2\pi}{|b|}$, uye period ye $y=\tan bx$ ndi $\frac{\pi}{|b|}$.
Kana pane mutengo wakakwana, chikamu chine negative che graph chinokwidzwa kumusoro uye period inova hafu. Kune masquare, shandisa $\sin^{2}x=\frac{1-\cos2x}{2}$, $\cos^{2}x=\frac{1+\cos2x}{2}$.

alg_trigPoint.prompt: Kana kona yakaenzana ne $\theta$ ine initial side iri positive direction ye $x$-axis uye poindi riri pa terminal side riri P$({xp}, {yp})$, mutengo we ${E}$ ndeupi? (Nyora sechikamu chisingaderedzwi. Kana iri nhamba yakazara, nyora nhamba yakazara. Muenzaniso: 3/4)
hints: Tanga watsvaga nhambwe kubva pa origin O kusvika papoindi P, $r=\sqrt{x^{2}+y^{2}}$ (kana makomedheniti epoindi P ari $(x, y)$).
$\sin\theta=\frac{y}{r}$, $\cos\theta=\frac{x}{r}$, $\tan\theta=\frac{y}{x}$.

alg_trigRootCount.prompt: Pa $0\le\theta<2\pi$, huwandu hwemidzi yechokwadi yakasiyana ye equation ${eq}$ ndehupi? (Nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Kana $k\theta=\phi$, huwandu hwe $\phi$ ndi $0\le\phi<2k\pi$.
Verenga huwandu hwemapoindi ekusangana kwe graph ye $y=\sin\phi$ nezvimwe nemutsetse $y=$ (konsitanti) pa period imwe neimwe.

alg_trigSpecial.prompt: Tsvaga mutengo unotevera. ${expr}$ (Unogona kunyora sedhesimali kana sechikamu seu 3/4)
hints: Chinja kona kuita kona isingaiti $0^\circ$ kusvika pasi pe $360^\circ$ (kona ine terminal side imwechete).
Shandisa $\sin30^\circ=\frac{1}{2}$, $\cos60^\circ=\frac{1}{2}$, $\tan45^\circ=1$ nemisiyano yezviratidzo mukota imwe neimwe.

bm_absIneq.prompt: Pakati pemhinduro dze inequality ${ineq}$, nhamba dzakazara $x$ dzine $-{N}\le x\le {N}$ ndedzingani? (Nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Tanga wasiyanisa kuti mutengo wakakwana uri mudiki kana mukuru kupfuura nhamba.
Kana uri mudiki, chinja kuita $-c<A<c$, kana uri mukuru, kuita $A<-c$ kana $A>c$, wotsvaga huwandu hwe $x$, wobva waverenga nhamba dzakazara mukati mehuwandu hwakapiwa.
bm_absIneq.explanation: Kana chiratidzo chemutengo wakakwana chabviswa, mhinduro ye ${ineq}$ ndi${sol}$. Pakati peidzi, nhamba dzakazara dzisingapfuri $-{N}$ kusvika ${N}$ ndi${ans}$.

bm_circleLine.prompt: Denderedzwa: ${circ}$, mutsetse: ${line}$. Nhamba dzakazara $m$ dzinoita kuti zvisangane pamapoindi maviri akasiyana ndedzingani? (Nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Kana equation yemutsetse yapinzwa mu equation yedenderedzwa, inova quadratic equation ye $x$.

Kuti zvisangane pamapoindi maviri akasiyana, quadratic equation iyi inofanira kuva nemidzi miviri yechokwadi yakasiyana. Tsvaga huwandu hwe $m$ kubva ku discriminant $D>0$ wobva waverenga nhamba dzakazara.
bm_circleLine.explanation: Kana equation yemutsetse yapinzwa mu equation yedenderedzwa, ${sub}=0$. Kana discriminant iri $D$, $\frac{D}{4}={d4}$, saka kubva ku $D>0$, ${cond}$. Nekuti ${chk}$, nhamba dzakazara $m$ ndidzo dzese kubva pa $-{hi}$ kusvika ${hi}$, saka dzose ndi${ans}$.

bm_compUnknown.prompt: Kune mabasa maviri $f(x)={f}$, $g$, kana composite function $(g\circ f)(x)={h}$, mutengo we $g({k})$ ndeupi? (Nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Kuti uwane mutengo we $g({k})$, tsvaga $x$ kana $f(x)={k}$.
Pinza $x$ iyoyo mu composite function $(g\circ f)(x)=g(f(x))$.
bm_compUnknown.explanation: Kubva ku $f(x)={k}$, $x={x0}$. $(g\circ f)({x0})=g(f({x0}))=g({k})$, saka kubva ku $g({k})={h}$, mutengo kana $x={x0}$ ndi${ans}$.

bm_countDigits.prompt: Pane makadhi ${n}$ ane manhamba akasiyana, imwe pakadhi rimwe nerimwe, uye manhamba ari pamakadhi ndeaya ${ds}$. Kana ukasarudza makadhi 3 ukaaronga mumutsara umwe kuita nhamba yenhamba nhatu, nhamba dzakaenzana dzinogona kuva ngani? (0 haigoni kuva panzvimbo yekutanga. Nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Nzvimbo yeumwe inofanira kuva nhamba yakaenzana. Sarudza nzvimbo yeumwe kutanga wobva wazadza dzimwe.
Paradzanisa mamiriro apo nzvimbo yeumwe iri 0 nepo iri nhamba yakaenzana isiri 0, uye verenga nepermutation. Kana nhamba yakaenzana isiri 0 iri panzvimbo yeumwe, 0 haigoni kuva panzvimbo yekutanga.
bm_countDigits.explanation: Kana nzvimbo yeumwe iri 0: nzvimbo mbiri dzasara dzinosarudzwa kubva pamakadhi ${n1}$ asara ndokurongwa mumutsara, saka ${zex}$. Kana nzvimbo yeumwe iri nhamba yakaenzana isiri 0: nzvimbo yeumwe inosarudzwa pakati pemakadhi ${nz}$ enhamba dzakaenzana dzisiri 0, nzvimbo yekutanga inosarudzwa pamakadhi ${n2}$ asara asina 0, nzvimbo yepakati inosarudzwa pamakadhi ${n2}$ asara, saka ${oex}$. Nemutemo wekuwedzera, ${z}+{o}={ans}$.

bm_discK.prompt: Pakati penhamba dzakazara $k$ dzinoita kuti graph ye quadratic function $y={f}$ igumane axis ye $x$ pamapoinzi maviri akasiyana, mangani ari pa $-{N}\le k\le {N}$? (Nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Graph kugumana axis ye $x$ pamapoinzi maviri akasiyana zvakafanana ne quadratic equation $y=0$ kuva nemidzi miviri yechokwadi yakasiyana.
Tsvaga renji ye $k$ iyo discriminant $D$ inenge yakakura kudarika 0, wobva wavhara nhamba dzakazara dziri murenji yakapihwa.
bm_discK.explanation: Kuti ive nemidzi miviri yechokwadi yakasiyana, discriminant $D={D}>0$ inofanira kuva, saka ${cond}$. Nhamba dzakazara $k$ dzinogutsa izvi pa $-{N}\le k\le {N}$ dzose ndedzi ${ans}$.

bm_funcCount.prompt: Seti $X$ ndiyo seti yenhamba dzese dzechisikirwa dziri ${m}$ kana pasi, uye seti $Y$ ndiyo seti yenhamba dzese dzechisikirwa dziri ${n}$ kana pasi. Pakati pemafunction $f$ kubva ku $X$ kuenda ku $Y$, mangani ane $f(1)=1$ uye asiri one-to-one? (Nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Kana $f(1)=1$, kukosha kwe function kweimwe neimwe yezvikamu zvakasara kunogona kusarudzwa zvakasununguka kubva pazvikamu ze $Y$.
Tsvaga se (mafunction ese anogutsa mamiriro) $-$ (aya ari one-to-one). Mu one-to-one function, zvikamu zvakasiyana zvine kukosha kwakasiyana.
bm_funcCount.explanation: Mafunction ane $f(1)=1$ ndeane ${tot}$, nekuti zvikamu ${m1}$ zvakasara zvega zvega zvinogona kuva nekukosha kwe ${n}$; pakati pawo, ari one-to-one ndeane ${inj}$ nekuti zvikamu zvakasara zvinofanira kuva nekukosha kwakasiyana kusiri 1. Saka ${tot}-{inj}={ans}$.

bm_ineqSystem.prompt: Pakati pezvigadziriso zvakafanana zveinequalities mbiri dzemutsetse ${i1}$, ${i2}$, nhamba dzakazara $x$ dziri ngani? (Nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Gadzirisa inequality imwe neimwe yega kuti utange wawana renji ye $x$.

Ratidza chikamu chinopindirana chemarenji maviri panhamba line, wobva wavhara nhamba dzakazara dziri mukati. Kana uchipatsanura kana kuwanza nenhamba isina kunaka (negative), chiratidzo che inequality chinochinja.
bm_ineqSystem.explanation: Kugadzirisa inequality yekutanga kunopa ${s1}$, yechipiri kunopa ${s2}$. Nhamba dzakazara dziri murenji yakafanana ndedzi ${ints}$, saka dzose ndedzi ${ans}$.

bm_lineParPerp.prompt: Pane mutsetse $L:{L}$ uye pointi $\mathrm{P}$ ine makoodineti $({x0},{y0})$. Kana $y$-intercept yemutsetse unopfuura pa pointi $\mathrm{P}$ uchienderana na $L$ iri $s$, uye $y$-intercept yemutsetse unopfuura pa pointi $\mathrm{P}$ uri perpendicular na $L$ iri $t$, kukosha kwe $s+t$ ndekupi? (Nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Slope yemutsetse wemhando $ax+by+c=0$ ndiyo $-\frac{a}{b}$, uye chigadzirwa che slope dzemitsetse miviri yakamira perpendicular ndi $-1$.
Mutsetse unoenderana une makoefficient akafanana e $x$ ne $y$, uye wakamira perpendicular une chimiro $bx-ay=k$ ($k$ i constant). Isa makoodineti e pointi P kuti uwane $k$.
bm_lineParPerp.explanation: Mutsetse unoenderana ndi ${par}$ uye kuisa $x=0$ kunopa $s={s}$. Mutsetse perpendicular ndi ${perp}$ uye kuisa $x=0$ kunopa $t={t}$. Saka $s+t={ans}$.

bm_matUnknown.prompt: Kana matrix $A={A}$, $B={B}$, $C={C}$ uye ${ex}=C$ ichigutsa, kukosha kwe sum $x+y$ yenhamba dzechokwadi $x$, $y$ ndekupi? (Nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Matrix mbiri dzinofanana kana zvikamu zviri panzvimbo imwe chete zvakaenzana.
Gadzira equation yemutsetse kubva pachikamu chine $x$ kuti uwane $x$, wobva wawana $y$ nenzira imwe chete.
bm_matUnknown.explanation: Kuenzanisa zvikamu zvine $x$ kunopa ${eqx}$, saka $x={xv}$; kuenzanisa zvikamu zvine $y$ kunopa ${eqy}$, saka $y={yv}$. Saka $x+y={ans}$.

bm_polyExpand.prompt: Kana expansion yeexpression ${expr}$ yarongwa mudescending order ye $x$, huwandu hwe coefficient ye $x^2$ neconstant term ndehupi? (Nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Wedzera chibereko chimwe nechimwe chega, wobva wabatanidza terms dzakafanana.
Zvinobatsira kushandisa fomula yekuwedzera $(ax+b)^2=a^2x^2+2abx+b^2$. Usakanganwe zviratidzo nema coefficient ari kumberi.
bm_polyExpand.explanation: Nokuti $({e1}){op}({e2})$, kana tikarongedza tinowana ${total}$. Coefficient ye $x^2$ ndi ${c2}$, constant term ndi ${c0}$, saka huwandu ndi ${ans}$.

bm_polyFactor.prompt: Mugumisiro wefactorization yequadratic ${Pex}$ ndi $(ax+b)(cx+d)$. Kana $a$, $b$, $c$, $d$ dziri nhamba dzizere, $a>0$, $c>0$, $a\le c$, uye kana $a=c$ ipapo $b\le d$, kukosha kwe $a+b+c+d$ ndekupi? (Nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Funga nezvemaparera enhamba dzizere dzinogona kuita constant term $bd$ ne coefficient ye $x^2$ $ac$.
Sarudza mumwe, wowedzera, wobva wacheka kana coefficient ye $x$ yakaenzana ne $ad+bc$.

bm_propRange.prompt: Kune mamiriro maviri $p:{pc}$, $q: m\le x\le {n}$ e nhamba chaidzo $x$, nhamba yakazara hombe $m$ inoita kuti mataurirwo $p\to q$ ave echokwadi ndeipi? (Nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Kana mataurirwo $p\to q$ ari echokwadi, seti yechokwadi ye $p$ iri mukati meseti yechokwadi ye $q$.
Tanga wawana renji ye $x$ inoita $p$, wobva waita kuti mugumo wekuruboshwe werenji iyoyo ive $m$ kana kupfuura.
bm_propRange.explanation: Seti yechokwadi ye $p$ ndi $\{x\mid {lo}{rl}x{rl}{hi}\}$. Kuti iri mukati meseti yechokwadi ye $q$ $\{x\mid m\le x\le {n}\}$, zvinofanira kuva $m\le {lo}$ uye ${hi}\le {n}$. Saka kukosha kukuru kwenhamba yakazara $m$ ndi ${ans}$.

bm_quadRange.prompt: Kune quadratic function $f(x)={f}$, kana kukosha kukuru kwe $f(x)$ pa ${s}\le x\le {t}$ kuri $M$ uye kukosha kudiki kuri $m$, kukosha kwe $M+m$ ndekupi? (Nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Shandura kuita chimiro che $f(x)=a(x-p)^2+q$ kuti uwane vertex.
Coordinate ye $x$ yevertex iri mukati merenji yakapiwa, saka enzanisa kukosha kwebasa pavertex nepamigumo miviri yerenji.
bm_quadRange.explanation: Nokuti $f(x)={vf}$, vertex ndi $({h},{k})$ uye iri mukati merenji. Kukosha kwebasa pamigumo miviri ndi $f({s})={fs}$, $f({t})={ft}$, saka kukosha kukuru $M={M}$, kudiki $m={m}$, uye $M+m={ans}$.

bm_quadRoots.prompt: Midzi miviri yakasiyana yaiyo chaiyo yeequation ${eq}$ ye $x$, kubva kudiki, ndi $\alpha$, $\beta$. Kukosha kwe $\beta-2\alpha$ ndekupi? (Nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Tamisa terms dzose dziri kurudyi kuenda kuruboshwe kuti uite chimiro che (quadratic)$=0$.
Itai factorization kuti muwane midzi miviri, wobva waisa mudzi mudiki ku $\alpha$ nomukuru ku $\beta$.
bm_quadRoots.explanation: Kana tikarongedza, ${std}=0$, uye kana tikaita factorization ${fac}=0$, saka $\alpha={al}$, $\beta={be}$. Nokudaro $\beta-2\alpha={ans}$.

bm_setOps.prompt: Seti yese $U$ ndiyo seti yenhamba dzose dzechisikigo dziri ${n}$ kana pasi pazvo. Seti diki $A$ ye $U$ ndiyo seti yedivisor dzose dze ${a}$, uye $B$ ndiyo seti yema multiple ose e ${b}$. Huwandu hwema element ose eseti $A\cap B^{c}$ ndehupi? (Nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Nyora $A$ ne $B$ nenzira yekurondedzera ma element. $B$ unofungwa mukati me $U$ chete.
$B^{c}$ ndizvo zvinosara kana ma element e $B$ abviswa pa $U$. Sarudza chete ma element e $A$ asiri mu $B$.
bm_setOps.explanation: Nokuti $A=\{{As}\}$, $B=\{{Bs}\}$, $A\cap B^{c}=\{{Rs}\}$ uye huwandu hwema element ndi ${ans}$.

bm_transform.prompt: Makoodhineti echisvitsa $\mathrm{P}$ ndi$({a},{b})$. Chisvitsa chakawanikwa nekutamisa $\mathrm{P}$ ne${p}$ munzira ye$x$-axis uye ne${q}$ munzira ye$y$-axis ndi$\mathrm{Q}$, chakawanikwa nekutarisa $\mathrm{Q}$ pa$x$-axis ndi$\mathrm{R}$, uye chakawanikwa nekutarisa $\mathrm{R}$ pamutsetse $y=x$ ndi$\mathrm{S}(m,n)$. Kukosha kwe$2m+n$ kuri kupi? (nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Kutamisa: $(x,y)\to(x+p,\,y+q)$, kutarisa pa$x$-axis: $(x,y)\to(x,-y)$, kutarisa pamutsetse $y=x$: $(x,y)\to(y,x)$.
Wana chisvitsa chimwe panguva imwe nenzira inotevedzana.

ca1_absNotDiff.prompt: Pafunction $f(x)={fx}$, nhamba chaidzo $k$ dzinoita kuti $f$ isagone kusiyaniswa pa$x=k$ dzakawanda sei ose? (nyora nhamba chete)
hints: $|g(x)|$ inokotama pazvisvitsa apo chiratidzo che$g(x)$ chinoshanduka. Tarisa kana chiratidzo chinoshanduka pamudzi (kana iri mudzi wakapetwa).
Kana kuwanda kwemudzi wega wega kusiri kwakaenzana, haigoni kusiyaniswa pachisvitsa ichocho, kana kwakaenzana inogona kusiyaniswa.
ca1_absNotDiff.explanation: Pamidzi yeikwesheni (dzimwe) iri mukati mekukosha kusina chiratidzo, iyo ine kuwanda kusina kuenzana ndi${oddr}$, uye iyo ine kuwanda kwakaenzana ndi${evenr}$. Pamidzi ine kuwanda kusina kuenzana chiratidzo chinoshanduka uye mitero yekuruboshwe nekurudyi inosiyana, saka haigoni kusiyaniswa, asi pamidzi ine kuwanda kwakaenzana inogona kusiyaniswa. Saka zvisvitsa zvinotsvakwa ndi${ans}$.

ca1_areaCubicAxis.prompt: Huwandu hwenzvimbo mbiri dzakakomberedzwa nekakona $y={f}$ ne$x$-axis ndehwei? (nyora sechikamu chakapfupikiswa. Kana inhamba yakazara, nyora senhamba yakazara. Muenzaniso: 3/4)
hints: Wana $x$ dzezvisvitsa zvekusangana kwekakona ne$x$-axis (midzi mitatu yeikwesheni yechitatu).
Pachikamu chimwe nechimwe tarisa kana kakona kari pamusoro kana pasi pe$x$-axis, uye kana kari pasi, shandura chiratidzo uchiita integral.
ca1_areaCubicAxis.explanation: Zvisvitsa zvekusangana kwekakona ne$x$-axis ndi$x={rs}$. Paparutivi $[{r1},{r2}]$ $\int y\,dx={i1}$, paparutivi $[{r2},{r3}]$ $\int y\,dx={i2}$, saka huwandu hwenzvimbo ndi$\left|{i1}\right|+\left|{i2}\right|={ansf}$.

ca1_areaLineParam.prompt: Kana nzvimbo yakakomberedzwa nekakona $y={cur}$ nemutsetse $y=mx$ ($0<m<{a}$) iri ${S}$, kukosha kwekoronstanti $m$ kuri kupi? (nyora nhamba chete)
hints: $x$ dzezvisvitsa zvekusangana kwekakona nemutsetse ndi$0$, ${a}-m$.
Ita integral ye(kakona)−(mutsetse) pakati pezvisvitsa zviviri, uinyore uchishandisa $m$, wobva wagadzirisa ikwesheni inoita kuti ive ${S}$.
ca1_areaLineParam.explanation: $x$ dzezvisvitsa zvekusangana ndi$0$, ${a}-m$ uye nzvimbo ndi$\int_0^{{a}-m}\{({a}-m)x-x^2\}dx=\frac{({a}-m)^3}{6}$. Sezvo iri ${S}$, ${a}-m={d}$, ndiko kuti $m={ans}$.

ca1_areaParabolaLine.prompt: Nzvimbo yakakomberedzwa neparaboro $y={f}$ nemutsetse $y={g}$ ndeyei? (nyora sechikamu chakapfupikiswa. Kana inhamba yakazara, nyora senhamba yakazara. Muenzaniso: 3/4)
hints: Batanidza maikwesheni maviri kuti uwane $x$ dzezvisvitsa zvekusangana $\alpha<\beta$.
Ita integral ye(ikwesheni yepamusoro)−(ikwesheni yepasi) kubva ku$\alpha$ kusvika ku$\beta$.
ca1_areaParabolaLine.explanation: Kana maikwesheni maviri abatanidzwa, $x$ dzezvisvitsa zvekusangana ndi${al}$, ${be}$ uye musiyano wemaikwesheni maviri ndi${dif}$. Kana paparutivi iri tikaita integral ye(girafu yepamusoro)−(girafu yepasi), nzvimbo ndi${calc}={ansf}$.

ca1_areaTangentParabola.prompt: Nzvimbo yakakomberedzwa nemutsetse unobata paraboro $y={f}$ pachisvitsa chine $x$ ye${a}$, paraboro iyi, ne$y$-axis ndeyei? (nyora sechikamu chakapfupikiswa. Kana inhamba yakazara, nyora senhamba yakazara. Muenzaniso: 3/4)
hints: Tanga wawana ikwesheni yemutsetse unobata. Mutsetse unobata uri parutivi rumwe chete (kumusoro kana kuzasi) rweparaboro.
Ita integral yekukosha kusina chiratidzo kwe(paraboro)−(mutsetse unobata) kubva pa$x=0$ kusvika pa$x={a}$.
ca1_areaTangentParabola.explanation: Ikwesheni yemutsetse unobata ndi$y={tl}$ uye musiyano weparaboro nemutsetse unobata ndi${dif}$. Kana kukosha kusina chiratidzo kwemusiyano uyu kwaitwa integral kubva pa$x=0$ kusvika pa$x={a}$, nzvimbo ndi${calc}={ansf}$.

ca1_contProduct.prompt: Pafunction ${pw}$ ne$g(x)={gd}$ (mavara ose ari muikwesheni ye$g$ makoronstanti), kana $f(x)g(x)$ ichienderera pa$x$ dzose chaidzo, kukosha kwe$g({kq})$ kuri kupi? (nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Kuti $f(x)g(x)$ ienderere kunyange pazvisvitsa apo $f$ isingaenderere, kukosha kwe$g$ pachisvitsa ichocho kunofanira kuva sei?
Shandisa mamiriro ekuti $g=0$ pachisvitsa ichocho kuti usarudze makoronstanti emavara aripo muikwesheni ye$g$.
ca1_contProduct.explanation: $f$ inosvetuka pa${ptxt}$, saka kuti $f(x)g(x)$ ienderere, $g=0$ inofanira kuva pazvisvitsa izvi. Kana makoronstanti asarudzwa nemamiriro aya, $g(x)={gfull}$ uye $g({kq})={ans}$.

ca1_contRadical.prompt: Kana function ${pw}$ ichienderera pa$x={c}$, kukosha kwekoronstanti $k$ kuri kupi? (nyora sechikamu chakapfupikiswa. Kana inhamba yakazara, nyora senhamba yakazara. Muenzaniso: 3/4)
hints: Kuti ienderere pa$x={c}$, kukosha kwelumiti kana $x\to {c}$ kunofanira kuva $k$.
Svunungura mudzi muchiverengero kana pachikamu chekuzasi, wobva wapfupisa chinhu chakajairika.
ca1_contRadical.explanation: Kuti ienderere, $k=\lim_{x\to {c}}f(x)$. Pa$x\ne {c}$, kana mudzi wasunungurwa uye zvapfupikiswa, $f(x)={rat}$, saka kukosha kwelumiti kana $x\to {c}$ ndi$k={ansf}$.

ca1_contTwoJoint.prompt: Kana function ${pw}$ ichienderera pa$x$ dzose chaidzo, kukosha kwe$a+b$ pamakoronstanti $a$, $b$ kuri kupi? (nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Panogona kusaenderera ndipo apo ikwesheni inoshanduka, $x={p1}$, $x={p2}$.
Gadzira ikwesheni inoti kukosha kweikwesheni yekuruboshwe neyekurudyi kwakaenzana pachisvitsa chimwe nechimwe.
ca1_contTwoJoint.explanation: Pa$x={p1}$, $x={p2}$ kukosha kwemativi ose maviri kunofanira kuenzana, saka tinowana maikwesheni maviri, uye kana agadziriswa, $a={av}$, $b={bv}$. Saka $a+b={ans}$.

ca1_defIntAbs.prompt: Kukosha kwe$\int_{{p}}^{{q}}|{g}|\,dx$ kuri kupi? (nyora sechikamu chakapfupikiswa. Kana inhamba yakazara, nyora senhamba yakazara. Muenzaniso: 3/4)
hints: Tsvaga chisvitsa apo chiratidzo cheikwesheni iri mukati mekukosha kusina chiratidzo chinoshanduka, ndiko kuti mudzi une $x$ uri mukati meparutivi.
Kamura parutivi pachisvitsa ichocho, bvisa kukosha kusina chiratidzo muchikamu chimwe nechimwe, wobva waita integral.
ca1_defIntAbs.explanation: Ikwesheni iri mukati mekukosha kusina chiratidzo inoshandura chiratidzo pa$x={zs}$, saka parutivi pakamurwa. Muchikamu chimwe nechimwe chiratidzo hachishanduki, saka kana kukosha kusina chiratidzo kweintegral yechikamu chimwe nechimwe kwawedzerwa, ${parts}={ansf}$.

ca1_defIntFindBound.prompt: Pa$a$ yakanaka, kana $\int_{{lo}}^{a}\left({g}\right)dx={V}$, kukosha kwe$a$ kuri kupi? (nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Wana indefinite integral wobva wanyora $\int_{{lo}}^{a}$ sepolynomial ye$a$.
Kubva paikwesheni yawawana, tsvaga mhinduro ine $a>{lo}$. Sezvo ikwesheni ichikwira, pane mhinduro imwe chete.
ca1_defIntFindBound.explanation: Indefinite integral imwe ndi$G(x)={G}$, saka $G(a)-G({lo})={V}$, uye pa$a>{lo}$ kukosha uku kunokwira ne$a$, saka pane mhinduro imwe chete. Kana yagadziriswa, $a={ans}$.

ca1_defIntSplit.prompt: Pafunction inoenderera $f(x)$, kana $\int_{{a0}}^{{p}}f(x)\,dx={A}$, $\int_{{a0}}^{{q}}f(x)\,dx={B}$, kukosha kwe$\int_{{lo}}^{{hi}}\left({mf}\right)dx$ kuri kupi? (nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Shandisa zvivakwa zveintegral yakatemwa $\int_a^b f\,dx+\int_b^c f\,dx=\int_a^c f\,dx$ ne$\int_b^a f\,dx=-\int_a^b f\,dx$.
Nyora integral ye$f$ yaunotsvaga uchishandisa kukosha kuviri kwakapiwa, wobva waita integral yechikamu chekoronstanti zvakasiyana.
ca1_defIntSplit.explanation: Paparutivi razvinotsvakwa, $\int f(x)\,dx={I}$. Chikamu chekoronstanti chinoverengwa se$\int c\,dx=c\times(\text{urefu hune nzira hweparutivi})$ wobva wachiwedzera. Saka kukosha ndi${ans}$.

ca1_defIntSymm.prompt: Kukosha kwe$\int_{-{a}}^{{a}}\left({g}\right)dx$ kuri kupi? (nyora sechikamu chakapfupikiswa. Kana inhamba yakazara, nyora senhamba yakazara. Muenzaniso: 3/4)
hints: Parutivi rwakaenzana kuoriginu. Integral yezvikamu zvine masimba asina kuenzana e$x$ ndi$0$.
Wedzera ikwesheni kuti usare nezvikamu zvine masimba akaenzana chete, wobva waverenga se$2\int_0^{a}$.
ca1_defIntSymm.explanation: Kana ikwesheni yagadzirwa, integral yakatemwa yezvikamu zvemasimba asina kuenzana ndi$0$ uye yezvikamu zvemasimba akaenzana ndi${evp}$. Saka $2\int_0^{a}\left({evp}\right)dx={ansf}$.

ca1_derivSignMin.prompt: Pafunction yepolynomial $f$, kana ${given}$, huwandu hwekukosha kwose kwe$x$ kunopa kukosha kwakaderera kwe$f$ ndehwei? (nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Kukosha kwakanyanya kunobuda pazvisvitsa apo chiratidzo che$f'(x)$ chinoshanduka. Pamudzi wakapetwa (chinhu chakapetwa kaviri) chiratidzo hachishanduki.
Tarisa chiratidzo che$f'(x)$ kuruboshwe nekurudyi kwemudzi mumwe nemumwe, wotsvaga zvisvitsa apo chinoshanduka kubva pa$-$ kuenda pa$+$.
ca1_derivSignMin.explanation: Zvisvitsa apo chiratidzo che$f'(x)$ chinoshanduka kubva pa$-$ kuenda pa$+$ ndizvo zvakaderera. Kana tafata tafura yezviratidzo, zvisvitsa zvakadaro ndi$x$ kana ${mins}$, uye huwandu ndi ${ans}$.

ca1_diffLimitPoly.prompt: Kana $f(x)={f}$, kukosha kwe${lim}$ kuri kupi? (nyora sechikamu chakapfupikiswa. Kana inhamba yakazara, nyora senhamba yakazara. Muenzaniso: 3/4)
hints: Unogona kushandura ikwesheni kuita chimiro chedhefinishani yedhirivhativhi ye$f$, $\lim\frac{f(a+\Delta)-f(a)}{\Delta}$. Wedzera nekubvisa kuti chimiro che$f(x)-f({a})$ chioneke pachiverengero.
Tanga wawana kukosha kwe$f({a})$ kana $f'({a})$, wobva wavasanganisa zvakakodzera neikwesheni.
ca1_diffLimitPoly.explanation: Tanga wawana $f'(x)$, saka $f'({a})={d1}$ uye $f({a})={d0}$. Kana lumiti yanyorwa sedhirivhativhi, ${step}={ansf}$.

ca1_diffParam.prompt: Kana function ${pw}$ ichigona kusiyaniswa pa$x={c}$, kukosha kwe$a+b$ kwemakoronstanti $a$, $b$ kuri kupi? (nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Kana ichigona kusiyaniswa, inoenderera pa$x={c}$, uye dhirivhativhi yekuruboshwe neyekurudyi dzakaenzana.
Gadzira maikwesheni maviri: kukosha kwemafunction mairi maviri pa$x={c}$ kwakaenzana, uye kukosha kwemadhirivhativhi kwakaenzana.
ca1_diffParam.explanation: Sezvo ichienderera pa$x={c}$, kukosha kwemaikwesheni maviri kwakaenzana, uye sezvo ichigona kusiyaniswa, kukosha kwemadhirivhativhi avo kwakaenzanawo. Kana maikwesheni maviri agadziriswa, $a={av}$, $b={bv}$, saka $a+b={ans}$.

ca1_extremaCoef.prompt: Function yechitatu $f(x)={f}$ ($a$, $b$, $c$ makoronstanti) ine kukosha kwakanyanya pa$x={m}$, kukosha kwakaderera pa$x={n}$, uye $f({z})={w}$. Huwandu hwekukosha kwakanyanya nekwakaderera ndehwei? (nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Pazvisvitsa zvekukosha kwakanyanya nekwakaderera $f'(x)=0$, saka unogona kuwana $a$, $b$ kubva pa$f'({m})=f'({n})=0$.
Mushure mekuwana $a$, $b$, sarudza $c$ kubva pamamiriro e$f({z})={w}$. Pakupedzisira verenga kukosha kwakanyanya $f({m})$ nekwakaderera $f({n})$ wovawedzera.
ca1_extremaCoef.explanation: Kubva pa$f'({m})=f'({n})=0$, $a={av}$, $b={bv}$, uye kubva pa$f({z})={w}$, $c={cv}$. Kukosha kwakanyanya ndi$f({m})={fm}$, kwakaderera ndi$f({n})={fn}$, saka huwandu ndi ${ans}$.

ca1_indefInitial.prompt: Dhirivhativhi yefunction $f(x)$ ndi$f'(x)={d}$ uye $f({p})={q}$. Kukosha kwe$f({r})$ kuri kupi? (nyora nhamba chete)
hints: $f(x)$ ndiyo indefinite integral ye$f'(x)$. Wana $f(x)$ uchisanganisa koronstanti yeintegral $C$.
Kubva pamamiriro e$f({p})={q}$ sarudza koronstanti $C$, wobva wawana kukosha kwe$f({r})$.

ca1_indefSecond.prompt: Pafunction $f(x)$, $f''(x)={d}$, $f'({p})={s}$, uye $f({q})={w}$. Kukosha kwe$f({r})$ kuri kupi? (nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Kana ukaita integral ye$f''$ kamwe unowana $f'$, kana wakaiita zvakare unowana $f$. Integral imwe neimwe inouya nekoronstanti imwe.
Kubva pamamiriro e$f'({p})={s}$ sarudza koronstanti yekutanga, uye kubva pa$f({q})={w}$ sarudza yechipiri.
ca1_indefSecond.explanation: Kana tafunga integral ye$f''$ wosarudza koronstanti kubva pa$f'({p})={s}$, $f'(x)={g1}$, uye kana tafunga integral zvakare wosarudza koronstanti kubva pa$f({q})={w}$, $f(x)={g0}$. Saka $f({r})={ans}$.

ca1_ineqParam.prompt: Pafunction $f(x)={f}$, kukosha kwakaderera kwenhamba chaiyo $a$ inoita kuti inikwoyriti $f(x)+a\ge 0$ igare yakarurama paparutivi ${dom}$ kuri kupi? (nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Kuti $f(x)+a\ge0$ igare yakarurama, kukosha kwakaderera kwe$f(x)$ paparutivi iri kunofanira kuva $-a$ kana kupfuura.
Wana kukosha kwakaderera kwe$f(x)$ paparutivi nekuenzanisa kukosha kwakanyanya nekwakaderera nekukosha kwemagumo eparutivi.
ca1_ineqParam.explanation: Kukosha kwakaderera kwe$f(x)$ paparutivi iri ndi${mn}$. Kuti $f(x)+a\ge0$ igare yakarurama, $a\ge {mn2}$, saka kukosha kwakaderera kwe$a$ ndi${ans}$.

ca1_integralEq.prompt: Kana polynomial function $f(x)$ ichigutsa $f(x)={rhs}$ kune nhamba dzese dzechokwadi $x$, mutengo we $f({k})$ ndeupi? (Nyora nhamba chete)
hints: $\int_0^1 f(t)\,dt$ ikonsitanti isingatsamiri ku $x$. Kana ukaiisa $c$, unogona kutaura $f(x)$ nemukuwo we $c$.
Pinza $f(x)$ iyoyo mu $\int_0^1 f(t)\,dt=c$ kuti utsvage $c$.
ca1_integralEq.explanation: Kana $\int_0^1 f(t)\,dt=c$ (konsitanti), $f(x)$ inova quadratic ine $c$. Kubva pachirevo chekuti mutengo wayo wakabatanidzwa kubva ku $0$ kusvika ku $1$ wakaenzana ne $c$, $c={c}$, uye $f({k})={ans}$.

ca1_integralFuncExtremum.prompt: Kana $f(t)={f}$, mutengo mudiki wemuno webasa $G(x)=\int_{{s}}^{x}f(t)\,dt$ ndeupi? (Nyora sechikamu chisingaderedzwi. Kana iri nhamba yakazara, nyora nhamba yakazara. Muenzaniso: 3/4)
hints: Nekuti $G'(x)=f(x)$, kuwedzera nekudzikira kwe $G$ kunotarwa nechiratidzo che $f(x)$.
Mutengo mudiki wemuno uri pa $x$ apo chiratidzo che $f(x)$ chinochinja kubva pa $-$ kuenda ku $+$, uye mutengo wawo unoverengwa se $\int_{s}^{x}f(t)\,dt$.
ca1_integralFuncExtremum.explanation: Poindi apo chiratidzo che $G'(x)=f(x)$ chinochinja kubva pa $-$ kuenda ku $+$ ndi $x={z}$. Mutengo mudiki wemuno ndi $G({z})=\int_{{s}}^{{z}}f(t)\,dt={ansf}$.

ca1_integralFuncFind.prompt: Kana polynomial function $f(x)$ ichigutsa $\int_{{c}}^{x}f(t)\,dt={F}$ ($a$ ikonsitanti) kune nhamba dzese dzechokwadi $x$, mutengo we $f({k})$ ndeupi? (Nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Kana $x={c}$, integral iri kuruboshwe ndi $0$, saka unogona kutsvaga $a$.
Wobva wasiyanisa mativi ose maviri ne $x$ kuti uwane $f(x)$.
ca1_integralFuncFind.explanation: Kana $x={c}$, divi rekuruboshwe ndi $0$, saka $a={av}$. Kana mativi ose maviri akasiyaniswa, $f(x)={fx}$, saka $f({k})={ans}$.

ca1_integralLimit.prompt: Kune polynomial function $f(x)={f}$, mutengo we ${lim}$ ndeupi? (Nyora sechikamu chisingaderedzwi. Kana iri nhamba yakazara, nyora nhamba yakazara. Muenzaniso: 3/4)
hints: Denominator ne numerator zvose zvinosvika pedyo ne $0$. Edza kushandisa hukama pakati pe definite integral ne indefinite integral $\frac{d}{d x}\int_a^x f(t)\,dt=f(x)$.
Kana $F$ iri nayo $F'(x)=f(x)$, tora $\int_a^x f(t)\,dt=F(x)-F(a)$ uye inova chimiro chetsananguro ye derivative.
ca1_integralLimit.explanation: Kana $F$ ine $F'(x)=f(x)$ uye integral yanyorwa se $F(\text{muganhu wepamusoro})-F(\text{muganhu wepazasi})$, muganhu unova chimiro che derivative ye $F$, uye mutengo wawo ndi${step}={ansf}$.

ca1_ivtCount.prompt: Nhamba dzakazara $a$ dzinoita kuti equation ${fx}=0$ ive nemudzi wechokwadi muchikamu chakavhurika $({m},{n})$ ndedzingani? (Nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Basa iri rinowedzera muchikamu chose. Saka zviratidzo zvemitengo yebasa pamagumo maviri echikamu zvinofanira kusiyana.
Nyora mamiriro ekuti zviratidzo zve $f({m})$, $f({n})$ zvinopesana, kureva $f({m})f({n})<0$, seinequality ye $a$.
ca1_ivtCount.explanation: Nekuti $f(x)={fx}$ ine $f'(x)>0$ uye inowedzera, mamiriro anodiwa anokwana ekuva nemudzi wechokwadi muchikamu ndi $f({m})f({n})<0$. Nhamba dzakazara $a$ dzinogutsa izvi ndi ${alo}<a<{ahi}$, saka ndi${ans}$.

ca1_kinCoefFind.prompt: Nzvimbo yepoindi P inofamba pamutsetse wenhamba panguva $t$ ndi $x(t)={f}$ ($a$, $b$ ndedzekonsitanti). Kana kumhanho kwepoindi P panguva $t={p}$ kuri $0$ uye kumhanyisa kuri ${q}$, nzvimbo yepoindi P panguva $t={k}$ ndeipi? (Nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Kumhanho ndi $v(t)=x'(t)$, kumhanyisa ndi $a(t)=v'(t)$. Nyora mamiriro maviri seequations: $v({p})=0$, $a({p})={q}$.
Gadzirisa equations mbiri pamwe chete kuti utsvage $a$, $b$, wobva waverenga mutengo we $x({k})$.

ca1_limCoefPoly.prompt: Kune basa $f(x)={f}$ ($a$, $b$ ndedzekonsitanti), kana ${lim}={L}$, mutengo we $f(1)$ ndeupi? (Nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Nekuti muganhu uripo uye denominator inova $0$, numerator inofanira kuva $0$ pa $x={c}$.
Ipapo muganhu ndi${rel}$, saka shandisa kuti mutengo uyu ndi${L}$ nemamiriro e numerator kuita simultaneous equations ye $a$, $b$.
ca1_limCoefPoly.explanation: Numerator inofanira kuva $0$ pa $x={c}$, saka $f({c})={m0}$. Panguva iyi muganhu ndi${rel}$ uye mutengo uyu ndi${L}$, saka kugadzirisa equations mbiri kunopa $a={av}$, $b={bv}$ uye $f(1)={ans}$.

ca1_limCoefRational.prompt: Kana $\lim_{x\to {c}}\frac{{num}}{{den}}={L}$, kune makonsitanti $a$, $b$, mutengo we $a+b$ ndeupi? (Nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Kuti muganhu uripo pa $x={c}$ apo denominator inova $0$, numerator inofanira kuva $0$ pa $x={c}$.
Taura $b$ nemukuwo we $a$ kuti numerator ive ne chinhu chinowanzwa ${xc}$, wobva wanyora kuti muganhu wechirevo chakadzikiswa ndi${L}$.
ca1_limCoefRational.explanation: Nekuti muganhu uripo uye denominator iri $0$ pa $x={c}$, numerator inofanira kuva $0$ pa $x={c}$. Mushure mekudzikisa chinhu chakajairika che numerator ne denominator, kubva pamamiriro ekuti muganhu ndi${L}$, $a={av}$, $b={bv}$. Naizvozvo $a+b={ans}$.

ca1_limDerivForm.prompt: Kune basa rinogona kusiyaniswa $f(x)$, kana $f({a})={s}$, $f'({a})={t}$, mutengo we ${lim}$ ndeupi? (Nyora sechikamu chisingaderedzwi. Kana iri nhamba yakazara, nyora nhamba yakazara. Muenzaniso: 3/4)
hints: Wedzera nekubvisa, kana gadzira numerator, kuti chimiro $f(x)-f({a})$ (kana $f(a+h)-f(a)$) chioneke.
Tsananguro ye derivative ndi $\lim_{x\to {a}}\frac{f(x)-f({a})}{{xa}}=f'({a})$.
ca1_limDerivForm.explanation: Kana chimiro $f(x)-f({a})$ chagadzirwa mu numerator uye tsananguro ye derivative yashandiswa, nekuti $f({a})={s}$, $f'({a})={t}$, muganhu ndi${step}={ansf}$.

ca1_limExistence.prompt: Kune basa ${pw}$, kana mutengo we $\lim_{x\to {c}}f(x)$ uripo, mutengo wekonsitanti $a$ ndeupi? (Nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Kuti muganhu uripo, muganhu wekuruboshwe nowekurudyi kana $x\to {c}$ zvinofanira kuenzana.
Pinza mitengo iri pedyo ne $x={c}$ muchirevo che $x<{c}$ nechirevo che $x>{c}$ zvakasiyana, uye utaure miganhu miviri nemukuwo we $a$.
ca1_limExistence.explanation: Muganhu wekuruboshwe ndiwo mutengo wechirevo che $x<{c}$ kana $x\to {c}$, wekurudyi ndiwo mutengo wechirevo che $x>{c}$. Nekuti mitengo miviri inofanira kuenzana, $a={ans}$.

ca1_limInfRatio.prompt: Mutengo we $\lim_{x\to\infty}\frac{{num}}{{den}}$ ndeupi? (Nyora sechikamu chisingaderedzwi. Kana iri nhamba yakazara, nyora nhamba yakazara. Muenzaniso: 3/4)
hints: Tanga waenzanisa madhigirii emazwi akakwirira zvikuru e numerator ne denominator. Kana dhigirii re numerator riri pasi pere denominator, muganhu ndi $0$.
Edza kugovanisa denominator ne numerator nesimba rakakura re $x$.
ca1_limInfRatio.explanation: Kana $x\to\infty$, numerator inotarwa nechimiro ${nl}$ uye denominator ne ${dl}$, saka muganhu wakaenzana nemuganhu wechikamu chemazwi maviri $\frac{{nl}}{{dl}}$, uye mutengo wacho ndi${ansf}$.

ca1_limPiecewise.prompt: Kune basa ${pw}$, mutengo we {ask} ndeupi? (Nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Chirevo che $f$ chinoshanduka pa $x={k}$. Tanga wasarudza kuti mutengo uri mukati me $f$ unosvika pedyo ne ${k}$ uchibva kumativi madiki here kana makuru.
Tsvaga mutengo pa $x={k}$ muchirevo chedivi rakasarudzwa. Mutengo webasa pachawo $f({k})$ hauna chekuita nemuganhu.
ca1_limPiecewise.explanation: Muganhu kana $x\to {k}^{-}$ ndi${lv}$, uye muganhu kana $x\to {k}^{+}$ ndi${rv}$ (mutengo webasa pa $x={k}$ ndi${e}$ asi hauna chekuita nemuganhu). Kana tikaona kuti mutengo wemukati muchirevo chinotsvakwa unosvika pedyo ne ${k}$ uchibva kudivi ripi, wobva washandisa mitengo iyi zvakakodzera, mhinduro ndi${ans}$.

ca1_limRadical.prompt: Kukosha kwe$\lim_{x\to\infty}\left({expr}\right)$ kuri kupi? (unogona kunyora sedesimali kana sechikamu seka 3/4)
hints: Kana pane musiyano wemaikwesheni ane midzi, kana musiyano weikwesheni ine mudzi neyemutsetse, wanza nekugovanisa nekuwedzera (ikwesheni ine mudzi)+(chasara) kuti usunungure mudzi.
Mushure mekusunungura mudzi, govanisa nhamba yekuzasi neyekumusoro ne$x$ wobva wasiya $x\to\infty$.
ca1_limRadical.explanation: Kana nhamba yekumusoro ikasunungurwa mudzi, ikwesheni inoshanduka kuita chimiro che$\frac{{numr}}{{den2}}$. Kana nhamba yekuzasi neyekumusoro dzagoverwa ne$x$, yekumusoro inosvika pa${nc}$, yekuzasi pa${dc}$, saka kukosha kwelumiti ndi${ans}$.

ca1_maxMinFind.prompt: Pafunction $f(x)={f}$ ($a$ ikoronstanti), kana kukosha kwakanyanya paparutivi rakavharwa $[{s},{t}]$ kuri ${M}$, kukosha kwakaderera paparutivi iri kuri kupi? (nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Kukosha kwakanyanya nekwakaderera paparutivi rakavharwa kunowanikwa nekuenzanisa kukosha kwemukati neyemagumo maviri eparutivi.
Wana kukosha kwakanyanya uchichengeta $a$ kuti usarudze $a$, wobva wawana kukosha kwakaderera nenzira imwechete.
ca1_maxMinFind.explanation: Kana kukosha kwemukati kwaenzaniswa neyemagumo maviri, kukosha kwakanyanya ndi${mx0}+a$ uye ndiko ${M}$, saka $a={av}$. Kukosha kwakaderera ndi${mn0}+a={ans}$.

ca1_monoGiven.prompt: Function yechitatu $f(x)={f}$ ($a$, $b$ makoronstanti) inodzikira paparutivi rakavharwa $[{m},{n}]$, uye inokwira paparutivi mairi maviri $(-\infty,{m}]$, $[{n},\infty)$. Musiyano wekukosha kwakanyanya nekwakaderera kwe$f(x)$ paparutivi $[{m},{n}]$ ndewei? (nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Pazvisvitsa $x={m}$, $x={n}$ apo $f$ inoshanduka kubva pakukwira kuenda pakudzikira, uye kubva pakudzikira kuenda pakukwira, $f'(x)=0$.

$f'(x)$ ikwesheni yechipiri ine midzi $x={m}$, $x={n}$, saka inyore sa$f'(x)=($chiverengero chechikamu chechipiri$)\times{fm}{fn}$ kuti uwane $a$, $b$. Paparutivi rinodzikira, kukosha kwakanyanya nekwakaderera kunobva kumagumo api?
ca1_monoGiven.explanation: Pa$x={m}$, $x={n}$ apo kukwira nekudzikira zvinoshanduka, $f'(x)=0$, saka $f'(x)={d3}{fm}{fn}$. Kana zvichiverengero zvaenzaniswa, $a={av}$, $b={bv}$. Sezvo ichidzikira paparutivi, kukosha kwakanyanya ndi$f({m})={fmv}$, kwakaderera ndi$f({n})={fnv}$, uye musiyano wacho ndi${ans}$.

ca1_mvtBound.prompt: Function inogona kusiyaniswa $f(x)$ ine ${lo}\le f'(x)\le {hi}$ pane nhamba chaiyo dzose $x$ uye ${cond}$. Kukosha kwakanyanya kwe$f({b})$ kuri kupi? (nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Netiyorema yekukosha kwepakati, pane $c$ inoita kuti $f(b)-f(a)=f'(c)(b-a)$. Shandisa kukosha kwakanyanya kwe$f'(c)$.
Kana pane zvisvitsa zviviri zvinozikanwa, tanga nechiri padhuze nechisvitsa chaunotsvaga.
ca1_mvtBound.explanation: Chisvitsa chinozikanwa chiri padhuze ne$f({b})$ yatinotsvaga ndi$x={na}$ ($f({na})={nm}$) uye kusiyana ndi${gap}$. Netiyorema yekukosha kwepakati, $f({b})-({nm})=f'(c)\times{gap}\le {hi}\times{gap}$, saka $f({b})\le {ans}$. Kukosha uku kunowanikwa chaizvo nefunction ine mutero uri pa${hi}$ nguva dzose, saka kukosha kwakanyanya ndi${ans}$.

ca1_mvtC.prompt: Pafunction $f(x)={f}$, kukosha kwenhamba chaiyo $c$ ($c$ inopfuura ${a}$ uye iri pasi pe${b}$) inogutsa netiyorema yekukosha kwepakati paparutivi $[{a},{b}]$ kuri kupi? (nyora nhamba chete)
hints: $c$ yetiyorema yekukosha kwepakati inogutsa $\frac{f({b})-f({a})}{{b}-({a})}=f'(c)$.
Tanga wawana mwero wepakati weshanduko, wobva wasarudza pamhinduro dze$f'(c)=($mwero wepakati weshanduko$)$ iri mukati meparutivi risina magumo.
ca1_mvtC.explanation: Mwero wepakati weshanduko ndi$\frac{f({b})-f({a})}{{b}-({a})}={sl}$, uye mhinduro ye$f'(c)={sl}$ paparutivi $({a},{b})$ ndi$c={ans}$ chete.

ca1_noExtremum.prompt: Pafunction yechitatu $f(x)={f}$, nhamba dzakazara $a$ dzinoita kuti $f$ isave nekukosha kwakanyanya kana kwakaderera dzakawanda sei? (nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Function yechitatu isina kukosha kwakanyanya kana kwakaderera zvinoreva kuti chiratidzo che$f'(x)$ hachishanduki.
Nyora dhisikiminanti $D\le 0$ yeikwesheni yechipiri $f'(x)=0$ seinikwoyriti ye$a$ wobva waverenga mhinduro dzakazara.
ca1_noExtremum.explanation: Sezvo $f'(x)$ ichifanira kusashandura chiratidzo, dhisikiminanti ye$f'(x)=0$ ndi$D\le 0$. Nhamba dzakazara $a$ dzinogutsa izvi ndedzi${lo}\le a\le {hi}$, saka ndidzo ${ans}$.

ca1_optimBox.prompt: Kubva pamakona mana ebepa rakaita segonhi rine hupamhi ${W}$ cm nehurefu ${H}$ cm, tsinga zvikwere zvakaenzana, wobva wapeta chasara kuti uite bhokisi rine chimiro checuboid risina chivharo. Huwandu hwakanyanya hwebhokisi huri mangani cm³? (Nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Rega kureba kweparutivi rumwe rwechikwere chinotemwa ku $x$, uye taura huwandu hwebhokisi semusiyano $V(x)$ we $x$.
Huwandu hwakanyanya hunowanikwa pamutengo wemidzi ye $V'(x)=0$ iri muchikamu $0<x<(\text{divi pfupi})\div 2$.
ca1_optimBox.explanation: Kana kureba kweparutivi rumwe rwechikwere chinotemwa kuri $x$ cm, $V(x)=x({W}-2x)({H}-2x)$ ($0<x<{hh}$), uye kugadzirisa $V'(x)=0$ kunopa kumusoro kwakanyanya pa $x={x}$ apo kuwedzera kunoshanduka kuita kudzika. Huwandu hwakanyanya ndi${ans}$ cm³.

ca1_optimProfit.prompt: Kana chigadzirwa chikaitwa $x$ mayuniti pazuva ($0\le x\le {X}$) uye zvose zvikatengeswa, mutengo wese ndi $C(x)={cost}$ (zviuru gumi zvewon), uye mutengo wekutengesa paunit imwe ndi${price}$ zviuru gumi zvewon. Purofiti yakanyanya yezuva (mari yakatengeswa kubvisa mutengo wese) ndiyo yakawanda sei muzviuru gumi zvewon? (Nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Rega purofiti $P(x)={price}x-C(x)$ uye ugadzirise $P'(x)=0$.
Enzanisa mutengo une $x$ yakanyanya pamwe nemitengo pamagumo maviri echikamu $x=0$, $x={X}$.
ca1_optimProfit.explanation: $P(x)={price}x-C(x)$ uye kubva ku $P'(x)=0$ poindi yakanyanya yemukati mechikamu ndi $x={xs}$. Papoindi iyi nemapoindi emagumo, $P({xs})={ans}$, $P(0)={p0}$, $P({X})={pX}$, saka mutengo wakanyanya ndi${ans}$ zviuru gumi zvewon.

ca1_powerFindN.prompt: Kune nhamba yechisikigo $n$, $f(x)={f}$. Kana $f'({a})={V}$, mutengo we $n$ ndeupi? (Nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Derivative ye $x^n$ ndi $nx^{n-1}$.
Taura $f'(x)$ semusiyano we $n$, wobva wafunga kuti mutengo unoshanduka sei $n$ ichikura.
ca1_powerFindN.explanation: $f'(x)={cc}\cdot n\cdot x^{n-1}-{kk}$, saka $f'({a})={cc}\cdot n\cdot{a}^{n-1}-{kk}$. Mutengo uyu unokura sezvo $n$ ichikura, saka kune nhamba imwe chete $n$ inopa mutengo ${V}$, uye $n={ans}$.

ca1_powerTangentN.prompt: Pamutsetse wakakombama $y={fx}$ ($n$ inhamba yechisikigo isingapfuri $2$), kana $y$-intercept yemutsetse unobata pakakombama papoindi ine $x$-coordinate ${a}$ iri ${V}$, mutengo we $n$ ndeupi? (Nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Derivative ye $x^n$ ndi $nx^{n-1}$, saka slope yemutsetse unobata inogona kutaurwa semusiyano we $n$.
Kana $y$-intercept yemutsetse unobata ikatauriwa se $n$, mutengo wayo wakakwana unokura sezvo $n$ ichikura.
ca1_powerTangentN.explanation: Kubva ku $f(x)={fx}$, $f'(x)={cc}nx^{n-1}$, saka $y$-intercept yemutsetse unobata ndi $f({a})-{a}f'({a})=(1-n)\cdot{ccp}\cdot{a}^n$. Mutengo wayo wakakwana unokura sezvo $n$ ichikura, saka kune $n$ imwe chete inopa ${V}$, uye $n={ans}$.

ca1_prodAbstract.prompt: Kune mabasa maviri anogona kusiyaniswa $f(x)$, $g(x)$, $f({a})={s}$, $f'({a})={t}$, $g({a})={u}$, $g'({a})={w}$. Kana $h(x)={hx}$, mutengo we $h'({a})$ ndeupi? (Nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Mutemo wechibereko: $\{f(x)g(x)\}'=f'(x)g(x)+f(x)g'(x)$.
Kana chibereko chine zvinhu zvitatu kana kupfuura, wedzera mazwi apo chinhu chimwe chete chinosiyaniswa panguva.

ca1_returnTime.prompt: Poindi P inofamba pamutsetse wenhamba inobva pa origin panguva $t=0$, uye kumhanho kwayo panguva $t$ ($t\ge0$) ndiko $v(t)={v}$. Kumhanho kwepoindi P panguva yainodzoka kwekutanga kuorigin mushure mekubva? (Nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Nzvimbo ndiyo antiderivative yekumhanho, uye nekuti nzvimbo yekutanga ndi $0$, $x(t)=\int_0^t v(s)\,ds$.
Tsvaga mutengo mudiki we $t$ yakanaka inogutsa $x(t)=0$ wobva wapinza mu $v(t)$.
ca1_returnTime.explanation: $x(t)=\int_0^t v(s)\,ds={xt}$ uye $t$ dzakanaka dzine $x(t)=0$ ndi${rs}$. Pamutengo mudiki $t={t0}$, $v({t0})={ans}$.

ca1_rootCountK.prompt: Pafunction $f(x)={f}$, nhamba yenhamba dzakazara $k$ dzinoita kuti ikwesheni $f(x)=k$ ive nemidzi chaiyo yakasiyana ${nr}$ chaizvo ndeyei? (nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Fungidzira nhamba yematsangano egirafu ye$y=f(x)$ nemutsetse wakati sandara $y=k$.
Wana kukosha kukuru nekudiki kwemuno, wobva wasarudza huwandu hwe$k$ hunoita kuti pave nematsangano ${nr}$.
ca1_rootCountK.explanation: Kana kukosha kwakanyanya kuwanikwa kubva pa$f'(x)=0$ ndi ${ext}$. Kuti pave nemidzi chaiyo yakasiyana ${nr}$, zvinofanira kuva ${rng}$, saka nhamba dzakazara $k$ ndi ${ans}$.

ca1_tangentFromPoint.prompt: Chigadzirwa chemiteremo yemitsetse miviri inobata kakona $y={f}$ ichibva pachisvitsa $({p},{q})$ chiri chipi? (nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Kana $x$ yechisvitsa chekubata iri $t$, mutsetse unobata ndi$y=f'(t)(x-t)+f(t)$, uye mutsetse uyu unofanira kupa $y={q}$ pa$x={p}$.
Kubva pamamiriro aya wana ikwesheni yechipiri ye$t$, wana midzi miviri, wobva waverenga miteremo $f'(t)$.
ca1_tangentFromPoint.explanation: Kana $x$ yechisvitsa chekubata iri $t$, mamiriro ekuti mutsetse unobata upe $y={q}$ pa$x={p}$ anopa ikwesheni yechipiri ine midzi $t={t1}, {t2}$. Miteremo ndi$f'({t1})$ ne$f'({t2})$, uye chigadzirwa chavo ndi ${ans}$.

ca1_tangentIntercept.prompt: Mutsetse unobata kakona $y={f}$ pachisvitsa chine $x$ ye${a}$ unosangana ne$y$-axis pachisvitsa chine $y$ ipi? (nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Mutsetse wekubata une mutero wakaenzana ne$f'({a})$ pachisvitsa chekubata.
Muikwesheni yemutsetse unobata $y-f({a})=f'({a})\{x-({a})\}$, wana kukosha kwe$y$ kana $x=0$.

ca1_tangentIntersect.prompt: Mutsetse unobata kakona $y={f}$ pachisvitsa chine $x$ ye${a}$ unosangana nekakona kakawedzera kamwe pachisvitsa chisiri chekubata. $y$ yechisvitsa ichocho ndeipi? (nyora nhamba chete)
hints: $x$ yezvisvitsa zvekusangana kwemutsetse unobata nekakona ndiyo midzi ye(ikwesheni yekakona)−(ikwesheni yemutsetse)$=0$, uye ikwesheni iyi ine mudzi wakapetwa pa$x={a}$.
Huwandu hwemidzi mitatu yeikwesheni yechitatu hunowanikwa kubva pachiverengero che$x^2$, saka wana mudzi wasara wobva waiisa muikwesheni yekakona.
ca1_tangentIntersect.explanation: (kakona)−(mutsetse)$=0$ ikwesheni yechitatu ine mudzi wakapetwa pa$x={a}$, uye huwandu hwemidzi mitatu hunosarudzwa nehukama hwemidzi nezvichiverengero. Mudzi wasara ndi$x={s}$, uye kana wasanganiswa muikwesheni yekakona, $y$ ndi ${ans}$.

ca1_tangentSlopeTwo.prompt: Pane mitsetse miviri inobata kakona $y={f}$ une mutero ${m}$. Huwandu hwezvikamu zve$y$ zvemitsetse miviri iyi ndehwei? (nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Kana mutero uri ${m}$, $x$ yechisvitsa chekubata ndiyo mhinduro ye$f'(x)={m}$.
Pachisvitsa chimwe nechimwe chekubata $(s, f(s))$, chikamu che$y$ ndi$f(s)-s\cdot{m}$.
ca1_tangentSlopeTwo.explanation: Kana ikwesheni $f'(x)={m}$ yagadziriswa, $x$ dzezvisvitsa zvekubata ndi ${s1}$, ${s2}$. Kana zvikamu zve$y$ zvemutsetse mumwe nemumwe zvawanikwa zvikawedzerwa, zvinoita ${ans}$.

ca1_throwImpact.prompt: Bhora rakakandirwa kumusoro richibva panzvimbo ine kukwirira kwe${h0}$ m pamusoro penyika, uye mushure me$t$ masekondi kukwirira kwebhora kwaiva $h(t)={h}$ (m). Kumhanya kwebhora panguva rinoramba richisvika pasi kuri kwema m/s mangani? (nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Nguva yekusvika pasi ndiyo kukosha kwakanaka kwe$t$ apo $h(t)=0$. Kumhanya kune mutero $h'(t)$.
Gadzirisa $h(t)=0$ kuti uwane mudzi wakanaka, wobva waverenga kukosha kusina chiratidzo kwekumhanya panguva iyoyo.
ca1_throwImpact.explanation: Mudzi wakanaka we$h(t)=0$ ndi$t={T}$ masekondi, uye $h'(t)={v0}-10t$, saka $h'({T})={vv}$. Kumhanya ndiko kukosha kusina chiratidzo kwemutero, saka ndi ${ans}$ m/s.

ca1_totalDistPos.prompt: Nzvimbo yechisvitsa P chinofamba pamutsetse wenhamba panguva $t$ ($t\ge0$) ndi$x(t)={f}$. Kureba kwakafambwa nechisvitsa P kubva panguva $t=0$ kusvika $t={T}$ ndekupi? (nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Kureba kwakafambwa hakusi shanduko yenzvimbo, asi huwandu hwekureba kwenzira dzimwe nedzimwe dzakakamurwa panguva dzinoshandurwa nemutsara.
Tanga wacheka kuti nguva dzine $v(t)=x'(t)=0$ dziri mukati meparutivi $(0,{T})$ here.
ca1_totalDistPos.explanation: Kana nguva dzine $v(t)=x'(t)=0$ dzawanikwa, nguva dzinoshandura mutsara muparutivi ndi ${turns}$. Kana paparutivi pakakamurwa panguva idzi, kukosha kusina chiratidzo kweshanduko yenzvimbo kwawedzerwa, kureba kwakafambwa ndi ${ans}$.

ca1_totalDistVel.prompt: Kumhanho kwepoindi P inofamba pamutsetse wenhamba panguva $t$ ($t\ge0$) ndiko $v(t)={v}$. Ndeipi nhambwe yakafambwa nepoindi P kubva panguva $t=0$ kusvika $t={T}$? (Nyora sechikamu chisingaderedzwi. Kana iri nhamba yakazara, nyora nhamba yakazara. Muenzaniso: 3/4)
hints: Nhambwe yakafambwa ndiyo kubatanidza kwekumhanya $|v(t)|$.
Kanganisa chikamu pamaguru apo $v(t)=0$, wobva wabatanidza zvichienderana nechiratidzo.
ca1_totalDistVel.explanation: Panguva iri mukati mechikamu apo chiratidzo chekumhanho chinoshanduka ndi${zs}$. Kana chikamu chikakanganiswa pamaguru aya, chiratidzo chinogara chakadaro muchikamu chimwe nechimwe, saka toshandisa mutengo wakakwana we $\int v(t)\,dt$ wobva wabatanidza, ${parts}={ansf}$.

ca1_twoRootsK.prompt: Pamusiyano $f(x)={f}$, ndeipi muwayo wemitengo yese yechokwadi $k$ inoita kuti equation $f(x)=k$ ive nemidzi yechokwadi yakasiyana yakazara chaizvo ${nr}$? (Nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Funga nezvemuganhu apo huwandu hwemidzi yechokwadi yakasiyana huchishanduka, kureva apo mutsetse wakatsetseka $y=k$ unobata graph pamutengo wakanyanya kana wakapfuura.
Sarudza kubva pachimiro chegraph kuti ndeipi pamitengo yakanyanya inoita kuti pave nemidzi ${nr}$ chaizvo.
ca1_twoRootsK.explanation: Mitengo yakanyanya ndi${ext}$. Kana tikaverenga huwandu hwemapoindi ekusangana kana mutsetse wakatsetseka unobata graph pamutengo wakanyanya uye kana usingabati, $k$ inoenderana nemamiriro ndi${kk}$, uye muwayo ndi${ans}$.

ca1_velZeroAccel.prompt: Kana nzvimbo yepoindi P inofamba pamutsetse wenhamba panguva $t$ ($t\ge0$) iri $x(t)={f}$, ndeipi kumhanyisa panguva yekupedzisira pane nguva mbiri apo kumhanho kwepoindi P kuri $0$? (Nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Kumhanho ndiko kusiyanisa kwenzvimbo ne $t$, $v(t)=x'(t)$, uye kumhanyisa ndiko kusiyanisa kwekumhanho, $a(t)=v'(t)$.
Tsvaga midzi miviri ye $v(t)=0$, wobva wapinza mudzi wekupedzisira mu $a(t)$.
ca1_velZeroAccel.explanation: $v(t)=x'(t)$ uye midzi miviri ye $v(t)=0$ ndi $t={t1}$ ne $t={t2}$. Mutengo we $a(t)=v'(t)$ panguva yekupedzisira $t={t2}$ ndi${ans}$.

ca2_addTheorem.prompt: Kana ${ga}$, ${gb}$ uye ${ra}$, ${rb}$, tsvaga mutengo we ${ask}$. (Nyora sechikamu chisingaderedzwi. Kana iri nhamba yakazara, nyora nhamba yakazara. Muenzaniso: 3/4)
hints: Shandisa mitengo yakapihwa ne $\sin^{2}\theta+\cos^{2}\theta=1$ kuwana mamwe mitengo yetrigonometry anodiwa. Chiratidzo chinotarwa nekota yaunowira kona.
Pinza mitengo yawawana mu theorem yekuwedzera.

ca2_areaCurves.prompt: Rega $S$ ive nzvimbo yakakomberedzwa nemagraph maviri $y={f}$, $y={g}$ nemitsetse miviri $x={a}$, $x={b}$. Tsvaga mutengo we ${ask}$. (Nyorera: axis ye $x$ ndi $y=0$.) (Nyora sechikamu chisingaderedzwi. Kana iri nhamba yakazara, nyora nhamba yakazara. Muenzaniso: 3/4)
hints: Batanidza equation yegraph iri pamusoro kubvisa equation yegraph iri pazasi muchikamu.

Shandisa $(\tan x)'=\frac{1}{\cos^{2}x}$ ne $(\ln x)'=\frac{1}{x}$ kutsvaga antiderivative yemisiyano ye exponential, trigonometry nerational, uye shandisa kuchinjira kwevariable kana ichiri yakabatanidzwa.
ca2_areaCurves.explanation: Muchikamu $[{a},{b}]$, $y={f}$ iri pamusoro, saka $S=\int_{{a}}^{{b}}({f}-{gg})\,dx={wk}$. Naizvozvo mutengo we ${ask}$ ndi${res}$.

ca2_ballDistance.prompt: Bhora rinodonhedzwa kubva pakukwirira kwe ${h}$ m. Nguva dzose rinozosvika pasi, rinomhanya kudzokera kukukwirira kwe ${ratio}$ kakawanda kwekukwirira kwaakadonha, wobva wadonha zvakare, uye izvi zvinodzokororwa nekusingaperi. Nhambwe yese yakafambwa nebhora ingani m? (Nyora sechikamu chisingaderedzwi. Kana iri nhamba yakazara, nyora nhamba yakazara. Muenzaniso: 3/4)
hints: Fungawo nhambwe yekutanga yekudonha ${h}$ m, nenhambwe yega yega inotevera yekukwira nekudzika (kakapetwa kaviri kukwirira kwekukwira).
Kukwirira kwekukwira kunoita kuteedzana kwegeometric ine chikamu chekutanga (kukwirira kwekutanga)×(chikamu chekudzoka).
ca2_ballDistance.explanation: Muwayo wekukwirira kwekukwira ndi${up}$ m, nhambwe yekukwira nekudzika ndiyo kakapetwa kaviri, saka nhambwe yese ndi ${h}+2\times {up}={res}$ m.

ca2_ballReverse.prompt: Bhora rakarasiwa kubva pakukwirira kwakati, uye pese paridonha pasi rinotsvedza richikwira kusvika pakukwirira kunoita ${ratio}$ kakawanda kwekukwirira kwakapfuura, richidonha zvakare, zvichitevera zvisingaperi. Kana kukwirira kwekutsvedza kwechi${nb}$ kuri ${H}$ m, huwandu hwose hwenzira yakafambwa nebhora ndi m mangani? (Nyora sechikamu chisingaderedzwi. Kana iri nhamba yakazara, nyora sanhamba yakazara. Muenzaniso: 3/4)
hints: Kana kukwirira kwekutanga ari $h$ m, kutsvedza kwega kwega kunoita ${ratio}$ kakawanda kwekukwirira kwapfuura, saka kukwirira kwekutsvedza kwechi$n$ ndi$h\times \left({ratio}\right)^{n}$.
Tanga wawana $h$, wobva wawana nzira yose seyakaverengwa nekudonha kwekutanga $h$ pamwe nenzira yekukwira nekudonha (kaviri kwekukwirira kwekukwira).
ca2_ballReverse.explanation: Kana kukwirira kwekutanga ari $h$ m, ${H}=h\times \left({ratio}\right)^{{nb}}$, saka $h={h}$. Huwandu hwekukwirira kwekukwira ndi${up}$ m, saka nzira yose ndi${h}+2\times {up}={res}$ m.

ca2_chainTable.prompt: Kune ma differentiable functions maviri $f$, $g$, ${tbl}$ . Kana $h(x)={hx}$, wana kukosha kwe$h'({a})$ . (Unogona kunyora sedhesimali kana sechikamu se3/4)
hints: Tarisa kuti $h$ ichigadzirwa, quotient kana composition, wobva washandisa fomula yemutemo wakakodzera we derivative.
Tsvaga kukosha kwe function nederivative zvinodiwa pa$x={a}$ patafura uzviise. Kana ari composite function, kukosha kwe inner function ndiyo poinzi inoiswa mu outer function.

ca2_commonTangent.prompt: Macurve maviri $y={f}$, $y={g}$ anosangana papoinzi ye$x={x0}$, uye ane tangent imwe chete papoinzi iyoyo. Kune ma constants $a$, $b$, wana kukosha kwe$ab$ . (Nyora nhamba chete.)
hints: Kana macurve maviri anosangana pa$x={x0}$, kukosha kwe function kwakaenzana, uye kana tangent yakafanana, derivative yakaenzana.
Gadzirisa equations mbiri dza$a$, $b$ pamwe chete kuti uwane $a$, $b$.
ca2_commonTangent.explanation: $y={f}$ pa$x={x0}$ ine kukosha kwe function ${F}$ uye derivative ${D}$, saka ${wk}$ . Nokudaro $ab={ans}$ .

ca2_derivExpLog.prompt: Pa function $f(x)={fx}$, wana kukosha kwe$f'({x0})$ . (Nyora sechikamu chisingaderedzwi. Kana iri nhamba yakazara, nyora sanhamba yakazara. Muenzaniso: 3/4)
hints: Shandisa $(e^{x})'=e^{x}$, $(\ln x)'=\frac{1}{x}$ nemutemo wa chain kuti utanga wawana $f'(x)$.
Kana kukosha kunoiswa kuri muchimiro che$\ln m$, shandisa $e^{\ln m}=m$.

ca2_doubleAngle.prompt: Kana ${cd}$ , wana kukosha kwe${ask}$ . (Nyora sechikamu chisingaderedzwi. Kana iri nhamba yakazara, nyora sanhamba yakazara. Muenzaniso: 3/4)
hints: Shandisa $\sin2\alpha=2\sin\alpha\cos\alpha$, $\cos2\alpha=\cos^{2}\alpha-\sin^{2}\alpha$ ne$\sin^{2}\alpha+\cos^{2}\alpha=1$.

Kana $\sin\alpha\pm\cos\alpha$ yapiwa, ita square mativi ose. Kana $\tan\alpha=t$, $\sin2\alpha=\frac{2t}{1+t^{2}}$, $\cos2\alpha=\frac{1-t^{2}}{1+t^{2}}$, uye kana $\tan\frac{\alpha}{2}=t$, $\sin\alpha=\frac{2t}{1+t^{2}}$, $\cos\alpha=\frac{1-t^{2}}{1+t^{2}}$.

ca2_eExponent.prompt: Kana $\lim_{{to}}{ex}=e^{k}$, wana kukosha kwe$k$ . (Unogona kunyora sedhesimali kana sechikamu se3/4)
hints: Ita kuti ive muchimiro che$\lim_{h\to0}(1+h)^{\frac{1}{h}}=e$.
Govanisa uye vhiya exponent kuti $h$ yeibase ne exponent zvive reciprocals.

ca2_expLogLimit.prompt: Tsvaga mutengo wemuganhu unotevera. $\lim_{{to}}{ex}$ (Nyora sechikamu chisingaderedzwi. Kana iri nhamba yakazara, nyora nhamba yakazara. Muenzaniso: 3/4)
hints: Chinja chirevo kuti ugone kushandisa $\lim_{x\to0}\frac{e^{x}-1}{x}=1$ ne $\lim_{x\to0}\frac{\ln(1+x)}{x}=1$.
Wanza uye ugovanise kuti coefficients zvienderane, kuti chimiro chimwechete chiwanikwe mu denominator ne numerator.
ca2_expLogLimit.explanation: Kana chirevo chachinjwa kuti ushandise miganhu yakakosha, ${wk}$, saka mutengo wemuganhu ndi${res}$.

ca2_extremaPair.prompt: Basa $f(x)={fx}$ rine mutengo mukuru wemuno nemutengo mudiki wemuno kamwe chete rimwe nerimwe. Kana pane mutengo mukuru wemuno pa $x=\alpha$ uye mutengo mudiki wemuno pa $x=\beta$, tsvaga mutengo we $\alpha-\beta$. (Nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Tsvaga $x$ umo $f'(x)=0$, wobva waona kuti chiratidzo che $f'(x)$ chinoshanduka sei pamberi nepashure payo.
Kana chiratidzo che $f'(x)$ chichibva pakanaka kuenda pakashata, ndiyo mutengo mukuru wemuno; kana chichibva pakashata kuenda pakanaka, ndiyo mutengo mudiki wemuno.
ca2_extremaPair.explanation: Nekuti $f'(x)={fp}$, pane mutengo mukuru wemuno pa $x={mx}$ uye mutengo mudiki wemuno pa $x={mn}$. Naizvozvo $\alpha-\beta=({mx})-({mn})={ans}$.

ca2_geoConvCount.prompt: Tsvaga muwayo wenhamba dzese dzakazara $x$ dzinoita kuti zvinotevera zvibatanidzwe. ${obj}$ (Nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Kuteedzana $\{r^{n}\}$ kunobatana kana $-1<r\le 1$, uye infinite geometric series $\sum_{n=1}^{\infty}r^{n}$ inobatana kana $-1<r<1$.
Nyora mamiriro ekubatana seinequality ye $x$, wobva watsvaga nhamba dzese dzakazara dzinoigutsa uchiwedzera.
ca2_geoConvCount.explanation: Kubva pamamiriro ekubatana, ${rg}$. Nhamba dzakazara $x$ dzinoigutsa ndi${lst}$, saka muwayo wadzo ndi${ans}$.

ca2_geoSeriesParam.prompt: Kana infinite series $\sum_{n=1}^{\infty}{term}$ inobatana uye muwayo wayo uri ${S}$, tsvaga mutengo wekonsitanti $r$. (Nyora sechikamu chisingaderedzwi. Kana iri nhamba yakazara, nyora nhamba yakazara. Muenzaniso: 3/4)
hints: Muwayo we infinite geometric series ndi (izwi rekutanga)÷(1-chikamu chakafanana).
Tanga watsvaga izwi rekutanga nechikamu chakafanana kubva muizwi rakajairika reseries.
ca2_geoSeriesParam.explanation: Izwi rekutanga ${fa}$, chikamu chakafanana ${ratio}$, saka muwayo ndi${sumf}={S}$. Kugadzirisa kunopa $r={res}$.

ca2_implicitDeriv.prompt: Kana $y$ iri basa re $x$, tsvaga mutengo we ${what}$ papoindi $ {pt} $ pakakombama ${eq}$. (Nyora sechikamu chisingaderedzwi. Kana iri nhamba yakazara, nyora nhamba yakazara. Muenzaniso: 3/4)
hints: Siyanisa mativi ose maviri echirevo ne $x$, uchiwanza mazwi ane $y$ ne $\frac{ dy }{ dx }$.
Pinza makomedheniti epoindi muchirevo chakasiyaniswa uye ugadzirise $\frac{ dy }{ dx }$. Kana iri second derivative, siyanisa chirevo chakasiyaniswa ne $x$ zvakare.
ca2_implicitDeriv.explanation: Kana mativi ose maviri akasiyaniswa ne $x$ uye $y'=\frac{ dy }{ dx }$, ${wk}$, saka mutengo ndi${res}$.

ca2_integralBasic.prompt: Kana $I=\int_{{lo}}^{{hi}}\left({fx}\right)dx$, tsvaga mutengo we ${ask}$. (Nyora sechikamu chisingaderedzwi. Kana iri nhamba yakazara, nyora nhamba yakazara. Muenzaniso: 3/4)
hints: Shandisa $\int e^{x}dx=e^{x}$, $\int\sin x\,dx=-\cos x$, $\int\cos x\,dx=\sin x$, $\int\frac{1}{x}dx=\ln|x|$, $\int\frac{1}{\cos^{2}x}dx=\tan x$.
Chenjerera kuti $\int f(kx)\,dx=\frac{1}{k}F(kx)$, wobva wapinza miganhu yepamusoro neyepazasi wobvisa.

ca2_inverseDeriv.prompt: Kana basa $f(x)={fx}$ rinowedzera pane seti yenhamba dzese dzechokwadi, uye $g(x)$ ndiro basa rayo rinopesana, tsvaga mutengo we $g'({b})$. (Nyora sechikamu chisingaderedzwi. Kana iri nhamba yakazara, nyora nhamba yakazara. Muenzaniso: 3/4)
hints: Tanga watsvaga $a$ inogutsa $f(a)={b}$.
Mutemo wekusiyanisa basa rinopesana: $g'({b})=\frac{1}{f'(a)}$.

ca2_limitPair.prompt: Pakoronstanti $a$, $b$, kana ${eq}$, tsvaga kukosha kwe$ab$. (nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Kana lumiti iripo asi nhamba yekuzasi ichiita $0$ pakulumiti, nhamba yekumusoro inofanira kuitawo $0$. Shandisa mamiriro aya kutanga kuwana hukama pakati pe$a$ ne$b$.

Mushure mekuisa hukama uhwu, gadzira nhamba yekumusoro, kana svunungura mudzi, kana shandura kuita $1-\cos x=\frac{\sin^{2}x}{1+\cos x}$ kuti uwane lumiti, wobva waiita yakaenzana nekukosha kwakapiwa.

ca2_lineAngle.prompt: Kana kona yakapinza inoumbwa nemitsetse miviri $ {l1} $, $ {l2} $ iri $\theta$, tsvaga kukosha kwe$\tan\theta$. (nyora sechikamu chakapfupikiswa. Kana inhamba yakazara, nyora senhamba yakazara. Muenzaniso: 3/4)
hints: Kona $\alpha$ inoumbwa nemutsetse une mutero $m$ nemutsara wakanaka we$x$-axis inogutsa $\tan\alpha=m$. Kana ukashandura ikwesheni kuita chimiro che$y=mx+k$, unoziva mutero.
Shandisa tiyorema yekuwedzera yetangenti pamusiyano wemakona maviri, uye tora kukosha kwakanaka nekuti ikona yakapinza.

ca2_monotoneParam.prompt: Wana huwandu hwenhamba dzakazara $a$ dzinoita kuti function $f(x)={fx}$ ikwire pamusoro peseti yenhamba chaiyo dzose. (Kana $f'(x)\ge 0$ pa$x$ dzose chaiyo, inonzi inokwira.) (nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Kuti function inogona kusiyaniswa ikwire pamusoro penhamba chaiyo dzose, $f'(x)\ge0$ inofanira kuvapo pa$x$ dzose.
Wana huwandu hwe$a$ hunoita kuti kukosha kwakaderera kwe$f'(x)$ (kana dhisikiminanti) kuve $0$ kana kupfuura, wobva waverenga nhamba dzakazara.
ca2_monotoneParam.explanation: ${wk}$. Saka nhamba dzakazara $a$ dzinogutsa mamiriro ndi${lst}$, uye dzose ndi${ans}$.

ca2_motionReverse.prompt: Nzvimbo yechisvitsa P chinofamba pamutsetse wenhamba panguva $t$ ($t>0$) ndi$x(t)={xt}$. Tsvaga kumhanyisa panguva apo kumhanya kwechisvitsa P kunotanga kuva $0$. (nyora sechikamu chakapfupikiswa. Kana inhamba yakazara, nyora senhamba yakazara. Muenzaniso: 3/4)
hints: Kumhanya ndiyo dhirivhativhi yenzvimbo ye$t$, $v(t)=x'(t)$, uye kumhanyisa ndi$a(t)=v'(t)$.
Wana $t$ diki yakanaka inogutsa $v(t)=0$ wobva waiisa muna $a(t)$.
ca2_motionReverse.explanation: ${wk}$, saka kumhanyisa panguva apo kumhanya kunotanga kuva $0$ ndi${res}$.

ca2_quotientDeriv.prompt: Kune basa $f(x)={fx}$, tsvaga mutengo we $f'({x0})$. (Nyora sechikamu chisingaderedzwi. Kana iri nhamba yakazara, nyora nhamba yakazara. Muenzaniso: 3/4)

ca2_riemann.prompt: Kana $L=\lim_{n\to\infty}{pre}\sum_{k=1}^{n}{body}$, tsvaga mutengo we ${ask}$. (Nyora sechikamu chisingaderedzwi. Kana iri nhamba yakazara, nyora nhamba yakazara. Muenzaniso: 3/4)

Kana mitengo yakanyanya ine $e$, yera se $2.7<e<2.8$ wobva waverenga nhamba dzakazara mukati mehuwandu.
ca2_rootCountParam.explanation: Nekuti ${fpx}$, mitengo yakanyanya ndi${ext}$, uye kuti pave nemapoindi ekusangana ${nr}$, ${rg}$. Nhamba dzakazara $k$ munzvimbo iyi ndi${lst}$, saka pane ${ans}$.

ca2_seqGeoLimit.prompt: Tsvaga mutengo wemuganhu wekuteedzana kunotevera. $\lim_{n\to\infty}{ex}$ (Nyora sechikamu chisingaderedzwi. Kana iri nhamba yakazara, nyora nhamba yakazara. Muenzaniso: 3/4)

Kana ukagovanisa numerator ne denominator nesimba iri, mazwi ane mutengo wakakwana webase mudiki anoenda ku $0$.
ca2_seqGeoLimit.explanation: Kana numerator ne denominator zvikagovaniswa neizwi rine mutengo wakakwana webase mukuru ${dom}$, mazwi akasara anoenda ku $0$ uye chinosara ndiyo coefficients chete, ${wk}$. Naizvozvo mutengo wemuganhu ndi${res}$.

ca2_seqLimit.prompt: Tsvaga mutengo wemuganhu wekuteedzana kunotevera. $\lim_{n\to\infty}{ex}$ (Nyora sechikamu chisingaderedzwi. Kana iri nhamba yakazara, nyora nhamba yakazara. Muenzaniso: 3/4)
hints: Govanisa numerator ne denominator neizwi rakakwirira zvikuru re denominator, kana kuti kana pane ruzi, rationalize kutanga.
Kana $n\to\infty$, mazwi akaita se $\frac{1}{n}$, $\frac{1}{n^{2}}$ anoenda ku $0$.
ca2_seqLimit.explanation: Kana chirevo chakurongwa, ${wk}$, saka mutengo wemuganhu ndi${res}$.

ca2_seqSumLimit.prompt: Wana kukosha kwe limit inotevera. $\lim_{n\to\infty}{ex}$ (Nyora sechikamu chisingaderedzwi. Kana iri nhamba yakazara, nyora sanhamba yakazara. Muenzaniso: 3/4)
hints: Shandisa $\sum_{k=1}^{n}k=\frac{n(n+1)}{2}$, $\sum_{k=1}^{n}k^{2}=\frac{n(n+1)(2n+1)}{6}$, $\sum_{k=1}^{n}k^{3}=\left\{\frac{n(n+1)}{2}\right\}^{2}$ kunyora huwandu se polynomial ye$n$.
Kana $n\to\infty$, tenzanisa chete ma coefficient emazwi ane degree yepamusoro mu numerator ne denominator.
ca2_seqSumLimit.explanation: Kana huwandu hwanyorwa semutsara we$n$, ${wk}$ , saka kukosha kwe limit ndi${res}$ .

ca2_subsTransform.prompt: Pa continuous function $f$, kana ${gv}$ , wana kukosha kwe${tg}$ . (Nyora sechikamu chisingaderedzwi. Kana iri nhamba yakazara, nyora sanhamba yakazara. Muenzaniso: 3/4)

ca2_substitution.prompt: Wana kukosha kwe definite integral $\int_{{lo}}^{{hi}}{fx}\,dx$ . (Nyora sechikamu chisingaderedzwi. Kana iri nhamba yakazara, nyora sanhamba yakazara. Muenzaniso: 3/4)

Usakanganwa kuti kana wachinja, renji reintegral rinochinjawo kuita kukosha kwe$u$.

ca2_tangentLine.prompt: Wana $y$ coordinate yepoinzi apo tangent papoinzi $ {pt} $ pacurve ${cv}$ inosangana ne$y$-axis. (Unogona kunyora sedhesimali kana sechikamu se3/4)
hints: Derivative papoinzi yekubata ndiyo slope yetangent.
Isa $x=0$ mu equation yetangent $y-y_0=m(x-x_0)$.

ca2_tangentTriangle.prompt: Wana nzvimbo yepembetatu yakakomberedzwa ne tangent papoinzi $ {pt} $ pacurve ${cv}$ , $x$-axis, ne$y$-axis. (Nyora sechikamu chisingaderedzwi. Kana iri nhamba yakazara, nyora sanhamba yakazara. Muenzaniso: 3/4)

Hwaro nekukwirira kwepembetatu ndi$|x\text{ intercept}|$, $|y\text{ intercept}|$.

ca2_telescope.prompt: Wana huwandu hwe infinite series $\sum_{n=1}^{\infty}{term}$ . (Nyora sechikamu chisingaderedzwi. Kana iri nhamba yakazara, nyora sanhamba yakazara. Muenzaniso: 3/4)
hints: Ma factor edenominator akabatana nechikamu chakaenzana. Edza kuagoverana kuita partial fractions.

$\frac{1}{A(A+d)}=\frac{1}{d}\left(\frac{1}{A}-\frac{1}{A+d}\right)$, uye kana pane ma factor matatu, $\frac{1}{A(A+1)(A+2)}=\frac{1}{2}\left(\frac{1}{A(A+1)}-\frac{1}{(A+1)(A+2)}\right)$. Tsvaga mazwi anosara mushure mekudzimwa mu partial sum.
ca2_telescope.explanation: Kana wagovanisa kuita partial fractions uye wawana partial sum, mushure mekudzimwa ${wk}$ , saka huwandu ndi${res}$ .

ca2_trigLimit.prompt: Tsvaga mutengo wemuganhu unotevera. $\lim_{{to}}{ex}$ (Nyora sechikamu chisingaderedzwi. Kana iri nhamba yakazara, nyora nhamba yakazara. Muenzaniso: 3/4)

ca2_velocityIntegral.prompt: Kumhanho kwepoindi P inofamba pamutsetse wenhamba panguva $t$ ($t\ge0$) ndiko $v(t)={vt}$. Tsvaga nhambwe yakafambwa nepoindi P kubva panguva $t=0$ kusvika $t={T}$. (Nyora sechikamu chisingaderedzwi. Kana iri nhamba yakazara, nyora nhamba yakazara. Muenzaniso: 3/4)

Tsvaga nguva apo chiratidzo chekumhanho chinochinja, kamura chikamu, usarudze chiratidzo che $|v(t)|$ muchikamu chimwe nechimwe, wobva wabatanidza.

ca2_volumeRotate.prompt: Rega $V$ ive huwandu hwe solid yekutenderera yakaitwa nekutenderedza $x$-axis nzvimbo yakakomberedzwa nemagraph maviri $y={f}$, $y={g}$ nemitsetse miviri $x={a}$, $x={b}$. Tsvaga mutengo we ${ask}$. (Nyorera: $x$-axis ndi $y=0$.) (Nyora sechikamu chisingaderedzwi. Kana iri nhamba yakazara, nyora nhamba yakazara. Muenzaniso: 3/4)

Tora graph yepamusoro seradius yekunze uye graph yepazasi seradius yemukati. $(\tan x)'=\frac{1}{\cos^{2}x}$ uye $\sin^{2}x=\frac{1-\cos 2x}{2}$.

cm1_absIneqCount.prompt: Pakati pemhinduro dze inequality ${expr}$, nhamba dzakazara $x$ ndedzingani? (Nyora nhamba chete)

cm1_absIneqRep.explanation: Kubva ku $-c{op}{mx}-a{op}c$, $a-c{op}{mx}{op}a+c$ uye mhinduro iri ${lo}{op}x{op}{hi}$, saka $a-c={mlo}$, $a+c={mhi}$. Naizvozvo $a={a}$, $c={c}$ uye $a+c={ans}$.

cm1_coloring.prompt: Pane zvikamu ${n}$ zvine nhamba ${regs}$. Zvikamu zvinobatana chete nemapairi anotevera: ${edges}$. Zvikamu zviviri zvakabatana zvinofanira kupendwa nemavara akasiyana. hints: Sarudza kutevedzana kwekupenda, uye pakupenda chikamu chimwe nechimwe verenga huwandu hwemavara asara kana wabvisa mavara akashandiswa pazvikamu zvakabatana zvakapendwa kare.

Kana huwandu hwemavara anogona kushandiswa hunosiyana zvichienderana nokuti zvikamu zvakabatana zvakapendwa kare zvine vara rimwe here kana akasiyana, paradzanisa mamiriro wobva washandisa mutemo wekuwedzera.
cm1_coloring.explanation: Kupenda nekutevedzana uye kuverenga huwandu hwemavara anogoneka nemutemo wekuwanza nemutemo wekuwedzera kunopa ${work}={ans}$ nzira.

cm1_combCommittee.prompt: Pakati pevakomana ${m}$ nevasikana ${w}$, kuchasarudzwa ${r}$ ve komiti. Mukomana mumwe chaiye anofanira kusarudzwa, musikana mumwe chaiye haafaniri kusarudzwa, uye vasikana vasingaite ${a}$ vanofanira kuva mukati. Nzira dzekusarudza ndedzingani? (Nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Kana wasarudza mumwe anofanira kusarudzwa nemumwe asingafaniri kusarudzwa, dambudziko rinova rekusarudza vamwe vakasara pakati pevanhu vasara.
Paradzanisa mamiriro apo vasikana vari ${a}$, ${a}+1$, $\ldots$, wobva wawedzera (nzira dzekusarudza vasikana)$\times$(nzira dzekusarudza vakomana).
cm1_combCommittee.explanation: Mukomana mumwe asarudzwa kare uye musikana mumwe abviswa, saka pakati pevakomana ${m1}$ nevasikana ${w1}$ kuchasarudzwa vamwe ${r1}$, vasikana vasingaite ${a}$. ${work}={ans}$.

cm1_complexCond.prompt: Pa nhamba yechokwadi $x$, mu complex number $z={zs}$, kukosha kwe $x$ kunoita kuti $z$ ive pure imaginary ndekupi? (Pure imaginary ndi complex number ine real part $0$ uye imaginary part isiri $0$.) (Nyora nhamba chete)

Tsvaga $x$ inoita kuti real part ive $0$, wobva waongorora kuti imaginary part haisi $0$ pakukosha uku.
cm1_complexCond.explanation: Real part ye $z$ ndi ${re}$, imaginary part ndi ${im}$. Real part inofanira kuva $0$, saka ${roots}$. Panguva iyi kukosha kwe imaginary part ndi ${chk}$, saka $x={ans}$ ndiyo inoita kuti ive pure imaginary.

cm1_cubicOneReal.prompt: Kana huwandu hwemidzi yechokwadi yakasiyana ye equation ${eq}=0$ iri $S$, uye chigadzirwa chemidzi yose yakasiyana yeimaginary iri $T$, kukosha kwe $S+T$ ndekupi? (Nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Mu equation ine integer coefficients uye leading coefficient $1$, midzi ye integer iri pakati pema divisor e constant term. Tarisa nefactor theorem.
Tsvaga mudzi mumwe uye ugovane nesynthetic division kuti usare nechimiro chiri pasi. Shandisa discriminant ye quadratic yasara kuti uone kuti midzi iri imaginary.
cm1_cubicOneReal.explanation: Kuita factoring kunopa ${eq}={fac}$. Discriminant ye quadratic ${quad}$ ndi $D={D}<0$ saka ine midzi miviri yeimaginary ine chigadzirwa $T={q}$, uye huwandu hwemidzi yechokwadi ndi $S={S}$. Saka $S+T={ans}$.

cm1_discrimCount.prompt: Pa quadratic equation ${eq}=0$, nhamba dzakazara $k$ dzinoita kuti midzi yayo yose miviri ive imaginary dziri ngani pa ${lo}\le k\le {hi}$? (Nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Kuti quadratic equation ive nemidzi yeimaginary, discriminant $D<0$ inofanira kuva.
Kana coefficient ye $x$ iri even, zviri nyore kushandisa $\frac{D}{4}=\left(\frac{b}{2}\right)^2-ac$. Gadzirisa izvi seinequality mu $k$.
cm1_discrimCount.explanation: $\frac{D}{4}={d4}<0$ inofanira kuva, uye kuigadzirisa kunopa ${kr}$. Nhamba dzakazara $k$ dzinogutsa izvi ndedzi ${ks}$, saka mu ${lo}\le k\le {hi}$ dzose ndedzi ${ans}$.

cm1_divisorCount.prompt: Pakati pema divisor akanaka enhamba yechisikirwa $N={fac}$, mangani ari ma multiple e ${m}$? (Nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Ma divisor ari ma multiple e ${m}$ anogona kunyorwa se ${m}\times t$. Fungai kuti $t$ inogona kuva nhamba dzipi.
Ma divisor akadaro ndeechimiro ${m}\times t$, uye $t$ idivisor ye $\frac{N}{{m}}$.
cm1_divisorCount.explanation: Ma divisor ari ma multiple e ${m}$ ndeechimiro ${m}\times t$, uye $t$ idivisor ye $\frac{N}{{m}}={Nm}$. Huwandu hwema divisor iwayo ndi ${prod}={ans}$.

cm1_factorEval.prompt: Pachishandiswa kuparadzanisa kuita zvinhu, kukosha kwe-${expr}$ ndekupi? (Nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Isa nhamba huru se-$N$, paradzanisa nhamba yekumusoro kuita zvinhu, wobva wapfupisa neyekuzasi.
Semuenzaniso, $N^3-1=(N-1)(N^2+N+1)$, $N^4+N^2+1=(N^2+N+1)(N^2-N+1)$, $N^4-1=(N^2+1)(N^2-1)$, chirevo chakafanana neyekuzasi chinoonekwa sechinhu chenhamba yekumusoro.
