cm1_factorEval.explanation: Kana $N={N}$, kuparadzanisa nhamba yekumusoro kuita zvinhu kunopa ${fac}$, uye kupfupisa neyekuzasi kunopa ${simp}$. Saka kukosha ndi${ans}$.

cm1_gridPaths.prompt: Pa-coordinate plane, pakati penzira pfupi dzichibva pachinhambwe $(0,0)$ kuenda pachinhambwe $({a},{b})$ nekufamba ne-$+1$ panguva imwe munzira ye-axis ye-$x$ kana ye-axis ye-$y$, nzira dzingani dzinopfuura pachinhambwe A$({p},{q})$ asi dzisingapfuure pachinhambwe B$({u},{v})$? (Nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Huwandu hwenzira pfupi kubva ku-$(0,0)$ kuenda ku-$(m,n)$ hunoitwa nekusarudza kuteedzana kwekuenda kurudyi nguva $m$ nekumusoro nguva $n$, ${}_{m+n}\mathrm{C}_{m}$.
Panzira 'dzinopfuura', wedzera huwandu hwenzira dzechikamu chimwe nechimwe; panzira 'dzisingapfuure', bvisa nzira dzinopfuurawo pachinhambwe B pane dzose dzinopfuura pachinhambwe A.
cm1_gridPaths.explanation: Nzira dzinopfuura pachinhambwe A ndi${t1}$. Pakati pazvo, dzinopfuurawo pachinhambwe B ndi${t2}$. Saka huwandu hwenzira hunodiwa ndi${ans}$.

cm1_iPower.prompt: Kana $z={z}$, huwandu hwechikamu chechokwadi nechikamu che-imaginary che-${expr}$ ndehupi? (Nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Masimba e-$i$ anodzokorora nekutevedzana uku: $i,\ -1,\ -i,\ 1$. Kana $z$ yakaoma, tanga wainyatsorerutsa kuita chimiro che-$a+bi$.
Sezvo $z^4=1$, masimba e-$z$ anodzokorora kukosha kwakafanana pane ma-$4$ ega ega. Tarisa chete chasara mushure mekupatsanura ne-$4$.
cm1_iPower.explanation: Tanga warerutsa, $z={zs}$ uye $z^4=1$. Kushandura chikamu kuita chasara mushure mekupatsanura ne-$4$, ${work}$. Saka huwandu hwechikamu chechokwadi nechikamu che-imaginary ndi${ans}$.

cm1_iPowerSum.prompt: Kana $z={z}$, huwandu hwechikamu chechokwadi nechikamu che-imaginary che-${expr}$ ndehupi? (Nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Tanga warerutsa $z$ kuita chimiro che-$a+bi$, wozosimbisa kuti $z^4=1$. Ipapo unogona kuziva kukosha kwehuwandu hwemasimba mana anotevedzana $z+z^2+z^3+z^4$.
Kana ukaisa mazwi mana nemana, huwandu hweboka rega rega hwakafanana. Mazwi akasara pakupedzisira ndiwo asara mushure mekupatsanura nhamba yemazwi ne-$4$.
cm1_iPowerSum.explanation: Tanga warerutsa, $z={zs}$, saka $z^4=1$ uye $z+z^2+z^3+z^4=0$. Kuisa mazwi mana nemana, huwandu hweboka rega rega ndi$0$, uye sezvo ${n}={q4}\times4+{rm}$, mazwi asara ndiwo ekutanga ${rm}$ chete, saka ${work}$. Saka huwandu hwechikamu chechokwadi nechikamu che-imaginary ndi${ans}$.

cm1_identity.prompt: Mu-identity ${lhs}={rhs}$ ye-$x$, kukosha kwe-${ask}$ kuri sei kune nhamba dzisingachinji ${consts}$? (Nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Identity ndiyo equation inoita chokwadi kunyange ukaisa kukosha kupi zvako kwe-$x$. Unogona kuwedzera divi rekuruboshwe woenzanisa ma-coefficient emasimba akafanana.
Kana $x={p}$, chirevo chiri mukati mebhureketi chinoita $0$. Kuisa kukosha uku kunopa kukosha kwenhamba isingachinji nekukasira.
cm1_identity.explanation: Nekuenzanisa ma-coefficient kana kuisa kukosha kwakakodzera kwe-$x$, ${sol}$. Saka ${ask}={ans}$.

cm1_linIneqCount.prompt: Pakati pemhinduro dze-inequality dzakabatana ${i1}$, ${i2}$, nhamba dzakazara $x$ dzingani? (Nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Gadzirisa inequality imwe neimwe zvakasiyana kuti uwane huwandu hwe-$x$, wozowana chikamu chakafanana. Kuwanza kana kupatsanura mativi ose nenhamba isiri yakanaka kunotendeudza chiratidzo che-inequality.
Dhirowa huwandu huviri pamutsetse wenhamba woverenga nhamba dzakazara dziri muchikamu chakabatana. Chenjera kana pane chiratidzo chekuenzana.
cm1_linIneqCount.explanation: Mhinduro ye-inequality yekutanga ndi${s1}$, yechipiri ndi${s2}$, saka huwandu hwakafanana ndi${s}$. Nhamba dzakazara $x$ dzinogutsa izvi ndi${ints}$, dzose ndi${ans}$.

cm1_linIneqParam.prompt: Pakati pezvakapindirwa zveinikwoyriti yakabatana ${i1}$, ${i2}$, kukosha kwose kwenhamba yakazara $k$ kunoita kuti nhamba dzakazara $x$ dzive ${n}$ chaizvo kunowedzerwa pamwe kuri kupi? (nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Tanga wagadzirisa inikwoyriti isina $k$ kuti uwane huwandu hwe$x$, wobva wanyora huwandu hwe$x$ weimwe inikwoyriti uchishandisa $k$.
Kuti pave nenhamba dzakazara ${n}$ chaizvo mukati mepamwe pemhando mbiri idzi, tarisa kuti magumo emhando iri pakati penhamba dzakazara dzipi.
cm1_linIneqParam.explanation: Mhinduro yeinikwoyriti yekutanga ndi ${s1}$, neyechipiri ndi ${s2}$. Kuti nhamba dzakazara $x$ dzive ${n}$ chaizvo, zvinofanira kuva ${kr}$, saka nhamba dzakazara $k$ ndi ${ks}$, uye huwandu hwadzo ndi ${ans}$.

cm1_matCayley.prompt: Pamatrikisi $A={A}$, $E={Emat}$, pane nhamba chaidzo $p$, $q$ dzinoita kuti $A^{{n}}=pA+qE$. Kukosha kwe${ask}$ kuri kupi? (nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Verenga $A^{{n}}$ zvakananga nekuwanza matrikisi kuti uwane zvikamu zvayo.
Nyora zvikamu ze$pA+qE$ uchishandisa $p$, $q$, wozvienzanisa nezvikamu ze$A^{{n}}$, uchawana mitemo yakabatana ye$p$ ne$q$.
cm1_matCayley.explanation: $A^{{n}}={Apow}$, uye kana ichienzaniswa nezvikamu ze$pA+qE$, $p={p}$, $q={q}$. Saka ${ask}={ans}$.

cm1_matWord.prompt: Mashopu maviri A, B anotengesa zvinhu zvemhando ${ni}$. Chikamu chechi (i, j) chematrikisi $P={mp}$ ndicho mutengo (won) wechinhu chimwe chechj chinotengeswa neshopu i (mutsetse 1: shopu A, mutsetse 2: shopu B), uye chikamu chechi (j, l) chematrikisi $Q={mq}$ ndiyo huwandu hwechinhu chechj chinodiwa nemunhu wechl pakati pa Gap (rukoko 1) naEul (rukoko 2). Kana Gap naEul vanotenga zvose zvavanoda neshopu imwe chete, uye vose vachisarudza shopu inodhura zvishoma, huwandu hwemari yavanobhadhara ndehwei (won)? (nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Mari inobhadharwa nemunhu l kushopu i ndiyo huwandu hwekuwanza zvikamu zvemutsetse i we$P$ nezverukoko l we$Q$ nenzira imwe neimwe.
Kukosha uku ndizvo zvikamu zve matrikisi $PQ$. Wana $PQ$, wobva wasarudza kukosha kudiki parukoko rumwe norumwe, wozvisanganisa.
cm1_matWord.explanation: $PQ={pq}$. Mari yaGap ndi ${pq11}$ won kushopu A uye ${pq21}$ won kushopu B, saka yakachipa ndi ${m1}$ won; yaEul ndi ${pq12}$ won kushopu A uye ${pq22}$ won kushopu B, saka yakachipa ndi ${m2}$ won. Saka huwandu ndi ${ans}$ won.

cm1_omega.prompt: Kana $\omega$ iri imwe midzi yekufungidzira yeikwesheni yechipiri ${eq}$, kukosha kwe${expr}$ kuri kupi? (nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Kana ukawanza mativi ose eikwesheni ne$x-1$ kana $x+1$, unowana kukosha kwe$\omega^3$.
Kana $\omega^3=\pm1$ ipapo $\omega^6=1$. Tarisa chete chasara kana exponent yagoverwa nenguva yekudzokorora.
cm1_omega.explanation: Sezvo $\omega$ iri mudzi weikwesheni ${eq}$, ${rel}$. Saka masimba anodzoka kukosha kumwechete pamusoro pe${per}$ imwe neimwe, uye kana exponent ikagoverwa ne${per}$ chinosara chete chinofungidzirwa, ${step}$. Saka kukosha kunotsvakwa ndi ${ans}$.

cm1_parabolaLine.prompt: Kana paraboro inotevera nemutsetse zvichibatana pachisvitsa chimwe chete, kukosha kwekoronstanti $k$ kuri kupi? (paraboro $y={f}$, mutsetse $y={g}$) (nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Kubata kunoreva kuti ikwesheni yechipiri inobva pakubatanidza mbiri idzi ine mudzi umwe wakapetwa.
Bvisa $y$ pamaikwesheni maviri, wobva waita kuti dhisikiminanti yeikwesheni yechipiri ive $0$.
cm1_parabolaLine.explanation: Kubva pa${f}={g}$, ${eq2}=0$, uye sezvo dzichibatana, dhisikiminanti $D=({bm})^2-4\cdot({a})\cdot({c}-k)=0$. Kana yagadziriswa, $k={ans}$.

cm1_parabolaLineCount.prompt: Pakati pe${lo}\le k\le {hi}$, nhamba dzakazara $k$ dzinoita kuti paraboro inotevera nemutsetse zvisasangane dzakawanda sei? (paraboro $y={f}$, mutsetse $y={g}$) (nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Kusasangana kunoreva kuti ikwesheni yechipiri inobva pakubatanidza mbiri idzi haina midzi chaiyo.
Wana huwandu hwe$k$ hunoita kuti dhisikiminanti yeikwesheni yechipiri isina $y$ ive $D<0$, wobva waverenga nhamba dzakazara mukati mahwo.
cm1_parabolaLineCount.explanation: Kubva pa${f}={g}$, ${eq2}=0$, uye kuti dzisasangane dhisikiminanti inofanira kuva $D<0$. Kubva pa$D=({bm})^2-4\cdot({a})\cdot({c}-k)={dk}<0$, ${kr}$, saka nhamba dzakazara mukati me${lo}\le k\le {hi}$ ndi ${ks}$, uye dzose ndi ${ans}$.

cm1_parabolaXaxis.prompt: Kana graph ye quadratic function $y={f}$ ichisangana ne$x$-axis pamapoinzi maviri akasiyana, uye kureba pakati pemapoinzi maviri iri ${d}$, kukosha kwe constant $k$ ndekwei? (Nyora nhamba chete.)
hints: $x$ coordinates dzemapoinzi ekusangana mbiri idzi ndidzo midzi miviri ye equation ${f}=0$.
Kana midzi miviri iri $\alpha$, $\beta$, kureba pakati pemapoinzi maviri ndi$|\alpha-\beta|$, uye $(\alpha-\beta)^2=(\alpha+\beta)^2-4\alpha\beta$.
cm1_parabolaXaxis.explanation: $x$ coordinates dzemapoinzi ekusangana $\alpha$, $\beta$ ndidzo midzi miviri ye${f}=0$, saka $\alpha+\beta={sm}$. Kubva pa$(\alpha-\beta)^2=({sm})^2-4\alpha\beta={d}^2$, $\alpha\beta={ab}$, uye kubva pahukama hwemidzi ne coefficients, $\alpha\beta=\frac{k}{{p}}$, saka $k={ans}$.

cm1_permArrange.prompt: Kana vakomana ${m}$ nevasikana ${w}$ vachirongwa mumutsetse, nhamba yenzira dzekuvarongera kuti pasave nevasikana vaviri vakagara vakatarisana ndeipi? (Vadzidzi vose vakasiyana.) (Nyora nhamba chete.)
hints: Zviri nyore kuisa mativi asingafaniri kuvhiringana (vasikana) pashure. Tanga warongera vakomana mumutsetse.
Kunobuda nzvimbo dzevasikana pakati pevakomana nemakumo ose maviri. Sarudza nzvimbo dzakasiyana pakati padzo kuti urongere vasikana.
cm1_permArrange.explanation: Nzira dzekutanga kurongera vakomana ${m}$ ndi${m}!={mf}$. Nzira dzekusarudza nzvimbo ${w}$ dzakasiyana pakati penzvimbo ${m1}$ pakati pevakomana nemakumo ose maviri kuti urongere vasikana ndi${}_{{m1}}\mathrm{P}_{{w}}={pv}$. Nokudaro ${mf}\times{pv}={ans}$ nzira.

cm1_permNumbers.prompt: Pane makadhi ${nc}$ ane nhamba dzakasiyana dzakanyorwa pamwe nepamwe, nhamba dzakanyorwa ndi${digs}$. Kana makadhi ${r}$ akasarudzwa uye akarongwa mumutsetse kuita nhamba yakazara ine madhijiti ${r}$, nhamba dzinoverengwa ne${m}$ dzinosvika ingani? ($0$ haigoni kuva panzvimbo yekutanga.) (Nyora nhamba chete.)
hints: Kuverengwa ne${m}$ kunoenderana nedhijiti rekupedzisira. Tanga wasarudza nhamba dzinogona kuva panzvimbo yekupedzisira.
Mushure mekusarudza nzvimbo yekupedzisira, nzvimbo yekutanga inosarudzwa pakati penhamba dzisiri $0$, uye nzvimbo dzakasara dzinozadzwa nemakadhi akasara (mutemo wekuvhiya).
cm1_permNumbers.explanation: Nhamba dzinogona kuva panzvimbo yekupedzisira ndi${Lstr}$. Pane imwe neimwe, wedzera (nhamba yenzira dzekusarudza nzvimbo yekutanga)$\times$(nhamba yenzira dzekuzadza nzvimbo dzakasara) kuti uwane ${work}={ans}$.

cm1_polyDivQR.prompt: Pa polynomial $P(x)={pp}$, kana quotient ye$P(x)\div({dv})$ iri $Q(x)$ uye remainder iri $R(x)$, kukosha kwe$Q({t})+R({t})$ ndekwei? (Nyora nhamba chete.)
hints: Govanisa mazwi ane degree yepamusoro, uite izwi rekutanga re quotient, wobva wavhiya nemutsara unogovanisa uye ubvise, uchidzokorora.
Izwi rekutanga re quotient ndi${qlead}$, uye degree ye remainder iri pasi pe degree yemutsara unogovanisa.

cm1_polyProdCoef.prompt: Pa polynomials mbiri $A={pa}$, $B={pb}$, coefficient ye$x^{{k}}$ pakuwedzera $AB$ ndeipi? (Nyora nhamba chete.)
hints: Haufaniri kuwedzera $AB$ yose. Tsvaga chete mapeya emazwi ane chigadzirwa chine chimiro che$x^{{k}}$.
Papeya rimwe nerimwe iro huwandu hwe degrees dzemazwi e$A$ ne$B$ hwakaenzana ne${k}$, vhiya ma coefficients, wobva wawedzera mhinduro dzose.
cm1_polyProdCoef.explanation: Kana ma coefficients ezvigadzirwa zvemazwi ane chimiro che$x^{{k}}$ akawedzerwa, ${terms}={ans}$. (Kana wawedzera chaizvo, $AB={prod}$.)

cm1_quadFence.prompt: Neutambo une kureba kwe${L}$ m inoshandiswa kugadzira danho rerectangle rine rutivi rumwe rakabatana nemadziro, uye kuisa zvikamu ${j}$ zvakakoromoka kumadziro kuti kupatsanura nzvimbo. Kana tambo isingashandiswi kudivi remadziro uye zvikamu zvichigadzirwa netambo yakafanana, nzvimbo yakanyanya yedanho rose ndeye $\mathrm{m}^2$ yakawanda sei? (nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Tora kureba kwerutivi rakakoromoka kumadziro se$x$ m wobva waverenga kuti pane marutivi akadaro mangani.
Nyora kureba kwerutivi rakafanana nemadziro neya$x$, gadzira nzvimbo seikwesheni yechipiri ye$x$, wobva wawana kona.
cm1_quadFence.explanation: Marutivi akakoromoka kumadziro ndiwo maviri emagumo nezvikamu ${j}$, zvese ${k}$, saka kureba kwerutivi rakafanana nemadziro ndi$({L}-{k}x)$ m. Nzvimbo $S(x)=x({L}-{k}x)$ inova yakanyanya pa$x={u}$ uye kukosha kwakanyanya ndi${ans}$ $\mathrm{m}^2$.

cm1_quadIneqAlways.prompt: Nhamba dzakazara $k$ dzinoita kuti mhinduro yeinikwoyriti ${ineq}$ ive nhamba chaiyo dzose dzakawanda sei? (nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Sezvo chiverengero che$x^2$ ari $k$, ganhura nyaya ye$k=0$ neisiri iyo. Kana $k\ne0$ inofanira kuva yakakotama kumusoro uye dhisikiminanti $D<0$ (kana $D\le0$).
Nyora dhisikiminanti $D$ seikwesheni ye$k$ wobva wagadzirisa inikwoyriti. Kana yakakotama kuenda kuzasi ($k<0$) haigoni kuva yechokwadi pa nhamba chaiyo dzose.
cm1_quadIneqAlways.explanation: Kana $k=0$, kuruboshwe kune koronstanti ${n}$ chete uye ichi chakakura kupfuura $0$, saka inikwoyriti inogara iri yechokwadi. Kana $k\ne0$, inofanira kukotama kumusoro, saka $k>0$ uye $\frac{D}{4}={d4}{rel}0$ inofanira kuvapo, uye kana yagadziriswa, ${kr}$. Saka kubatanidza $k=0$, nhamba dzakazara $k$ ndi${ks}$, dzose ${ans}$.

cm1_quadIneqSol.prompt: Kana mhinduro yeinikwoyriti yechipiri ${mx2}+ax+b{op}0$ iri ${sol}$, kukosha kwe${ask}$ pamakoronstanti $a$, $b$ kuri kupi? (nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Kukosha kwemagumo ose maviri emhinduro yeinikwoyriti ndiwo midzi miviri yeikwesheni yechipiri ${mx2}+ax+b=0$.
Nyora ikwesheni yechipiri muchimiro che(chiverengero che$x^2$)$\times(x-\alpha)(x-\beta)$ wobva waienzanisa nechimiro chakawedzerwa.
cm1_quadIneqSol.explanation: Sezvo mhinduro iri ${sol}$, midzi miviri ndi${lo}$, ${hi}$, uye sezvo chiverengero che$x^2$ chiri ${m}$, ${mx2}+ax+b={fac}={full}$. Saka $a={a}$, $b={b}$ uye ${ask}={ans}$.

cm1_quadRange.prompt: Pafunction $y={f}$, huwandu hwekukosha kwakanyanya nekwakaderera pa${m}\le x\le {n}$ ndehwei? (Pano, $x$ inhamba chaiyo.) (nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Pafunction yechipiri, tanga wacheka kuti $x$ yekona iri mukati meparutivi rakapiwa here.
Kana kona iri mukati meparutivi, enzanisa kukosha pakona nepamagumo maviri, kana iri kunze, enzanisa pamagumo maviri.
cm1_quadRange.explanation: Kona yefunction iyi ndi$({h},{kv})$, uye kukosha kwe$y$ pamagumo eparutivi ndi${fm}$ kana $x={m}$, ${fn}$ kana $x={n}$. Kana ukatarisa kuti $x$ yekona iri mukati meparutivi ${m}\le x\le {n}$ here wowana kukosha kwakanyanya nekwakaderera, huwandu hwacho ndi${ans}$.

cm1_quadRevenue.prompt: Chinhu chine mutengo wekugadzira we${w}$ won chinotengeswa pa${a}$ won chimwe, uye zvinotengeswa ${b}$ pazuva. Kana mutengo wekutengesa ukawedzerwa ne${s}$ won, huwandu hunotengeswa pazuva hunodzikira nezvikamu ${c}$. Kana mutengo ungawedzerwa ne${s}$ won kakawanda kakazara ($0$ kuchibatanidzwa), purofiti yakanyanya pazuva ndeye won ingani? (Purofiti inoverengwa se(mutengo wekutengesa $-$ mutengo wekugadzira)$\times$(huwandu hunotengeswa).) (nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Tora kakawanda kekukwidziridza mutengo se$t$ wobva wanyora mutengo wekutengesa nehuwandu hunotengeswa uchishandisa $t$.
(purofiti pachimwe)$\times$(huwandu hunotengeswa) ikwesheni yechipiri ye$t$. Tarisa kana $t$ yekona iri nhamba yakazara.
cm1_quadRevenue.explanation: Kana kakawanda kekukwidziridza kari $t$, purofiti pachimwe ndi$({e1}+{s}t)$ won, huwandu hunotengeswa ndi$({b}-{c}t)$, saka purofiti ndi$({e1}+{s}t)({b}-{c}t)$ won. Ikwesheni yechipiri iyi inova yakanyanya pa$t={tstar}$ uye purofiti panguva iyoyo ndi${ans}$ won.

cm1_remQuadDiv.prompt: Kune polynomial $P(x)$, chasara chakaitwa $P(x)\div({dv1})$ ndi ${r1}$ uye chasara che $P(x)\div({dv2})$ ndi ${r2}$. Kana chasara che $P(x)\div\left(({dv1})({dv2})\right)$ chiri $R(x)$, kukosha kwe $R({c})$ ndekupi? (Nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Chasara chekugovanisa nequadratic chiri polynomial yedegree 1 kana pasi. Isa $R(x)=px+q$.
Kubva ku $P(x)=({dv1})({dv2})Q(x)+R(x)$, edza kuisa kukosha kuviri kunoita kuti mugoveri ive $0$.
cm1_remQuadDiv.explanation: Kana $R(x)=px+q$, ipapo $R({a})=P({a})={r1}$, $R({b})=P({b})={r2}$. Kana equation mbiri idzi dzagadziriswa pamwe chete, $p={p}$, $q={q}$, saka $R(x)={Rx}$ uye $R({c})={ans}$.

cm1_remUnknown.prompt: Kune polynomial $P(x)={pp}$, chasara che $P(x)\div({dv})$ ndi ${R}$. Kukosha kwe constant $k$ ndekupi? (Nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Remainder theorem: chasara chekugovanisa polynomial $P(x)$ ne $x-a$ chakaenzana ne $P(a)$.
Kukosha kwe $x$ kunoita kuti mugoveri ive $0$ ndiko uku: $x={t}$. Kana ukaisa kukosha uku mu $P(x)$, unowana equation yelinear ye $k$.
cm1_remUnknown.explanation: Nemuremainder theorem, $P({t})={R}$ inofanira kuva yakadaro. $P({t})={lhs}$, saka kubva ku ${lhs}={R}$, $k={ans}$.

cm1_rootSignCond.prompt: Kubva paequation yequadratic ${eq}=0$, nhamba yakazara diki $k$ inoita kuti midzi miviri yakasiyana yaiyo chaiyo yose ive hombe kupfuura ${t}$ ndeipi? (Nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Kana divi rekuruboshwe riri $f(x)$, ndiyo nyaya apo graph ye $y=f(x)$ inosangana ne $x$ axis pamapoindi maviri akasiyana uye mapoindi ose maviri ari kurudyi kwe $x={t}$.
Cheka mamiriro matatu ose: discriminant $D>0$, nzvimbo yeaxis (axis $x>{t}$), uye $f({t})>0$.
cm1_rootSignCond.explanation: Kubva ku $f(x)={eq}$, kuti midzi miviri ose ive hombe kupfuura ${t}$, mamiriro matatu anofanira kuzadziswa: (i) $\frac{D}{4}={d4}>0$, (ii) axis $x=k$ ine $k>{t}$, (iii) $f({t})={ft}>0$. Nhamba yakazara diki $k$ inoita izvi ndi ${ans}$.

cm1_symmetricEval.prompt: Kana nhamba chaidzo $x$, $y$ dzichiita ${cond}$, kukosha kwe ${expr}$ ndekupi? (Nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Ratidza expression inotsvagwa nehuwandu $x+y$ nechibereko $xy$. Semuenzaniso $x^2+y^2=(x+y)^2-2xy$.
Kune cube shandisa $x^3+y^3=(x+y)^3-3xy(x+y)$, uye kune simba rechina tanga wawana $x^2+y^2$, wobva washandisa $x^4+y^4=(x^2+y^2)^2-2(xy)^2$.
cm1_symmetricEval.explanation: Kana tikashandura fomula dzekuwanza, ${expr}={work}$. (Pano $(x-y)^2=(x+y)^2-4xy={dd}\ge0$, saka nhamba chaidzo $x$, $y$ dzinoita mamiriro dzinovapo.) Nokudaro kukosha kunotsvagwa ndi ${ans}$.

cm1_symmetricInv.prompt: Kana nhamba chaiyo $x$ ichiita $x+\frac{1}{x}={k}$, kukosha kwe ${expr}$ ndekupi? (Nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Chibereko che $x$ ne $\frac{1}{x}$ ndi $1$. Saka kana uchiziva kukosha kwehuwandu $x+\frac{1}{x}$ chete, unogona kuwana huwandu hwemasimba.

$x^2+\frac{1}{x^2}=\left(x+\frac{1}{x}\right)^2-2$, $x^3+\frac{1}{x^3}=\left(x+\frac{1}{x}\right)^3-3\left(x+\frac{1}{x}\right)$, uye simba rechina rinowanikwa nekusikweya $x^2+\frac{1}{x^2}$ kamwe zvakare.
cm1_symmetricInv.explanation: Kana tikashandura fomula dzekuwanza, ${expr}={work}$. (Kune nhamba chaiyo $x$, $\left|x+\frac{1}{x}\right|\ge2$, saka nhamba chaidzo dzinoita mamiriro ano dzinovapo.) Nokudaro kukosha kunotsvagwa ndi ${ans}$.

cm1_sysReal.prompt: Kuti system yemitsauko ${e1}$, ${e2}$ ive nemhinduro dzechokwadi $(x, y)$, nhamba dzakazara $k$ pakati pe $-{M}\le k\le {M}$ dziri ngani? (nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Shandisa mutsauko mumwe kubvisa $y$ kuti uwane mutsauko wechipiri we $x$.
Kuti ive nemhinduro dzechokwadi, discriminant yemutsauko wechipiri inofanira kuva $0$ kana kupfuura.
cm1_sysReal.explanation: Kana tabvisa $y$ nomumwe mutsauko, tinowana mutsauko wechipiri we $x$, uye kuti uve nemhinduro dzechokwadi, ${dcond}$ inofanira kuvapo. Ndiko kuti ${kr}$, saka nhamba dzakazara mu $-{M}\le k\le {M}$ dzose pamwe chete ndi${ans}$.

cm1_sysTwo.prompt: Kana $x$, $y$ dziri mhinduro dzechokwadi dzesystem ${e1}$, ${e2}$, kukosha kukuru kwe $x$ ndekupi? (nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Gadzira mutsauko mumwe kana kuratidza mumwe mutsvuku nomumwe kuti uderedze huwandu hwemavara.
Wana mhinduro dzose dzechokwadi $(x, y)$, wobva wasarudza $x$ yakakura kwazvo.
cm1_sysTwo.explanation: Kana tagadzirisa system, $(x,\ y)={sols}$. Pakati pazvo kukosha kukuru kwe $x$ ndi${ans}$.

cm1_vietaExpr.prompt: Kana midzi miviri yemutsauko wechipiri ${eq}=0$ iri $\alpha$, $\beta$, kukosha kwe ${expr}$ ndekupi? (nyora sechikamu chisingadzikiswi. Kana iri nhamba yakazara, nyora nhamba yakazara. Semuenzaniso: 3/4)
hints: Muchirevo $ax^2+bx+c=0$, huwandu hwemidzi miviri ndi $-\frac{b}{a}$, chibereko ndi $\frac{c}{a}$.
Ratidza chirevo chinoda sa $\alpha+\beta$ ne $\alpha\beta$, wobva waisa kukosha.
cm1_vietaExpr.explanation: Kubva pahukama hwemidzi nema coefficient, $\alpha+\beta={sf}$, $\alpha\beta={pf}$. Saka ${expr}={work}={res}$.

cm1_vietaUnknown.prompt: Kana midzi miviri yemutsauko wechipiri $x^2-kx{cs}=0$ iri $\alpha$, $\beta$. Kana ${cond}$, kukosha kwe $k$ yakanaka ndekupi? (nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Kubva pahukama hwemidzi nema coefficient, huwandu hwemidzi ndi $k$, chibereko chemidzi ndi ${c}$.
Ratidza mamiriro akapihwa nga $\alpha+\beta$, $\alpha\beta$, kana isa mumwe mudzi sechinoshanduka uye mumwe nechirevo chacho kuti uwane $k$.
cm1_vietaUnknown.explanation: Kubva pahukama hwemidzi nema coefficient, $\alpha+\beta=k$, $\alpha\beta={c}$. ${work}$ Saka $k={ans}$.

cm2_amgmMin.prompt: Kana ${dom}$, kukosha kudiki kwe ${ex}$ ndekupi? (nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Kune nhamba mbiri dzakanaka $A$, $B$, $A+B\ge 2\sqrt{A\,B}$ (kuenzana kunoitika kana $A=B$).
Batanidza kuti chibereko chive chinogara, shandisa hukama hweaverage yearithmetic neyegeometric, wobva wasimbisa kuti kukosha kwe $x$ apo kuenzana kunoitika kuri mukati mehuwandu hwemamiriro ${dom}$.
cm2_amgmMin.explanation: ${work}$, uye kuenzana kunoitika kana $x={xe}$, uye kukosha uku kuri mukati mehuwandu hwemamiriro ${dom}$. Saka kukosha kudiki ndi${ans}$.

cm2_chordLength.prompt: Denderedzwa $C$: ${circ}$, mutsetse $l$: ${line}$. Kureba kwechord iyo $l$ inocheka mu $C$ ndekupi? (nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Perpendicular kubva pakati pedenderedzwa kuenda kumutsetse inogovera chord kuita zvikamu zviviri zvakaenzana. Tanga wawana kureba pakati pechigadziko nemutsetse.
Kana radius $r$ uye kureba pakati pechigadziko nemutsetse $d$, kureba kwechord ndi $2\sqrt{r^2-d^2}$.
cm2_chordLength.explanation: Pakati pedenderedzwa ndi $({cx}, {cy})$, radius ndi${rad}$. Kureba pakati pechigadziko nemutsetse ndi $d=\frac{|{la}\times({cx})+({lb})\times({cy})+({lc})|}{\sqrt{({la})^2+({lb})^2}}=\frac{{dh}}{{h}}={d}$, saka kureba kwechord ndi $2\sqrt{{rad}^2-{d}^2}=2\times{half}={ans}$.

cm2_circleGeneral.prompt: Chimiro chinoratidzwa nemutsauko ${eq}$ idenderedzwa. Kana coordinates epakati padenderedzwa iri $(a, b)$ uye kureba kweradius kuri $r$, kukosha kwe $a+b+r$ ndekupi? (nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Shandura kuita chimiro che perfect square: $(x-a)^2+(y-b)^2=r^2$ pa $x$ ne $y$.
Kamura macheni ose ne coefficient ye $x^2$, $y^2$, wobva wakanganisa $x$ pamwe chete ne $y$ pamwe chete kuti uite perfect square.
cm2_circleGeneral.explanation: Coefficient ye $x^2$ ndi${kk}$, saka kamura macheni ose nayo woshandura kuita perfect square kuti uwane ${std}$. Pakati ndi $({cx}, {cy})$, radius ndi${rad}$, saka $a+b+r={cx}+({cy})+{rad}={ans}$.

cm2_circleTangentAxes.prompt: Pakati pemadenderedzwa ane pakati pawo muquadrant yekutanga uye anobata $x$-axis ne$y$-axis panguva imwe chete, madenderedzwa maviri chete anopfuura papoinzi $P({p}, {q})$. Pakati pamadenderedzwa maviri aya, radius yedenderedzwa rine radius huru ndeipi? (Nyora nhamba chete.)
hints: Pakati pedenderedzwa rinobata maaxis maviri muquadrant yekutanga ndi$(r, r)$ uye radius ndi$r$.
Isa makoodinetsi epoinzi mu$(x-r)^2+(y-r)^2=r^2$ wogadzirisa quadratic equation ye$r$.
cm2_circleTangentAxes.explanation: Equation yedenderedzwa ndi$(x-r)^2+(y-r)^2=r^2$ ($r>0$) uye inopfuura papoinzi $P$, saka $({p}-r)^2+({q}-r)^2=r^2$, ndiko kuti $r^2-{u}r+{t}=0$. Kuigadzirisa kunopa $r={rs}$ kana $r={rl}$, saka radius huru ndi${ans}$.

cm2_compFindG.prompt: Pa functions mbiri $f$, $g$, kana $f(x)={f}$ uye composite function $(f\circ g)(x)={comp}$, kukosha kwe$g({t})$ ndekwei? (Nyora nhamba chete.)
hints: Nokuti $(f\circ g)(x)=f(g(x))$, isa $g(x)$ panzvimbo ye$x$ mumutsara we$f$.
Kubva pa$f(g(x))={comp}$, gadzirisa equation ye$g(x)$ uwane $g(x)$, wobva waisa $x={t}$.

cm2_compTable.prompt: Pa functions mbiri $f$, $g$ kubva paseti $X=\{{xset}\}$ kuenda ku$X$, zvakapiwa seizvi. $f$: ${ft}$, $g$: ${gt}$. Zvikamu $x$ zve$X$ zvinogutsa $(f\circ g)(x)=(g\circ f)(x)$ zvinosvika zvingani? (Nyora nhamba chete.)
hints: $(f\circ g)(x)=f(g(x))$, $(g\circ f)(x)=g(f(x))$. Wana kukosha kuviri zvakasiyana pa$x$ imwe neimwe.
Gadzira tafura ye$f(g(x))$ ne$g(f(x))$ ye$x=1, 2, \dots$ uchitevedzana wotenzanisa.
cm2_compTable.explanation: Kana $f(g(x))$, $g(f(x))$ yawanikwa pa$x$ imwe neimwe, ${work}$. Nhamba ye$x$ ine kukosha kwakaenzana ndi${ans}$.

cm2_divPoint.prompt: Pamapoinzi maviri $A({x1}, {y1})$, $B({x2}, {y2})$, pane poinzi $P$ inogovanisa segment $AB$ mukati. Kana $\overline{A P}:\overline{P B}={m}:{n}$, huwandu hwe $x$ coordinate ne $y$ coordinate yepoinzi $P$ ndehupi? (Nyora nhamba chete.)
hints: Makoodinetsi epoinzi inogovanisa segment $AB$ mukati nereshiyo $m:n$ ndi$\left(\frac{mx_2+nx_1}{m+n},\ \frac{my_2+ny_1}{m+n}\right)$.
Wana $x$ coordinate ne $y$ coordinate zvakasiyana wozviwedzera. $x$ coordinate ndi$\frac{{m}\times({x2})+{n}\times({x1})}{{m}+{n}}$.

cm2_divRatioFind.prompt: Pamapoinzi matatu $A({x1}, {y1})$, $B({x2}, {y2})$, $P({px}, {py})$, poinzi $P$ iri pa segment $AB$ uye $\overline{A P}:\overline{P B}=m:n$. Kana $m$, $n$ dzichiva nhamba dzekuverenga dzisina chikamu chakafanana, kukosha kwe$m+n$ ndekwei? (Nyora nhamba chete.)
hints: Kana $P$ ichigovanisa $AB$ nereshiyo $m:n$, $x$ coordinate ndi$\frac{mx_2+nx_1}{m+n}$. Tsvaga reshiyo kubva pamakoodinetsi e$P$.
Wana $\overline{A P}:\overline{P B}=|p_x-x_1|:|x_2-p_x|$ kubva pamusiyano we $x$ coordinates wodzikisa.
cm2_divRatioFind.explanation: Kana $x$ coordinates dzatenzanisirwa, $|{px}-({x1})|={u}$, $|({x2})-({px})|={w}$, saka $\overline{A P}:\overline{P B}={u}:{w}$, uye kana yakanyorwa sereshiyo yenhamba dzakazara dzisina chikamu chakafanana, ndi${m}:{n}$. ($y$ coordinate inopawo reshiyo imwe chete.) Nokudaro $m+n={ans}$.

cm2_existsInterval.prompt: $U$ ndiyo seti yenhamba dzose dzizere kubva pa ${p}$ kusvika pa ${q}$. Kukosha kukuru kwenhamba yakazara $k$ inoita kuti mataurirwo okuti 'kune imwe element $x$ ye $U$ inoita ${form}$' ave echokwadi ndekupi? (Nyora nhamba chete)
hints: 'Kune imwe $x$' zvinoreva kuti mataurirwo ndeechokwadi kana kuine $x$ imwe chete inoita mamiriro acho.
Shandura kusaenzana kuita chimiro che $k<g(x)$, wobva watsvaga kukosha kukuru kwe $g(x)$ pakati pema element e $U$.
cm2_existsInterval.explanation: ${form}$ inogona kushandurwa kuita $k<{gx}$. Pakati pema element e $U$, ${gx}$ ine kukosha kukuru ${gm}$ kana $x={xm}$, uye kana $k<{gm}$ mataurirwo acho anova echokwadi pa $x$ iyi. Saka kukosha kukuru kwenhamba yakazara $k$ ndi ${ans}$.

cm2_funcInjective.prompt: Mubasa rimwe-kune-rimwe $f$ rinobva paseti $X=\{{xset}\}$ richienda paseti $Y=\{{yset}\}$, mabasa anoita $f(1)\le {t}$ uye $f(2)\ge {u}$ ndeakawanda sei? (Nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Basa rimwe-kune-rimwe rinopa element dzakasiyana dze $X$ kukosha kwebasa kwakasiyana. Tanga wasarudza $f(1)$ ne $f(2)$.
Verenga nzira dzemaparera $(f(1), f(2))$ ane $f(1)\ne f(2)$, wobva wapamhidza nenhamba yenzira dzekusarudza kukosha kwebasa kwema element akasara.
cm2_funcInjective.explanation: $f(1)$ ine nzira ${t}$, $f(2)$ ine nzira ${n}-{u}+1$, uye nyaya dzinoita $f(1)=f(2)$ ndedzi ${ov}$, saka $(f(1), f(2))$ ine nzira ${pairs}$. Ma element akasara ${mr}$ anoenderana rimwe-kune-rimwe nekukosha ${nr}$ kwakasara, saka pane nzira ${rest}$, uye huwandu hunotsvagwa ndi ${pairs}\times{rest}={ans}$.

cm2_funcMonotone.prompt: Mubasa $f$ rinobva paseti $X=\{{xset}\}$ richienda paseti $Y=\{{yset}\}$, mabasa anoita ${chain}$ uye $f(1)\ge {u}$ ndeakawanda sei? (Nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Kana $f(1)<f(2)<\cdots$, kukosha kwebasa kose kwakasiyana, uye kana kukosha kwasarudzwa, kuenderana kunosarudzwa kamwe chete nenzira yekuronga kubva padiki kuenda hombe.
Nhamba dzinogona kuva kukosha kwebasa idzo dzizere kubva pa ${u}$ kusvika pa ${w}$, uye iyi inhamba yenzira dzekusarudza ${m}$ dzakasiyana pakati padzo.
cm2_funcMonotone.explanation: Kukosha kwebasa kunosarudzwa nekusarudza ${m}$ dzakasiyana pakati penhamba dzizere ${k}$ dzinobva pa ${u}$ kusvika pa ${w}$. Kana kukosha kwasarudzwa kuchienderana ne $f(1), f(2), \dots$ kubva padiki, kunosarudzwa nenzira imwe chete, saka huwandu ndi $_{{k}}\mathrm{C}_{{m}}={ans}$.

cm2_inclusionParam.prompt: Kune maseti maviri $A=\{x\mid {Ac}\}$, $C=\{x\mid {Cc}\}$ ($x$ inhamba chaiyo), maseti $B=\{x\mid a\le x\le b\}$ ($a$, $b$ nhamba dzizere) anoita $A\subset B\subset C$ ndeakawanda sei? (Pano $\subset$ inobatanidza nyaya apo maseti maviri akaenzana.) (Nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Tanga wanyora $A$ ne $C$ semagumo ane chimiro che $\alpha\le x\le\beta$.

Kana $A\subset B$, $a$ iri pasi kana pakuenzana nemugumo wekuruboshwe we $A$, uye $b$ iri pamusoro kana pakuenzana nemugumo wekurudyi we $A$; kana $B\subset C$, $a$ ne $b$ zvinofanira kunge zviri mukati megumo re $C$. Verenga kukosha kunogoneka kwe $a$ ne $b$ imwe neimwe.
cm2_inclusionParam.explanation: $A=\{x\mid {al}\le x\le {ar}\}$, $C=\{x\mid {cl}\le x\le {cr}\}$. Kuti $A\subset B\subset C$, zvinofanira kuva ${cl}\le a\le {al}$, ${ar}\le b\le {cr}$, saka $a$ ine ${na}$, $b$ ine ${nb}$, uye huwandu hwe $B$ ndi ${na}\times{nb}={ans}$.

cm2_inverseQuadDom.prompt: Kana basa rinopesana rebasa $f(x)={fx}$ (${dom}$) iri $g$, kukosha kwe $g({t})$ ndekupi? (Nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Nekudzikamisa domain (${dom}$), $f$ inova rimwe-kune-rimwe uye ine basa rinopesana.
Kana $g({t})=x$, ipapo $f(x)={t}$. Tsvaga mhinduro dze equation yequadratic $f(x)={t}$, wobva wasarudza inoenderana nedomain.
cm2_inverseQuadDom.explanation: Inogona kugadziriswa kuita chimiro che $f(x)={vf}$, uye kubva ku $f(x)={t}$, nokuti ${sq}={s2}$, ${xp}=\pm{s}$. Nokuti domain ndi ${dom}$, ${xp}={rt}$ uye $g({t})={ans}$.

cm2_inverseRational.prompt: Kana basa rinopesana ne $f(x)=\frac{{num}}{{den}}$ iri $g$, mutengo we $g({k})$ ndeupi? (Apa, domain ye $f$ ndiyo nhamba dzese dzechokwadi dzisina denominator $0$.) (Nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Wanza mativi ose maviri e $\frac{{num}}{{den}}={k}$ ne denominator wogadzirisa seequation yelinear ye $x$.
cm2_inverseRational.explanation: Kana $g({k})=x$, $f(x)={k}$, saka ${num}={k}\times({den})$. Kana yagadziriswa ye $x$, $({coef})x={rhs}$, saka $x={ans}$, kureva kuti $g({k})={ans}$.

cm2_irrLineCount.prompt: Nhamba dzakazara $k$ dzinoita kuti curve $y=\sqrt{{fr}}$ nemutsetse $y=x+k$ zvisangane pamapoindi 2 ndedzingani? (Nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Tsanangura vara idzva $t$ seizvi. $t=\sqrt{{fr}}$ ($t\ge 0$). Ipapo $x$ inogona kutaurwa nemukuwo we $t$. Huwandu hwemapoindi ekusangana hwakaenzana nehuwandu hwemidzi yechokwadi yakasiyana isiri negative ye quadratic equation ye $t$.
Mamiriro ekuti quadratic equation ye $t$ ive nemidzi miviri yechokwadi yakasiyana isiri negative ndi $D>0$, (muwayo wemidzi miviri)$\ge 0$, (chibereko chemidzi miviri)$\ge 0$.
cm2_irrLineCount.explanation: Kana vara idzva $t$ rinotsanangurwa se $t=\sqrt{{fr}}\ (t\ge 0)$, $x=\frac{t^2-({b})}{{a}}$ uye kubva ku $t=x+k$, $t^2-{a}t+({a}k-({b}))=0$. Kuti ive nemidzi miviri yechokwadi yakasiyana isiri negative, $D={a}^2-4({a}k-({b}))>0$ uye chibereko ${a}k-({b})\ge 0$ (muwayo ${a}>0$), saka ${lt}\le k<{ht}$. Nhamba dzakazara $k$ dzinogutsa izvi kubva ku ${lo}$ kusvika ku ${hi}$ ndi${ans}$.

cm2_irrationalMinMax.prompt: Mutengo mukuru webasa $f(x)={fx}$ pa ${lo}\le x\le {hi}$ ndeupi? (Nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Nekuti chirevo chiri mukati meradical chilinear, $f(x)$ inochinja nenzira imwe chete kana $x$ ichikura. Saka enzanisa mitengo pamagumo maviri echikamu.
Tsvaga mitengo yebasa kana $x={lo}$ nekana $x={hi}$ wobva wasarudza huru.
cm2_irrationalMinMax.explanation: $f({lo})=\sqrt{{rl}}+({c})={flo}$, $f({hi})=\sqrt{{rh}}+({c})={fhi}$. Nekuti $f$ inongowedzera kana kudzikira muchikamu ichi, mutengo mukuru pakati pemitengo miviri ndiwo mutengo mukuru, ndi${ans}$.

cm2_irrationalPass.prompt: Poindi rimwe pa graph ye irrational function $y=\sqrt{a({xp})}{qs}$ ($a$ ikonsitanti isiri $0$) ndi $P({x0}, {y0})$. Mutengo we $a$ ndeupi? (Nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Pinza makomedheniti epoindi muchirevo. Chenjerera kuti square root haisi pasi pe $0$.
Siya radical chete wobva wasiya mativi ose maviri akaitwa masquare, wogadzirisa seequation yelinear ye $a$.
cm2_irrationalPass.explanation: Kana poindi $P$ ripinzwa, ${y0}=\sqrt{a({x0}-({p}))}+({q})$, saka $\sqrt{a\times({d})}={s}$. Kana mativi ose maviri akaitwa masquare, $a\times({d})={s2}$, saka $a={ans}$.

cm2_lineCircleCount.prompt: Denderedzwa $C$: ${circ}$, mutsetse $l$: ${line}$. Nhamba dzakazara dzakanaka $k$ dzinoita kuti $C$ ne $l$ zvisangane pamapoindi maviri akasiyana ndedzingani? (Nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Kana nhambwe pakati pepakati pedenderedzwa nemutsetse iri diki pane radius, zvinosangana pamapoindi maviri akasiyana.
Gadzira chirevo chenhambwe $\frac{|{u}\times({cx})+({w})\times({cy})-k|}{\sqrt{({u})^2+({w})^2}}<{rad}$ seinequality ye $k$.
cm2_lineCircleCount.explanation: Nhambwe kubva pakati $({cx}, {cy})$ kusvika pamutsetse inofanira kuva diki pane radius ${rad}$, saka $|{K0}-k|<{rad}\sqrt{({u})^2+({w})^2}=\sqrt{{R2}}$. Nhamba dzakazara dzinogutsa izvi ndi ${lo}\le k\le {hi}$, uye pakati peidzi huwandu hwenhamba dzakazara dzakanaka ndi${ans}$.

cm2_lineThroughPerp.prompt: Mutsetse unodarika papoindi $P({px}, {py})$ wakatwasuka pamutsetse $l$: ${line}$ (mutsetse unodarika papoindi $P$ uye wakatwasuka ku $l$) unosangana ne $y$-axis papoindi ine $y$-coordinate yei? (Nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Kana mitsetse miviri yakatwasuka, chibereko che slope dzayo ndi $-1$.
Tanga watsvaga slope ye $l$, wobva wagadzira equation yepoindi-slope uchishandisa slope yemutsetse wakatwasuka, wopinza $x=0$.
cm2_lineThroughPerp.explanation: Slope yemutsetse $l$ ndi${ms}$, saka slope yemutsetse wakatwasuka ndi${mp}$. Nekuti unodarika papoindi $P$, $y-({py})={mp}\left(x-({px})\right)$, uye kupinza $x=0$ kunopa $y={ans}$.

cm2_necessaryDiv.prompt: Pamamiriro maviri e nhamba yakazara $x$, $p$: $x$ ndiyo yakawanda ye $m$. $q$: $x$ ndiyo yakawanda ye ${n}$. Kune nhamba dzechisikigo $m$ dzakawanda sei dzinoita kuti $p$ ive mamiriro anodiwa e $q$ asi risiri mamiriro anokwana? (Nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Kana $p$ iri mamiriro anodiwa e $q$, $q\Rightarrow p$. Mu truth sets, $Q\subset P$.
Kuti dzese dzakawanda dze ${n}$ dzive dzakawanda dze $m$, $m$ inofanira kuva chigovanisi che ${n}$. Kuti risave mamiriro anokwana, $p\Rightarrow q$ haifaniri kuva yechokwadi.
cm2_necessaryDiv.explanation: Nekuti ndiro mamiriro anodiwa, $q\Rightarrow p$, kureva kuti dzese dzakawanda dze ${n}$ dzinofanira kuva dzakawanda dze $m$, izvo zvinoitika kana $m$ iri chigovanisi che ${n}$. Kuti risave mamiriro anokwana, $p\Rightarrow q$ inofanira kuva yenhema, asi kana $m$ iri chigovanisi che ${n}$, $p\Rightarrow q$ inongova yechokwadi kana $m={n}$. Zvigovanisi zve ${n}$ ndi${nd}$, saka huwandu hwe $m$ hunotsvakwa ndi ${nd}-1={ans}$.

cm2_perpParam.prompt: Kune mitsetse miviri $l_1: {l1}$, $l_2: {l2}$, tsvaga muwayo wemitengo yese yechokwadi $k$ inoita kuti mitsetse miviri ifanane kana kuti ive yakatwasuka. (Apa, kana mitsetse miviri ichienderana zvizere, haitorwi sekufanana.) (Nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Mitsetse miviri $ax+by+c=0$, $a'x+b'y+c'=0$ inofanana (kana kuenderana) kana $ab'-a'b=0$, uye yakatwasuka kana $aa'+bb'=0$.
Mamiriro ekufanana anova quadratic equation ye $k$, mamiriro ekutwasuka anova linear equation. Gadzirisa imwe neimwe wokokora mitengo yose.
cm2_perpParam.explanation: Ma coefficients e $x$, $y$ ye $l_1$ ndi${p}$, $k$ uye ma coefficients e $l_2$ ndi$k{qs}$, ${rr}$. Mamiriro ekufanana: ${p}\times({rr})=k(k{qs})$, kureva ${eqPar}=0$ inopa $k={k1}$ kana $k={k2}$ uye mitsetse haiwirirani mumhaka mbiri idzi. Mamiriro ekutwasuka: ${p}(k{qs})+({rr})k=0$ inopa $k={k3}$. Naizvozvo muwayo ndi${k1}+({k2})+({k3})={ans}$.

cm2_pointLineDist.prompt: Nhambwe kubva papoindi $P({x0}, {y0})$ kusvika pamutsetse ${line}$ ndeipi? (Unogona kunyora sedhesimali kana sechikamu seu 3/4)
hints: Nhambwe iri pakati pepoindi $(x_0,y_0)$ nemutsetse $ax+by+c=0$ ndi $\frac{|ax_0+by_0+c|}{\sqrt{a^2+b^2}}$.
Verenga numerator $|{a}\times({x0})+({b})\times({y0})+({c})|$, uye denominator ndi $\sqrt{({a})^2+({b})^2}$.
cm2_pointLineDist.explanation: Mu $\frac{|{a}\times({x0})+({b})\times({y0})+({c})|}{\sqrt{({a})^2+({b})^2}}$, numerator ndi${N}$ uye $\sqrt{({a})^2+({b})^2}={h}$, saka nhambwe ndi $\frac{{N}}{{h}}={ans}$.

cm2_rationalAsym.prompt: Kana ma asymptotes maviri e graph ye rational function $y=\frac{{num}}{{den}}$ ari mitsetse $x=p$, $y=q$, mutengo we $p+q$ ndeupi? (Unogona kunyora sedhesimali kana sechikamu seu 3/4)
hints: Mutengo we $x$ unoita kuti denominator ive $0$ ndiwo vertical asymptote.
Mutengo wakazosvika pedyo $y$ kana mutengo wakakwana we $x$ uchikura kwazvo ndiwo horizontal asymptote. Ndiwo chikamu che coefficients ye $x$ mu numerator ne denominator.
cm2_rationalAsym.explanation: Vertical asymptote ndiwo mutengo we $x$ unoita kuti denominator ive $0$, saka mutsetse $x={px}$. Kana $x\to\infty$, $y\to\frac{{a}}{{c}}={qy}$, saka horizontal asymptote ndi $y={qy}$. Naizvozvo $p+q=({px})+({qy})={ans}$.

cm2_rationalIntersectCount.prompt: Nhamba dzechiverengero $n$ dzakazara dzinoita kuti graph yeshanduro $y={fr}$ nemutsetse ${line}$ zvisangane panzvimbo mbiri, pakati pe $-{N}\le n\le {N}$ dziri ngani? (nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Batanidza hwaro hwezviviri kuti uite mutsauko wechipiri we $x$, uye fungidzira mamiriro ekuva nenzvimbo mbiri dzakasiyana (discriminant).
Nokuti takawanza nechirevo che $x$ kubvisa denominator, tarisa kuti midzi yemutsauko wechipiri haiite kuti denominator ive $0$.
cm2_rationalIntersectCount.explanation: Kana tabatanidza, kubva ku $\frac{{k}}{{den}}{qs}={mx}+n$ mushure mokubvisa denominator, discriminant yemutsauko wechipiri ndi $D=({nstr})^2{ds}$. (Midzi haiite kuti denominator ive $0$.) Nokuti $D>0$ inofanira kuvapo, bvisa nhamba dzakazara $n$ dzisingagutsi izvi: pakati pe${tot}$ dzehuwandu, ${bad}$ dzinobviswa, saka mhinduro ndi${ans}$.

cm2_rationalParam.prompt: Graph yeshanduro $y=\frac{k}{x}$ ($k$ inhamba isiri $0$) yakaendeswa ne${p}$ munzira ye $x$ uye ne${q}$ munzira ye $y$, ine nzvimbo imwe $P({x0}, {y0})$. Nzvimbo yayo inosangana ne$x$ axis ine $x$ coordinate ipi? (nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Kana tabva tamhanyisa, mukati mechirevo $x$ inova $x-({p})$, $y$ inova $y-({q})$.
Isa coordinates enzvimbo yakapihwa kuti uwane $k$, wobva waisa $y=0$.
cm2_rationalParam.explanation: Graph yakaendeswa ndi $y=\frac{k}{{xsh}}{ysh}$. Nokuti $P$ iri pagraph, kubva ku ${y0}=\frac{k}{{dx}}{ysh}$, $k={kk}$. Kana $y=0$, $\frac{{kk}}{{xsh}}={nq}$, saka $x={ans}$.

cm2_reflectChainOrder.prompt: Nzvimbo $P(a, b)$ yakaendeswa ne${m}$ munzira ye $x$ uye ne${n}$ munzira ye $y$ inova $Q$, $Q$ yakachinjirwa kuchigadziko inova $R$, $R$ yakachinjirwa pa$x$ axis inova $S$. Kana coordinates ye$S$ ari $({sx}, {sy})$, kukosha kwe $a+b$ ndekupi? (nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Kuchinjira pachigadziko ndi $(x,y)\to(-x,-y)$, kuchinjira pa$x$ axis ndi $(x,y)\to(x,-y)$.
Nokuti kuendesa kunotangira, shanduko inosanganisira huwandu hwakaendeswa. Dzokera kumashure danho rimwe nerimwe kubva ku $S$ kana kuratidza nga $a$, $b$.
cm2_reflectChainOrder.explanation: Kana tairatidza ne $a$, $b$: $Q(a+({m}), b+({n}))$, $R(-a-({m}), -b-({n}))$, $S(-a-({m}), b+({n}))$. Kubva ku $-a-({m})={sx}$, $a={pa}$, kubva ku $b+({n})={sy}$, $b={pb}$, saka $a+b={ans}$.

cm2_reflectCurve.prompt: Graph yeshanduro $y={orig}$ yakachinjirwa kuchigadziko, wobva waendeswa ne${m}$ munzira ye $x$ uye ne${n}$ munzira ye $y$. Kana vertex yeparabola iri $(s, t)$, kukosha kwe $s+t$ ndekupi? (nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Kuchinjira pachigadziko ndi $(x,y)\to(-x,-y)$, saka shandura $x$ kuva $-x$ uye $y$ kuva $-y$ muchirevo.
Unogona kuwana vertex yeparabola yekutanga woshandisa kushanduka kuviri nenzira, kana kuvaka chirevo chakashandurwa zvakananga.
cm2_reflectCurve.explanation: Vertex yeparabola yekutanga ndi $({h}, {k})$. Kana yachinjirwa kuchigadziko, inova parabola ye $y=-({orig2})$ ine vertex $({nh}, {nk})$. Kana yaendeswa ne${m}$ pa$x$ uye ne${n}$ pa$y$, $(s, t)=({s}, {t})$, saka $s+t={ans}$.

cm2_reflectPointChain.prompt: Nzvimbo $P(a, b)$ yakachinjirwa pamutsetse $y=x$ inova $Q$, $Q$ yakachinjirwa pa$y$ axis inova $R$, $R$ yakaendeswa ne${m}$ munzira ye $x$ uye ne${n}$ munzira ye $y$ inova $S$. Kana coordinates ye$S$ ari $({sx}, {sy})$, kukosha kwe $a+b$ ndekupi? (nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Kuchinjira pamutsetse $y=x$ ndi $(x,y)\to(y,x)$, kuchinjira pa$y$ axis ndi $(x,y)\to(-x,y)$.
Dzokera kumashure danho rimwe nerimwe kubva ku $S$, kana kuratidza coordinates kubva ku $P(a,b)$ kusvika ku $S$ nga $a$, $b$.
cm2_reflectPointChain.explanation: Kana tairatidza ne $a$, $b$: $Q(b, a)$, $R(-b, a)$, $S(-b+({m}), a+({n}))$. Kubva ku $-b+({m})={sx}$, $b={pb}$, kubva ku $a+({n})={sy}$, $a={pa}$, saka $a+b={ans}$.

cm2_reflectShortest.prompt: Pa-coordinate plane, pamapoinzi $A({a1}, {a2})$, $B({b1}, {b2})$ uye poindi $P$ inofamba paaxis ye-$x$, kukosha kudiki kwe-$\overline{A P}+\overline{P B}$ ndekupi? (Nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Sezvo mapoinzi maviri ari divi rimwe che-axis ye-$x$, kuratidza poindi imwe pane axis ye-$x$ kunogona kushandura $\overline{A P}+\overline{P B}$ kuita kureba kwemutsetse mumwe.
Kutora poindi $B'$ yakaratidzwa pane axis ye-$x$ kubva ku-$B$, $\overline{P B}=\overline{PB'}$ uye $\overline{A P}+\overline{PB'}\ge\overline{AB'}$.
cm2_reflectShortest.explanation: Kana poindi yakaratidzwa pane axis ye-$x$ kubva ku-$B$ ari $B'({b1}, {nb2})$, $\overline{P B}=\overline{PB'}$, saka $\overline{A P}+\overline{P B}\ge\overline{AB'}$, uye sezvo $A$ ne-$B'$ vari kumativi akapesana e-axis ye-$x$, chikamu $AB'$ chinosangana neaxis ye-$x$, saka kuenzana kunoitika. $\overline{AB'}=\sqrt{({b1}-({a1}))^2+({a2}-({nb2}))^2}=\sqrt{{dx}^2+{ss}^2}={ans}$.

cm2_setOpSum.prompt: $U$ iseti yenhamba dzose dzechisikigo dzakakura kana kuenzana ne-1 uye dzidiki kana kuenzana ne-${N}$, $A$ iseti yezvikamu zvose ze-${da}$ zviri pakati pemitezo ye-$U$, $B$ iseti yezviwanikwa zvose ze-${mb}$ zviri pakati pemitezo ye-$U$. Huwandu hwemitezo yose yeseti ${ex}$ hwakaita sei? (Nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Tanga wanyora $A$ ne-$B$ nekunyora mitezo.
Complement $X^c$ ndiyo inosara mushure mekubvisa mitezo ye-$X$ pa-$U$. Verenga uchitanga mukati mebhureketi.

cm2_setSumCount.prompt: Pamaseti maviri $A=\{{sa}\}$, $B=\{{sb}\}$, huwandu hwemitezo yose yeseti $C=\{x+y\mid x\in A,\ y\in B\}$ hwakaita sei? (Nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Sarudza mutezo mumwe we-$A$ nemumwe we-$B$ wozvibatanidza, uchigadzira zvose zvinogoneka.
Kunyange kana kukosha kumwe chetekuri kuchiitika kakawanda, mutezo weseti unoverengwa kamwe chete.
cm2_setSumCount.explanation: Kuwana huwandu hwose hunogoneka, kukosha kwakasiyana ndi${sc}$. Sezvo iseti inonyora mutezo mumwe chete kamwe chete, huwandu hwemitezo ndi${ans}$.

cm2_sufficientQuad.prompt: Pamamiriro maviri e-$x$ yenhamba yechokwadi $p$: $x>a$, $q$: ${quad}>0$. Kukosha kudiki kwenhamba yakazara $a$ inoita kuti $p$ ive mamiriro anokwana e-$q$ ndekupi? (Nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Kana $p$ iri mamiriro anokwana e-$q$, $p\Rightarrow q$, zvinoreva kuti iseti yechokwadi ye-$p$ iri mukati meseti yechokwadi ye-$q$.
Tanga wagadzirisa quadratic inequality ${quad}>0$ kuwana iseti yechokwadi ye-$q$.
cm2_sufficientQuad.explanation: Mhinduro ye-${quad}>0$ ndi$x<{Rs}$ kana $x>{Rl}$. Kuti iseti yechokwadi ye-$p$ $\{x\mid x>a\}$ ive mukati meiyi seti, $a\ge {Rl}$ inodiwa. Saka kukosha kudiki kwenhamba yakazara $a$ ndi${ans}$.

cm2_tangentAtPoint.prompt: Poindi iri patangent pa-poindi $({x1}, {y1})$ yedenderedzwa ${circ}$ ndi$Q({t}, k)$, kukosha kwe-$k$ kuri sei? (Nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Tangent pa-poindi iri padenderedzwa yakatarisana nemuromo wedenderedzwa unobatanidza iyo poindi nepakati.
Tanga wagadzira equation yetangent, wobva waisa makoodhi epoindi $Q$.
cm2_tangentAtPoint.explanation: Equation yetangent ndi${tang}$. Sezvo poindi $Q$ iri patangent, kuisa $x={t}$, $y=k$ kunopa $k={ans}$.

cm2_translateCurve.prompt: Kana graph yefunctioni $y={orig}$ ikafambiswa ne-$m$ munzira ye-axis ye-$x$ ne-$n$ munzira ye-axis ye-$y$, inowirirana negraph yefunctioni $y={img}$. Kukosha kwe-$m+n$ kuri sei? (Nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Kufambisa ne-$m$ munzira ye-axis ye-$x$ ne-$n$ munzira ye-axis ye-$y$, isa $x-m$ panzvimbo ye-$x$ ne-$y-n$ panzvimbo ye-$y$.
Wedzera $y-n=f(x-m)$ woenzanisa ma-coefficient e-$x$ kutanga kuwana $m$.
cm2_translateCurve.explanation: Equation yakafambiswa ndi$y-n={shift}$. Kuwedzera nekuenzanisa ma-coefficient e-$x$, ${b}-({tw})m={b2}$, saka $m={m}$, uye kuenzanisa nhamba isingachinji kunopa $n={n}$. Saka $m+n={ans}$.

cm2_truthRange.prompt: Kune mamiriro maviri $p$: ${quad}\le 0$, $q$: $|{cx}|\le a$ e nhamba chaidzo $x$, nhamba yechisikigo $a$ diki inoita kuti contrapositive yemataurirwo $p\to q$ ive yechokwadi ichidaidzwa kuti $\alpha$, uye nhamba yechisikigo $a$ hombe inoita kuti converse yemataurirwo $p\to q$ ive yechokwadi ichidaidzwa kuti $\beta$. Kukosha kwe $\alpha\beta$ ndekupi? (Nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Mataurirwo necontrapositive yawo vanogara vakaenzana muchokwadi nenhema. Converse $q\to p$ inofanira kutariswa yoga pachayo. Kana maseti echokwadi ari $P$, $Q$, kana $p\to q$ iri yechokwadi, $P\subset Q$.
Tanga wanyora $P$ segumo, uye gadzirisa $|{cx}|\le a$ kuti uratidze $Q$ ne $a$. Tsvaga renji ye $a$ inoita kuti contrapositive ive $P\subset Q$ uye converse ive $Q\subset P$.
cm2_truthRange.explanation: $P=\{x\mid {m}\le x\le {n}\}$ uye $|{cx}|\le a$ ndi $-a\le {cx}\le a$. Contrapositive yakaenzana nemataurirwo epakutanga muchokwadi nenhema, saka $P\subset Q$ inofanira kuvapo; pamigumo miviri ye $P$, $x={m}$ ne $x={n}$, kukosha kwe ${cx}$ ndi ${u}$ ne ${w}$, saka $a\ge {d1}$, $a\ge {d2}$. Nokudaro $\alpha={al}$. Converse inoda $Q\subset P$, uye $Q$ ndi ${lowS}\le {kx}\le {highS}$, saka ${lowS}\ge {km}$, ${highS}\le {kn}$, ndiko kuti $a\le {d1}$, $a\le {d2}$. Nokudaro $\beta={be}$ uye $\alpha\beta={al}\times{be}={ans}$.

cm2_vennReverse.prompt: Kune masubseti maviri $A$, $B$ eseti yose $U$, $n(U)={nu}$, $n(A)={na}$, $n(B)={nb}$, $n((A\cup B)^c)={nc}$. Kukosha kwe $n(A^c\cup B)$ ndekupi? (Nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Tanga wawana huwandu hwema element eunion nge $n(A\cup B)=n(U)-n((A\cup B)^c)$.
Shandisa kuti $A^c\cup B=(A-B)^c$, saka $n(A^c\cup B)=n(U)-n(A-B)$.
cm2_vennReverse.explanation: $n(A\cup B)={nu}-{nc}={un}$ uye $n(A\cap B)=n(A)+n(B)-n(A\cup B)={na}+{nb}-{un}={ab}$. $A^c\cup B=(A-B)^c$ uye $n(A-B)={na}-{ab}$, saka $n(A^c\cup B)={nu}-({na}-{ab})={ans}$.

cul_bordaMax.prompt: Uku ndiko kuvhota kweBorda kwekusarudza mumwe pakati pevamiriri A, B, C. Wekutanga anowana mapoinzi $2$, wechipiri $1$, wechitatu $0$. Kana mapepa ekuronga ari '{b1}' vanhu ${n1}$, '{b2}' vanhu ${n2}$, '{b3}' vanhu ${n3}$, huwandu hwemapoinzi hukuru pakati pevamiriri vatatu ndehupi? (Nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Tsvaga kuti mumiriri wese ari pachinzvimbo chipi papepa rimwe nerimwe rekuronga, wobva wasarudza mapoinzi.
Tsvaga huwandu hwemapoinzi evamiriri vatatu vose, wobva wasarudza hukuru.
cul_bordaMax.explanation: Huwandu hwemapoinzi aA ndi ${eA}$, aB ndi ${eB}$, aC ndi ${eC}$. Huwandu hukuru hwemapoinzi ndi ${ans}$.

cul_bordaTotal.prompt: Uku ndiko kuvhota kweBorda kwekusarudza mumwe pakati pevamiriri A, B, C. Wekutanga anowana mapoinzi $2$, wechipiri $1$, wechitatu $0$. Kana mapepa ekuronga ari 'A>B>C' vanhu ${n1}$, 'B>C>A' vanhu ${n2}$, 'C>A>B' vanhu ${n3}$, huwandu hwemapoinzi aA ndehupi? (Nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Tanga wawana kuti A ari pachinzvimbo chipi papepa rimwe nerimwe rekuronga.
Wedzera (huwandu hwevanhu)×(mapoinzi echinzvimbo) ose.
cul_bordaTotal.explanation: A ari wekutanga papepa rekutanga (mapoinzi 2), wechitatu papepa rechipiri (mapoinzi 0), uye wechipiri papepa rechitatu (mapoinzi 1), saka ${n1}\times2+{n2}\times0+{n3}\times1={ans}$ mapoinzi.

cul_brailleAtMost.prompt: Sero rimwe rebraille rine nzvimbo ${d}$ dzinogona kuiswa madotsi, uye nzvimbo imwe neimwe inogona kusimuka kana kusasimuka. Pasero rimwe, mafomu akasiyana ane madotsi akasimuka kubva pa 1 kusvika pa ${k}$ ndeapi mazhinji? (Nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Huwandu hwemafomu ane madotsi akasimuka chaiwo $j$ inhamba yenzira dzekusarudza $j$ pakati penzvimbo ${d}$.
Verengera imwe neimwe kubva ku $j=1$ kusvika ku $j={k}$ wobva wawedzera.
cul_brailleAtMost.explanation: Mafomu ane madotsi akasimuka $j$ ndeye $_{{d}}\mathrm{C}_{j}$ nzira, saka ${terms}={ans}$ nzira.

cul_pitchFifth.prompt: Frequency yenoti yekutanga ndi ${f}$ Hz. Kubva panoti yakakwidzwa ne octave ${k}$, noti iri pamusoro pe perfect fifth (frequency ratio $3:2$) ine frequency ye Hz ngani? (Nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Noti iri octave pamusoro ine frequency yakapetwa kaviri.
Perfect fifth pamusoro, wanza frequency ne $\frac{3}{2}$.
cul_pitchFifth.explanation: Octave ${k}$ pamusoro: ${f}\times 2^{{k}}={mid}$ Hz, perfect fifth pamusoro: ${mid}\times\frac{3}{2}={ans}$ Hz.

cul_stringLength.prompt: Mumigodhi yezvishandiso zvetambo, kana tambo ichipfupika frequency inokwira, uye kana ukobvu nekusimba kwetambo zvakafanana, frequency inoenderana zvakapindururwa (inversely proportional) neurefu hwetambo. Kana tambo ine urefu ${L}$ cm ichibudisa noti ye ${f}$ Hz, kana tambo imwe chete ikadzvanywa kuti chikamu chinodengenyeka chipfupike kusvika ${L2}$ cm, frequency yenoti inobuda ndi Hz ngani? (Nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Kukosha kwe (frequency)×(urefu) hakuchinji.
Patsanura kukosha kwe ${f}\times{L}$ neurefu hutsva ${L2}$ cm.

cul_voteGuarantee.prompt: Vamiriri A, B, C vari kukwikwidza mukuvhota umo mumwe chete ane mavhoti mazhinji ndiye anokunda. Mhedzisiro yepakati pekuverengwa ndi A ${a}$ mavhoti, B ${b}$, C ${c}$, uye mavhoti ${m}$ achiri kusara asati averengwa. Kuti C azokunda ari ega pakutanga zvisinei nokuti mavhoti asara anogoverwa sei kuna A naB, C anofanira kuwana mavhoti mangani pamashoma pamavhoti ${m}$ asara? (Nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Kana C akawana mavhoti $x$ kubva pamavhoti asara, mavhoti ${m}$−$x$ asara anoenda kune vamwe vamiriri. Mamiriro akaipisisa ndeekuti ese anoenda kumumiriri ari kutungamira zvino.
Mavhoti aC anofanira kuva mazhinji kupfuura (kwete kuenzana) neemumiriri ari kumberi. Gadzira inequality wobva watsvaga integer duku $x$.
cul_voteGuarantee.explanation: Mavhoti akawanda zvino ndi ${M}$. Kana C akawana mavhoti $x$ kubva pasara uye mavhoti ${m}-x$ asara ese akaenda kumumiriri ane ${M}$, zvinofanira kuva ${c}+x>{M}+({m}-x)$. Kurongedza kunopa $x>{half}$, saka integer duku ndi ${ans}$.

econ_annuityPV.prompt: Pane pension inowanikwa ${A}$ won pagore rega rega mugore rekupedzisira, kwemakore ${n}$ (kubhadhara kwekutanga mushure megore rimwe, kwekupedzisira mushure memakore ${n}$). Kana interest rate yegore ndi ${r}$% ichiverengwa nekuwedzera pagore, present value yepension iyi ndi won mangani? (Zvisingasvike won zvinosiiwa. Nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Imhaka yekudzora kubhadhara kwega kwega kuenda pakukosha kwazvino kwenguva yekubhadhara, wobva wawedzera zvese.
Kana interest rate $i=\frac{{r}}{100}$, present value ndi $A\times\frac{1-(1+i)^{-{n}}}{i}$.
econ_annuityPV.explanation: $i={r}/100$, saka present value ndi ${A}\times\frac{1-(1+i)^{-{n}}}{i}\approx{ex}$ won, uye kana zvisingasvike won zvikasiiwa ndi ${ans}$ won.

econ_compoundFV.prompt: Pane deposit ine compound interest yegore ndi ${r}$%, interest ichiwedzerwa kuprincipal ${m}$ pagore, uye ${P}$ won inochengetwa kwemakore ${n}$. Interest rate pakuverenga kumwe chete ndi (annual rate)$\div{m}$, uye hapana mari inobviswa pakati. Huwandu hwose mushure memakore ${n}$ ndi won mangani? (Zvisingasvike won zvinosiiwa. Nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Huwandu hwekuverenga interest ndi (nhamba yekuverenga pagore)×(makore).
Shandisa interest rate ${rp}$% pakuverenga kumwe chete: huwandu hwose ndi principal yakawanzwa ne $(1+\frac{{rp}}{100})$ yakapetwa nhamba yekuverenga.
econ_compoundFV.explanation: Nhamba yekuverenga ndi ${m}\times{n}={k}$, rate yekuverenga kumwe ndi ${rp}$%, saka huwandu hwose ndi ${P}\times(1+\frac{{rp}}{100})^{{k}}\approx{ex}$ won, uye kana zvisingasvike won zvikasiiwa ndi ${ans}$ won.

econ_elasticityPoint.prompt: Demand function ndi $q={D}$ ($p$ ndiyo mutengo, $q$ ndiyo huwandu hunodiwa). Kana mutengo uri $p={p0}$, kukosha kwe price elasticity of demand $e=\left|q'(p)\times\frac{p}{q}\right|$ ndekupi? (Nyora segumi risingaite kuita zvidimbu zvidiki. Kana iri nhamba yose, nyora nhamba yose. Muenzaniso: 3/4)
hints: Tanga watsvaga $q'(p)$ wobva wawana kukosha kwayo pa $p={p0}$.
Tsvaga zvakare huwandu hunodiwa $q$ pa $p={p0}$ wobva waisa mu formula ye $e$.
econ_elasticityPoint.explanation: Kukosha kwe $q'(p)$ pa $p={p0}$ ndi ${dqv}$, huwandu hunodiwa ndi $q={qv}$, saka $e=\frac{{adq}\times{p0}}{{qv}}={fr}$.

econ_elasticityUnit.prompt: Muchiitiko chekudiwa $q={D}$, mutengo $p$ uri kuita price elasticity $e=\left|q'(p)\times\frac{p}{q}\right|$ yakaenzana ne1 ndeupi? (Fungira renji apo $p>0$ uye huwandu hunodiwa $q>0$.) (Nyora nhamba chete.)
hints: Wana $q'(p)$, wobva wanyora $\left|q'(p)\times\frac{p}{q}\right|=1$ seequation ye$p$.
Murenji une $q>0$, $q'(p)<0$, saka kubvisa absolute value kunopa $-q'(p)\times p=q$.
econ_elasticityUnit.explanation: $q'(p)={dq}$, saka kubva pa$-q'(p)\times p=q$, ${eqn}$, uye mhinduro ine $p>0$ ndi$p={ans}$.

econ_equilibriumTable.prompt: Huwandu hunodiwa hwechigadzirwa chimwe chiri ${qd1}$ kana mutengo uri ${p1}$ won, ${qd2}$ kana ${p2}$ won, uye huwandu hunopihwa hwakaita ${qs1}$ kana mutengo uri ${p3}$ won, ${qs2}$ kana ${p4}$ won. Kana huwandu hunodiwa nehunopihwa zvose zviri linear functions zvemutengo, mutengo wekuenzana apo huwandu hunodiwa nehunopihwa zvakaenzana ndi won mangani? (Nyora nhamba chete.)
hints: Shandisa slope yemutsetse unopfuura pamapoinzi maviri kuwana kuti huwandu hunodiwa nehunopihwa hunochinja zvakadini nemutengo.
Tora huwandu hunodiwa se$Q_d$, hunopihwa se$Q_s$, uye wana mutengo une $Q_d=Q_s$.
econ_equilibriumTable.explanation: Mwero wekuchinja kwehuwandu hunodiwa ndi$\frac{{qd2}-{qd1}}{{p2}-{p1}}={md}$, saka $Q_d={qd1}{md}(p-{p1})$, mwero wekuchinja kwehunopihwa ndi${ns}$, saka $Q_s={qs1}+{ns}(p-{p3})$. Kugadzirisa $Q_d=Q_s$ kunopa $p={ans}$ won.

econ_exchangeCross.prompt: Exchange rate ndi 1 dhora $={d}$ won, 1 yuro $={e}$ won. Kana ${n}$ yuro dzikashandurwa kuita madhora pasina commission, madhora mangani? (Nyora nhamba chete.)
hints: Tanga wawana kuti ${n}$ yuro ndi won ingani.
Govanisa mari iyo yewon nemutengo wedhora rimwe, ${d}$ won.

econ_inverseEntry.prompt: Chikamu che$({i}, {j})$ che inverse matrix $A^{-1}$ ye matrix $A={M}$ ndechipi? (Chikamu che$(i, j)$ chiri pamutsara we$i$ nepanhare ye$j$.) (Nyora sechikamu chisingaderedzwi. Kana iri nhamba yakazara, nyora sanhamba yakazara. Muenzaniso: 3/4)
hints: Determinant ye matrix ${G}$ ndi$ad-bc$. Kana isiri 0, inverse iripo.
Inverse ndi${H}$.
econ_inverseEntry.explanation: Determinant ndi${ap}\times{dp}-{bp}\times{cp}={det}$, uye chikamu che$({i}, {j})$ che$A^{-1}$ ndi$\frac{{num}}{{det}}$, ndiko kuti ${fr}$.

econ_leontief.prompt: Input coefficient matrix yemaindasitiri maviri 1, 2 ndi$A={M}$ (chikamu che$(i, j)$ che$A$ ihuwandu hwechigadzirwa chaindasitiri $i$ chinodiwa kana indasitiri $j$ ichigadzira chikamu chimwe). Kana huwandu hwose hwakagadzirwa neindasitiri mbiri ari $x_1$, $x_2$ (unit: 100 million won), uye final demand ari $d_1={d1}$, $d_2={d2}$, ${XV}=A{XV}+{DV}$ inosimbiswa. $x_1$ ndeupi? (Nyora nhamba chete.)
hints: Chinja equation kuita $(I-A){XV}={DV}$.
Wana inverse ye$I-A$ uivhiye ne${DV}$. Inverse ye$2\times2$ matrix ndiyo matrix ine zvikamu zvakaronga zvakare yakavhiyiwa ne$\frac{1}{ad-bc}$.

econ_marginalRevenue.prompt: Demand curve yechigadzirwa chimwe ndi$p={a}-{b}q$ ($p$ mutengo (won), $q$ huwandu hwakatengeswa). Total revenue ndi$R(q)=pq$, uye marginal revenue ndi$R'(q)$, derivative ye$R(q)$ maererano ne$q$. Huwandu hwakatengeswa $q$ apo marginal revenue iri ${m}$ won ndehupi? (Nyora nhamba chete.)
hints: Isa $p={a}-{b}q$ mu$R(q)=pq$ kuti unyore $R(q)$ sefomula ye$q$.
Wana $q$ apo derivative ye$R(q)$ ine kukosha kwe${m}$ won.

econ_presentValue.prompt: Mwero wegore rekubhadhara wenhoroondo ndi${r}$% unoverengwa nechikwereti chakawedzerwa gore rimwe nerimwe. Kukosha kwanhasi kwe${F}$ won dzichatambirwa mushure megore ${n}$ ndekwema won mangani? (siya zvakapoteredza zvisingasvike pawon imwe. Nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Kukosha kwanhasi $P$ ndiko kunoita kuti $P$ yakawedzerwa nechikwereti kwemakore ${n}$ ive ${F}$ won.
Verenga $P=F\div(1+\frac{{r}}{100})^{{n}}$.
econ_presentValue.explanation: $P={F}\div(1+\frac{{r}}{100})^{{n}}\approx{ex}$ won, uye kana zvisingasvike pawon imwe zvasiiwa, ndi${ans}$ won.

econ_profitCubic.prompt: Mari yose yekugadzira chigadzirwa chimwe $q$ ndi$C(q)=q^3-{b}q^2+{c}q+{f}$ (won), uye mutengo wekutengesa uri ${p}$ won pachimwe uye hausi kushanduka. Kana zvigadzirwa zvose zvakagadzirwa zvichitengeswa, purofiti (mari yose yawanikwa kubvisa mari yose yakashandiswa) yakanyanya ndeyema won mangani? ($q$ inhamba chaiyo isingaite pasi pe0.) (nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Purofiti ndi$\pi(q)={p}q-C(q)$. Siyanisa wobva wawana $q$ inoita $\pi'(q)=0$.
Pamudzi wakanaka we$\pi'(q)=-3q^2+{twob}q+{pc}=0$, chiratidzo che$\pi'(q)$ chinoshanduka kubva pa+ kuenda pa-.
econ_profitCubic.explanation: Sezvo $\pi(q)={p}q-C(q)$, $\pi'(q)=-3q^2+{twob}q+{pc}=-3(q-{q0})(q+{s})$. Pa$q\ge0$, $\pi'$ yakanaka pamberi pe$q={q0}$ uye isina kunaka shure kwayo, saka kukosha kwakanyanya kuri pa$q={q0}$ uye $\pi({q0})={ans}$ won.

econ_regionLP.prompt: Pane fekitori inogadzira zvigadzirwa A zvakawanda $x$ nezvigadzirwa B zvakawanda $y$ ($x$, $y$ nhamba dzakazara dzisingapfuure pasi pe0). Zvinhu nenguva yebasa inodiwa pachigadzirwa chimwe zvegadzirwa A ndi${a1}$ kg, maawa ${t1}$, uye zvegadzirwa B ndi${b1}$ kg, maawa ${t2}$. Zvinhu zvinogona kushandiswa pazuva hazvipfuure ${M}$ kg, nguva yebasa yevashandi vose pamwechete haipfuuri maawa ${T}$, uye purofiti ndi${pa}$ (yezviuru gumi zvewon) pachigadzirwa A chimwe nechimwe, ${pb}$ (yezviuru gumi zvewon) pachigadzirwa B chimwe nechimwe. Purofiti yakanyanya pazuva ndeyezviuru gumi zvewon zvingani? (nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Nyora mamiriro seinikwoyriti, uye uaratidze sedunhu paplani yemakoodhineti pamwe chete ne$x\ge0$, $y\ge0$.
Purofiti ${pa}x+{pb}y$ inova yakanyanya pane rimwe remakona edunhu. Tanga wacheka chisvitsa chekusangana kwemitsetse miviri yemuganhu.
econ_regionLP.explanation: Maikwoyriti ndi${a1}x+{b1}y\le{M}$, ${t1}x+{t2}y\le{T}$, $x\ge0$, $y\ge0$. Kona ine purofiti yakanyanya ndicho chisvitsa chekusangana kwemitsetse miviri yemuganhu $({x0}, {y0})$, uye chisvitsa ichi chine nhamba dzakazara, saka purofiti yakanyanya ndi${pa}\times{x0}+{pb}\times{y0}={ans}$ (yezviuru gumi zvewon).

econ_taxBracket.prompt: Mutero wemubhadharo munyika imwe unokamura mari inobhadharirwa mutero kuita zvikamu, uye chikamu chimwe nechimwe chine mwero wemutero wakasiyana. Pachikamu chisingapfuuri ${b1}$ (yezviuru gumi zvewon) ndi${r1}$%, pachikamu chinopfuura ${b1}$ asi chisingapfuuri ${b2}$ (yezviuru gumi zvewon) ndi${r2}$%, uye pachikamu chinopfuura ${b2}$ (yezviuru gumi zvewon) ndi${r3}$%. Kana mari inobhadharirwa mutero iri ${x1}$ (yezviuru gumi zvewon), mutero unofanira kubhadharwa ndewezviuru gumi zvewon zvingani? (nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Mwero wemutero unoshanda chete pamari iri mukati mechikamu. Tanga wawana mari iri muchikamu chimwe nechimwe.
Wedzera (mari yechikamu)×(mwero wemutero) zvose.
econ_taxBracket.explanation: Mari yechikamu chimwe nechimwe ndi${s1}$, ${s2}$, ${s3}$ (yezviuru gumi zvewon), saka mutero ndi${s1}\times\frac{{r1}}{100}+{s2}\times\frac{{r2}}{100}+{s3}\times\frac{{r3}}{100}={ans}$ (yezviuru gumi zvewon).

econ_taxEquilibrium.prompt: Mutsetse wekudiwa kwechinhu chimwe ndi$p={a}-{b}q$, uye mutsetse wekupihwa ndi$p={c}+{d}q$. Pano $p$ mutengo (won), $q$ huwandu (zvikamu). Kana hurumende ikaisa mutero we${t}$ won pakutengesa chikamu chimwe nechimwe kune vanopa, vanopa vanowana mutengo wakabhadharwa nevatengi wabvisirwa mutero. Mutengo unobhadharwa nevatengi pakuenzana mushure mekuisa mutero ndewema won mangani? (nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Mutengo unowanikwa chaizvo nevanopa ndi$p-{t}$.
Isa $p-{t}$ pachinzvimbo che$p$ pamutsetse wekupihwa, wobva waisa mutsetse wekudiwa $p={a}-{b}q$ kuti uwane $q$.
econ_taxEquilibrium.explanation: Mutengo unowanikwa nevanopa ndi$p-{t}$, saka $({a}-{b}q)-{t}={c}+{d}q$. Kana yagadziriswa, $q={qn}$, uye mutengo unobhadharwa nevatengi ndi$p={a}-{b}\times{qn}={ans}$ won.

econ_utilityBundle.prompt: Chinhu x chinodhura ${a}$ won chimwe, chinhu y chinodhura ${b}$ won chimwe. Unoda kushandisa bhajeti yose ye ${I}$ won pasina chasara kutenga $x$ x uye $y$ y ($x$, $y$ nhamba dzakazara dzisingasviki pa 0). Kana utility yakapiwa ndi $U={U}$, utility $U$ yakanyanya ndeipi? (Nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Tsvaga nhamba dzese dzakazara $(x, y)$ dzisingasviki pa 0 dzinogutsa equation yebhajeti ${a}x+{b}y={I}$.
Verenga mutengo we $U$ weboka rimwe nerimwe $(x, y)$ rawawana wobva waenzanisa.
econ_utilityBundle.explanation: $(x, y)$ dzinogutsa equation yebhajeti ndi${pairs}$. Pakati peidzi, jaya rine mutengo mukuru we $U$ ndi $(x, y)=({bx}, {by})$ (kana mijaya yakawanda ine mutengo mukuru wakafanana, imwe yadzo), uye ipapo $U={ans}$.

geo_conicGeneral.prompt: Pakati pema foci e conic ${eq}$, rega focus ine $x$-coordinate huru (kana pane focus imwe chete, ndiyo iyoyo) ive $(a,\ b)$. Mutengo we $a+b$ ndeupi? (Nyora senhamba yakazara. Kana iri negative, wedzera -)
hints: Chinja $x$ ne $y$ imwe neimwe kuita perfect square kuti uwane standard form.
Verenga center (kana vertex) kubva ku standard form, wobva wafamisa $c$ (kana $p$ kune parabola) munzira ine focus; poindi iri ndiyo focus.
geo_conicGeneral.explanation: Kana yachinjwa kuita perfect squares, ${std}$. Focus ndi${foc}$, saka $a+b={ans}$.

geo_conicParam.prompt: Kana nhambwe pakati pema foci maviri e curve ${eq}$ iri ${fd}$ uye ${cond}$, mutengo we $k$ ndeupi? (Nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Kana nhambwe pakati pema foci maviri iri $2c$, unogona kutanga watsvaga mutengo we $c$. Sarudzawo denominator ndeyipi ine $a^2$.
Ye ellipse $c^2=a^2-b^2$, ye hyperbola $c^2=a^2+b^2$. Tsvaga $k$ kubva muequation iyi.
geo_conicParam.explanation: Nekuti nhambwe pakati pema foci maviri ndi $2c={fd}$, $c={c}$, $c^2={c2}$. Nekuti ${work}$, $k={ans}$.

geo_conicTangentLine.prompt: Pamutsetse ${ln}$ unobata curve ${eq}$, mutengo wakanaka $k$ ndeupi? (Nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Pinza equation yemutsetse mu equation ye curve kuti uwane quadratic equation ye $x$; kana unobata, discriminant ndi $0$.
Wana chirevo che $k$ kubva ku discriminant $D=0$.
geo_conicTangentLine.explanation: Kana equation yemutsetse yapinzwa mu equation ye curve kuti ipe quadratic equation ye $x$, ndi${quad}$, uye nekuti unobata, discriminant $D=0$. Nekuti ${work}$, mutengo wakanaka $k$ ndi${ans}$.

geo_divPoint.prompt: Kune mapoindi maviri $A{pa}$, $B{pb}$ munzvimbo ine coordinates, poindi P iri pachikamu AB uye $AP:PB={m}:{n}$. Muwayo wema coordinates matatu epoindi P ndeupi? (Nyora senhamba yakazara. Kana iri negative, wedzera -)
hints: Poindi rinogovanisa chikamu AB mukuwirirana kwe $m:n$ ndi $\left(\frac{mx_2+nx_1}{m+n},\ \frac{my_2+ny_1}{m+n},\ \frac{mz_2+nz_1}{m+n}\right)$.
Verenga coordinate imwe neimwe zvakasiyana.
geo_divPoint.explanation: $P=\left(\frac{{n}\,x_A+{m}\,x_B}{{mn}},\ \frac{{n}\,y_A+{m}\,y_B}{{mn}},\ \frac{{n}\,z_A+{m}\,z_B}{{mn}}\right)={pp}$, saka muwayo wema coordinates matatu ndi${ans}$.

geo_divRatioPlane.prompt: Kune mapoindi maviri $A{pa}$, $B{pb}$ munzvimbo ine coordinates, rega P ive poindi apo chikamu AB chinosangana ne plane ${pl}$. Kana $AP:PB=m:n$ ($m$, $n$ nhamba dzechisikigo dzisina chinhu chakafanana), mutengo we $m+n$ ndeupi? (Nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Poindi riri pa plane ${pl}$ rine coordinate imwe iri $0$.
Taura coordinate iyoyo yepoindi rinogovanisa chikamu AB mu $s:t$ ne $s$, $t$, wobva waiisa yakaenzana ne $0$.
geo_divRatioPlane.explanation: Kana $AP:PB=s:t$, coordinate inoenderana yepoindi P inofanira kuva $\frac{t\cdot({za})+s\cdot({zb})}{s+t}=0$, saka $s:t=|{za}|:|{zb}|={ua}:{ub}$. Kana yadzikiswa kusvika pakusina chinhu chakafanana, ndi${m}:{n}$, saka $m+n={ans}$.

geo_dotAngle.prompt: Kana angle iri pakati pema vector maviri $\vec a={va}$, $\vec b={vb}$ iri $\theta$ ($0^\circ\le\theta\le180^\circ$), kukosha kwe $\theta$ ndekupi? (Nyora nhamba yedhigirii chete)
hints: Cosine yeangle iri pakati pema vector maviri ndi $\cos\theta=\frac{\vec a\cdot\vec b}{|\vec a||\vec b|}$.
Tsvaga dot product nehukuru hwevector imwe neimwe.
geo_dotAngle.explanation: $\vec a\cdot\vec b={dt}$, $|\vec a||\vec b|=\sqrt{{na2}}\sqrt{{nb2}}=\sqrt{{pr}}={rt}$, saka $\cos\theta=\frac{{dt}}{{rt}}={cs}$. Kubva ku $0^\circ\le\theta\le180^\circ$, $\theta={ans}^\circ$.

geo_dotNormExpand.prompt: Kune ma vector maviri $\vec a$, $\vec b$, kana $|\vec a|={na}$, $|\vec b|={nb}$, $\vec a\cdot\vec b={dt}$, kukosha kwe $|{ex}|^2$ ndekupi? (Nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Nokuti $|\vec x|^2=\vec x\cdot\vec x$, wedzera ${ex}$ nekuita dot product nayo pachayo.
Ratidza nge $|\vec a|^2$, $|\vec b|^2$, $\vec a\cdot\vec b$ wobva waisa kukosha.

geo_ellipseExtSum.prompt: Imwe focus yeellipse ${eq}$ ndi $F({fx},\ {fy})$, uye poindi iri mukati meellipse ine coordinate $A({xa},\ {ya})$. Kana poindi P iri paellipse ichifamba, chibereko chekukosha kukuru nekukosha kudiki kwe $PA+PF$ ndechipi? (Nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Kana imwe focus iri F', $PF=2a-PF'$. Saka $PA+PF=2a+(PA-PF')$.
Kubva patriangle inequality, $-AF'\le PA-PF'\le AF'$, uye nokuti A iri mukati meellipse, kuenzana kose kunogoneka.
geo_ellipseExtSum.explanation: Kana imwe focus iri F', $PA+PF=2a+(PA-PF')$, uye $a={a}$, $AF'={dd}$. Nokuti $-AF'\le PA-PF'\le AF'$, kukosha kukuru ndi $2a+AF'={mx}$, kudiki ndi $2a-AF'={mn}$, uye chibereko ndi ${ans}$.

geo_ellipseFocal.prompt: Ma focus maviri eellipse ${eq}$ ndi F, F'. Kana poindi P iri paellipse ichiita ${cond}$, kukosha kwe ${ask}$ ndekupi? (Nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Huwandu hwekureba kubva papoindi iri paellipse kusvika kuma focus maviri hwakagara, uye kukosha kwahwo ndiko kureba kwemajor axis.
Kana kureba kwemajor axis kuri $2a$ uye kureba pakati pema focus maviri kuri $2c$, $a={a}$, $c={c}$. Edza kushandisa $PF+PF'=2a$.
geo_ellipseFocal.explanation: Kureba kwemajor axis ndi $2a={tw}$, kureba pakati pema focus maviri ndi $2c={tc}$, saka $PF+PF'={tw}$, $FF'={tc}$. Nokuti ${work}$, kukosha kunotsvagwa ndi ${ans}$.

geo_ellipseFromEq.prompt: Kureba pakati pema focus maviri eellipse ${eq}$ ndekupi? (Nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Kana ukanyora equation yeellipse muchimiro che $\frac{x^2}{\square}+\frac{y^2}{\square}=1$ ine kurudyi $1$, denominator huru pakati pemaviri ndiyo $a^2$.
Ma denominator maviri ndi ${a2}$ ne ${b2}$, uye $c^2=a^2-b^2$.
geo_ellipseFromEq.explanation: Kana tikainyora muchimiro che ${std}$, $a^2={a2}$, $b^2={b2}$, saka $c^2=a^2-b^2={c2}$, $c={c}$. Kureba pakati pema focus maviri ndi $2c={ans}$.

geo_ellipseRightTri.prompt: Ma focus maviri eellipse ${eq}$ ndi F, F'. Kana poindi P iri paellipse ichiita $\angle FPF'=90^\circ$, nzvimbo yetriangle PFF' ndeipi? (Nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Kubva pamutsanangurwa weellipse, $PF+PF'=2a$, uye nokuti ndiyo triangle yakarurama, $PF^2+PF'^2=(FF')^2$.
Shandisa $(PF+PF')^2=PF^2+PF'^2+2\,PF\cdot PF'$ kuti utsvage $PF\cdot PF'$.
geo_ellipseRightTri.explanation: $a^2={a2}$, $b^2={b2}$, $c^2={c2}$, saka $PF+PF'=2a={tw}$, $FF'=2c={tc}$. Nokuti $PF^2+PF'^2={tc2}$, $2\,PF\cdot PF'=({tw})^2-{tc2}$, ndiko kuti $PF\cdot PF'={pr}$. Nzvimbo ndi $\frac{1}{2}\times PF\times PF'={ans}$.

geo_hyperAsym.prompt: Pamitsetse miviri yeasymptote yehaipabora ${eq}$, mutero wemutsetse une mutero wakanaka ndewei? (nyora sechikamu chakapfupikiswa. Kana inhamba yakazara, nyora senhamba yakazara. Muenzaniso: 3/4)
hints: Asymptote dze haipabora $\frac{x^2}{a^2}-\frac{y^2}{b^2}=1$ ndi$y=\pm\frac{b}{a}x$, uye dze$\frac{y^2}{a^2}-\frac{x^2}{b^2}=1$ ndi$y=\pm\frac{a}{b}x$.
Kana parutivi rwekurudyi paikwesheni pasiri $1$, tanga wapaita $1$, wobva wauraya $a^2$, $b^2$ panhamba dzekuzasi dze$x^2$, $y^2$.
geo_hyperAsym.explanation: Sezvo iri muchimiro che${std}$, asymptote ndi${asy}$. Mutero weasymptote ine mutero wakanaka ndi${ansf}$.

geo_hyperFocal.prompt: Ngatitaure kuti mafokasi maviri ehaipabora ${eq}$ ndi F, F'. Kana chisvitsa P chiri pahaipabora chiine ${cond}$, kukosha kwe${ask}$ kuri kupi? (nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Kukosha kusina chiratidzo kwemusiyano wemwero kubva pachisvitsa chiri pahaipabora kuenda pamafokasi maviri kwakaenzana nekureba kweaxis huru $2a$.
$a={a}$, $c={c}$, saka $|PF-PF'|=2a={tw}$, uye mwero kubva pachisvitsa chiri pahaipabora kuenda pafokasi imwe neimwe ndi$c-a={ca}$ kana kupfuura.
geo_hyperFocal.explanation: $a={a}$, $b={b}$, $c={c}$ uye $|PF-PF'|=2a={tw}$. Panguva ino, ${work}$, saka P iri pasanga riri padhuze ne F uye $PF'>PF$. (Kana $PF'=PF-2a$, ${alt}$ inova diki kupfuura $c-a$, izvo zvisingaite.) Saka ${work2}$, uye kukosha kunotsvakwa ndi${ans}$.

geo_hyperFocalRel.prompt: Ngatitaure kuti mafokasi maviri ehaipabora ${eq}$ ndi F, F'. Kana chisvitsa P chiri pahaipabora chiine ${cond}$, kukosha kwe${ask}$ kuri kupi? (nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Kukosha kusina chiratidzo kwemusiyano wemwero kubva pachisvitsa chiri pahaipabora kuenda pamafokasi maviri kwakaenzana nekureba kweaxis huru $2a$.
$a={a}$, $c={c}$, saka $|PF-PF'|=2a={tw}$, uye mwero kubva pachisvitsa chiri pahaipabora kuenda pafokasi imwe neimwe ndi$c-a={ca}$ kana kupfuura.

geo_lineIntersectParam.prompt: Munzvimbo, kana mitsetse miviri ${l1}$, ${l2}$ ichisangana pachisvitsa chimwe, kukosha kwekoronstanti $k$ kuri kupi? (nyora senhamba yakazara. Kana isina kunaka wedzera -)
hints: Tora kukosha kwakajairika kwemutsetse mumwe nemumwe se$s$, $t$ wobva wanyora makoodhineti ezvisvitsa zviri pamutsetse uchishandisa $s$, $t$.
Wana $s$, $t$ kubva paikwesheni inoti makoodhineti e$x$, $y$ akaenzana, wobva waenzanisa makoodhineti e$z$.
geo_lineIntersectParam.explanation: Kana kukosha kwakajairika kwemutsetse wekutanga kuri $s$ uye kwewechipiri $t$, makoodhineti e$x$, $y$ anofanira kuenzana, saka ${xy}$, uye kana yagadziriswa, $s={ss}$, $t={tt}$. Makoodhineti e$z$ anofanirawo kuenzana, saka ${eq3}$ uye $k={ans}$.

geo_lineSpacePoint.prompt: Pazvisvitsa zviri pamutsetse ${ln}$ pane chisvitsa chine ${cond}$. Huwandu hwemakoodhineti maviri asara echisvitsa ichi ndehwei? (nyora senhamba yakazara. Kana isina kunaka wedzera -)
hints: Kana kukosha kwakajairika kwezvikamu zvitatu kuri $s$, unogona kunyora $x$, $y$, $z$ zvose uchishandisa $s$.
Tanga wawana $s$ kubva pamamiriro akapiwa ${cond}$.
geo_lineSpacePoint.explanation: Kana kukosha kwakajairika kuri $s$, $(x,\ y,\ z)=({par})$. Kubva pa${cond}$, $s={ss}$, saka chisvitsa ichi ndi${pt}$, uye huwandu hwemakoodhineti maviri asara ndi${ans}$.

geo_parFocusDir.prompt: Pachisvitsa $P(x,\ y)$ chiri paparaboro ine fokasi $F({fx},\ {fy})$ uye directrix ${dirEq}$, kana ${cond}$, kukosha kwakanyanya kwe${un}$ kuri kupi? (nyora senhamba yakazara. Kana isina kunaka wedzera -)
hints: Chisvitsa chiri paparaboro chine mwero kubva pafokasi wakaenzana nemwero kubva padirectrix.
Pakati pefokasi nedirectrix ndipo panova vheteksi. Tanga wagadzira ikwesheni yeparaboro ine vheteksi $({vx},\ {vy})$ uye $p={pp}$.
geo_parFocusDir.explanation: Sezvo vheteksi iri $({vx},\ {vy})$ uye $p={pp}$, ikwesheni yeparaboro ndi${eqn}$. Kana ${cond}$, ${un}={sol}$, saka kukosha kwakanyanya kwe${un}$ ndi${ans}$.

geo_parMinSum.prompt: Rega focus ye parabola ${eq}$ ive F, uye coordinates zvepoindi A ndi $({xa},\ {ya})$. Kana poindi P riri pa parabola richifamba, mutengo mudiki we $PA+PF$ ndeupi? (Nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Nhambwe $PF$ kubva papoindi P pa parabola kusvika ku focus yakaenzana nenhambwe kubva ku P kusvika ku directrix.
Kana tsoka yeperpendicular kubva ku P kuenda ku directrix iri H, $PA+PH$ idiki kana A, P, H zviri pamutsetse mumwe.
geo_parMinSum.explanation: Directrix ndi${dir}$. Poindi A riri mukati meparabola (${chk}$), saka kana tsoka yeperpendicular kubva ku P kuenda ku directrix iri H, mutengo mudiki we $PA+PF=PA+PH$ ndiyo nhambwe kubva ku A kusvika ku directrix, ${ans}$.

geo_planeNormal.prompt: Kune poindi $A{pa}$, plane inodarika papoindi A uye yakatwasuka ku vector $\vec n=({vn})$ inosangana ne ${ax}$-axis papoindi ine ${ax}$-coordinate yei? (Unogona kunyora sedhesimali kana sechikamu seu 3/4)
hints: Kana position vector yepoindi P ripi neripi riri pa plane ari $\vec p$, $\vec n\cdot(\vec p-\vec a)=0$.
Tanga watsvaga equation ye plane $ax+by+cz=d$, wobva washandisa chokwadi chekuti poindi riri pa ${ax}$-axis rine coordinates mbiri dzimwe dziri $0$.
geo_planeNormal.explanation: Kune poindi P riri pa plane, $\vec n\cdot(\vec p-\vec a)=0$, saka equation ye plane ndi${plane}$. Poindi riri pa ${ax}$-axis rine coordinates mbiri dzimwe dziri $0$, saka kubva ku ${solve}$, ${ax}$-coordinate ndi${ans}$.

geo_projEllipse.prompt: Pa plane $\alpha$ pane denderedzwa rine radius ${rr}$. Kana denderedzwa iri rikaitwa orthogonal projection pa plane $\beta$, rinova ellipse. Kana kona pakati pema plane maviri $\alpha$, $\beta$ iri $\theta$ uye $\cos\theta={cs}$, nhambwe pakati pema foci maviri e ellipse iyi ndeipi? (Nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Pakati pema dhayamita edenderedzwa, rakafanana nemutsetse wekusangana kwema plane maviri haripinduki kureba, uye rakatwasuka rinodzikira ne $\cos\theta$.
Tsvaga kureba kwe major axis $2a$ nekwe minor axis $2b$ ye ellipse yakaitwa projection, wobva waverenga $c=\sqrt{a^2-b^2}$.
geo_projEllipse.explanation: Kureba kwe major axis ye ellipse yakaitwa projection ndi $2a=2\times {rr}$, uye kwe minor axis ndi $2b=2\times {rr}\cos\theta=2\times {bb}$, saka $a={rr}$, $b={bb}$. $c=\sqrt{{rr}^2-{bb}^2}={cc}$, saka nhambwe pakati pema foci maviri ndi $2c={ans}$.

geo_projPlaneArea.prompt: Nzvimbo yemufananidzo une nzvimbo ye ${ar}$ uri pa plane ${pl}$ wakaitwa orthogonal projection pa ${cp}$-plane ndeipi? (Nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Kana kona pakati peplane inemufananidzo ne ${cp}$-plane iri $\theta$, nzvimbo yeprojection ndi (nzvimbo yemufananidzo)$\times\cos\theta$.

Kona $\theta$ pakati pema plane maviri inotorwa se $0^\circ\le\theta\le90^\circ$, saka $\cos\theta=\frac{|\vec n_1\cdot\vec n_2|}{|\vec n_1||\vec n_2|}$ (mutengo wakakwana we dot product yema normal vectors maviri ugovaniswe nechibereko chehukuru hwadzo).
geo_projPlaneArea.explanation: Normal vector ye plane ${pl}$ ndi $({nv})$ uye hukuru hwayo ndi${nn}$. Normal vector ye ${cp}$-plane ndi $({cn})$, saka $\cos\theta=\frac{|{ns}|}{{nn}}=\frac{{ni}}{{nn}}$, uye nzvimbo yeprojection ndi ${ar}\times\frac{{ni}}{{nn}}={ans}$.

geo_spaceDist.prompt: Nhambwe pakati pemapoindi maviri $A{pa}$, $B{pb}$ munzvimbo ine coordinates ndeipi? (Nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Nhambwe pakati pemapoindi maviri $(x_1,\ y_1,\ z_1)$, $(x_2,\ y_2,\ z_2)$ munzvimbo ine coordinates ndi $\sqrt{(x_2-x_1)^2+(y_2-y_1)^2+(z_2-z_1)^2}$.
Tanga watsvaga misiyano yema coordinates matatu.

geo_sphereExpand.prompt: Kana ikwesheni ${eq}$ ichimiririra denderedzwa rine radius ye${rad}$, kukosha kwekoronstanti $s$ kuri kupi? (nyora senhamba yakazara. Kana isina kunaka wedzera -)
hints: Shandura $x$, $y$, $z$ mumwe nemumwe kuita sikweya yakakwana kuti uwane chimiro che$(x-a)^2+(y-b)^2+(z-c)^2=r^2$.
Parutivi rwekurudyi runofanira kuva $r^2={rad2}$.
geo_sphereExpand.explanation: Kana yashandurwa kuita sikweya yakakwana, ndi${std}$. Sikweya yeradius ndi${s4}-s={rad2}$, saka $s={s4}-{rad2}={ans}$.

geo_sphereSection.prompt: Chikamu chedenderedzwa ${eq}$ chinogurwa neplani ${pl}$ idenderedzwa. Kana nzvimbo yedenderedzwa iri ndi $m\pi$, kukosha kwenhamba yechisikigo $m$ kuri kupi? (nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Verenga pakati nesikweya yeradius yedenderedzwa kubva paikwesheni.
Kana ukawana mwero $d$ kubva pakati kuenda paplani, radius $r$ yechikamu ndi$r^2=R^2-d^2$.
geo_sphereSection.explanation: Pakati pedenderedzwa ndi${cc}$, sikweya yeradius ndi$R^2={rr2}$. Mwero kubva pakati kuenda paplani ${pl}$ ndi$d={dd}$, saka sikweya yeradius yedenderedzwa rechikamu ndi${rr2}-{dd}^2={ans}$ uye nzvimbo ndi${ans}\pi$.

geo_sphereTangentPlane.prompt: Pamusoro peplani ${pl}$ inobata denderedzwa rine pakati pa$C{cc}$ uye radius ye${rad}$, pane kukosha kwekoronstanti $k$, rinoguta ndiko kukuru kupi? (nyora senhamba yakazara. Kana isina kunaka wedzera -)
hints: Kana ichibata, mwero kubva pakati kuenda paplani wakaenzana neradius.
Mwero pakati pechisvitsa $(x_0,\ y_0,\ z_0)$neplani $ax+by+cz=k$ ndi$\frac{|ax_0+by_0+cz_0-k|}{\sqrt{a^2+b^2+c^2}}$.
geo_sphereTangentPlane.explanation: Hukuru hwevheta yenhando $({nv})$ ndi${nn}$, uye kana pakati pakaiswa muikwesheni yeplani, ${dc}$. Kubva pamwero $\frac{|{dc}-k|}{{nn}}={rad}$, $|{dc}-k|={rl}$, saka $k={dc}\pm{rl}$, uye kukosha kukuru ndi${ans}$.

geo_tangentAt.prompt: Nzvimbo yekona-nhatu yakakomberedzwa nemutsetse unobata kakona ${eq}$ pachisvitsa $P({x0},\ {y0})$, neaxis ye$x$ neaxis ye$y$ ndeyei? (nyora sechikamu chakapfupikiswa. Kana inhamba yakazara, nyora senhamba yakazara. Muenzaniso: 3/4)
hints: Mutsetse unobata pachisvitsa $(x_1,\ y_1)$ pakakona unowanikwa nekushandura $x^2\to x_1x$, $y^2\to y_1y$ (paparaboro, $y^2\to y_1y$, $x\to\frac{x+x_1}{2}$).
Wana zvikamu ze$x$ ne$y$ zveikwesheni yemutsetse unobata, wobva waverenga $\frac{1}{2}\times|x\text{ chikamu}|\times|y\text{ chikamu}|$.
geo_tangentAt.explanation: Ikwesheni yemutsetse unobata ndi${tan}$, chikamu che$x$ ndi${xi}$, chikamu che$y$ ndi${yi}$. Saka nzvimbo ndi$\frac{1}{2}\times|{xi}|\times|{yi}|={ansf}$.

geo_tangentsFromPoint.prompt: Chigadzirwa chemiteremo yemitsetse miviri inobata kakona ${eq}$ ichibva pachisvitsa $({x1},\ {y1})$ chii? (nyora sechikamu chakapfupikiswa. Kana inhamba yakazara, nyora senhamba yakazara. Muenzaniso: 3/4)
hints: Tora mutero wemutsetse unobata se$m$, wobva waisa mutsetse ${lnp}$ unopfuura pachisvitsa $({x1},\ {y1})$ muikwesheni yekakona.
Kubva pamamiriro ekubata (dhisikiminanti $=0$) unowana ikwesheni yechipiri ye$m$, uye miteremo yemitsetse miviri yakabata ndiyo midzi miviri yeikwesheni iyoyo.
geo_tangentsFromPoint.explanation: Kana mutsetse ${lnp}$ waiswa muikwesheni yekakona, dhisikiminanti yeikwesheni yechipiri ye$x$ inofanira kuva $0$, saka mutero $m$ wemutsetse unobata ndiyo midzi miviri yeikwesheni yechipiri ${quad}=0$. Kubva pahukama hwemidzi nezvichiverengero, chigadzirwa chemiteremo yemitsetse miviri chiri ${prod}$.

geo_threePerp.prompt: Kubva pachisvitsa P chiri kunze kweplani $\alpha$, tsvimbo yakananga pa$\alpha$ ine chitsitsinho H, uye kubva pa H tsvimbo yakananga pamutsetse $\ell$ uri pa$\alpha$ ine chitsitsinho K, uye tora chisvitsa A pa$\ell$ chisiri K. Mwero kubva pa P kuenda pamutsetse $\ell$ ngaive $d$. Kana ${giv}$, kukosha kwe${ask}$ kuri kupi? (nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Sezvo $PH\perp\alpha$, $HK\perp\ell$, netiyorema yemitsetse mitatu yakarurama, $PK\perp\ell$.
Shandisa tiyorema yaPythagoras muzvikona-nhatu zvakarurama zvakawanikwa netiyorema yemitsetse mitatu yakarurama, imwe neimwe.
geo_threePerp.explanation: Sezvo $PH\perp\alpha$, $HK\perp\ell$, netiyorema yemitsetse mitatu yakarurama, $PK\perp\ell$. ${work}$, saka kukosha kunotsvakwa ndi${ans}$.

geo_vecCircleEq.prompt: Mapoindi $A{pa}$, $B{pb}$ ane position vectors $\vec a$, $\vec b$ zvichiteverana, uye poindi P rine position vector $\vec p$. Radius yedenderedzwa inoumbwa nemapoindi ese P anogutsa $(\vec p-\vec a)\cdot(\vec p-\vec b)=0$ ndeipi? (Unogona kunyora sedhesimali kana sechikamu seu 3/4)
hints: $(\vec p-\vec a)\cdot(\vec p-\vec b)=0$ zvinoreva kuti ma vectors maviri $\vec p-\vec a$, $\vec p-\vec b$ akatwasuka.
Kona yaunoona chikamu AB kubva papoindi P ine madhigirii mangani?
geo_vecCircleEq.explanation: $(\vec p-\vec a)\cdot(\vec p-\vec b)=0$ zvinoreva kuti P iri padenderedzwa une chikamu AB sedhayamita. $AB={ab}$, saka radius ndi $\frac{1}{2}AB={ans}$.

geo_vecDecompose.prompt: Kana $\vec a={va}$, $\vec b={vb}$, $\vec c={vc}$, kune nhamba dzechokwadi $m$, $n$ dzinogutsa $\vec c=m\vec a+n\vec b$, mutengo we ${ask}$ ndeupi? (Unogona kunyora sedhesimali kana sechikamu seu 3/4)
hints: Taura zvikamu zve $m\vec a+n\vec b$ nemukuwo we $m$, $n$ wozviisa zvakaenzana nezvikamu ze $\vec c$.
Gadzirisa simultaneous equations ye $m$, $n$ dzinowanikwa kubva pazvikamu zviviri.
