geo_vecDotParam.prompt: Kune ma vectors maviri $\vec a={va}$, $\vec b={vb}$, kana $\vec a\cdot\vec b={dd}$, mutengo mukuru we nhamba yechokwadi $t$ ndeupi? (Nyora senhamba yakazara. Kana iri negative, wedzera -)
hints: Wanza zvikamu zvichienderana wobva wawedzera kuti utaure $\vec a\cdot\vec b$ nemukuwo we $t$.
Gadzirisa equation yawawana kuti utsvage mitengo yese ye $t$, wobva wasarudza mukuru.
geo_vecDotParam.explanation: Nekuti $\vec a\cdot\vec b={dexp}$, mhinduro ye equation ${dexp}={dd}$ ndi${sol}$. Pakati peidzi, mutengo mukuru ndi${ans}$.

geo_vecLinComb.prompt: Kana $\vec a={va}$, $\vec b={vb}$, mutengo we $|{ex}|$ ndeupi? (Nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Kuwedzera ma vectors nekuwanza ne nhamba yechokwadi kunoitwa pazvikamu.
Tanga watsvaga zvikamu zve ${ex}$, wobva watsvaga ruzi rwakanaka rwemuwayo wezvikwere zvezvikamu.

geo_vecOrthoParam.prompt: Kana ma vectors maviri $\vec a={va}$, $\vec b={vb}$ akatwasuka, mutengo wenhamba yechokwadi $t$ ndeupi? (Nyora senhamba yakazara. Kana iri negative, wedzera -)
hints: Dot product yema vectors maviri akatwasuka ndi $0$.
Wanza zvikamu zvichienderana wobva wawedzera kuti utaure $\vec a\cdot\vec b$ nemukuwo we $t$.
geo_vecOrthoParam.explanation: Nekuti ma vectors maviri akatwasuka, $\vec a\cdot\vec b=0$. $\vec a\cdot\vec b={dexp}$, saka kugadzirisa equation ${dexp}=0$ kunopa ${sol}$.

geo_vecSphereEq.prompt: Mapoindi $A{pa}$, $B{pb}$ ane position vectors $\vec a$, $\vec b$ zvichiteverana, uye poindi P rine position vector $\vec p$. Radius ye sphere inoumbwa nemapoindi ese P anogutsa $(\vec p-\vec a)\cdot(\vec p-\vec b)=0$ ndeipi? (Unogona kunyora sedhesimali kana sechikamu seu 3/4)
hints: $(\vec p-\vec a)\cdot(\vec p-\vec b)=0$ zvinoreva kuti ma vectors maviri $\vec p-\vec a$, $\vec p-\vec b$ akatwasuka.
Kona yaunoona chikamu AB kubva papoindi P ine madhigirii mangani?
geo_vecSphereEq.explanation: $(\vec p-\vec a)\cdot(\vec p-\vec b)=0$ zvinoreva kuti P iri pasphere une chikamu AB sedhayamita. $AB={ab}$, saka radius ndi $\frac{1}{2}AB={ans}$.

job_boxTunnel.prompt: Chidimbu chemuti chine chimiro che cuboid chine kureba ${a}$ cm, upamhi ${b}$ cm, kukwirira ${c}$ cm, chakaboorwa gomba rine chimiro che cuboid rine kureba ${p}$ cm, upamhi ${q}$ cm, richibva pakati pepamusoro kusvika pazasi (gomba harisvike mativi echidimbu). Kana mativi emukati megomba achiverengwa mu surface area, surface area yechidimbu chine gomba ndi cm² dzingani? (Nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Kana gomba raboorwa, pamusoro napazasi zvinodzikira nesaizi yegomba.
Panzvimbo pacho, mativi mana emukati megomba anowedzerwa.
job_boxTunnel.explanation: Surface area isati yaboorwa ndi $2({a}\times{b}+{b}\times{c}+{c}\times{a})={s0}$ cm². Bvisa ${p}\times{q}$ kaviri pamusoro napazasi, wobva wawedzera mativi emukati $2({p}+{q})\times{c}$, saka ${s0}-{pq2}+{inn}={ans}$ cm².

job_boxesCeil.prompt: Zvikamu ${n}$ zvinoputirwa ${k}$ pabhokisi rimwe, uye mabhokisi anotakurwa ${m}$ papallet imwe. Kunyange zvikamu zvichisara zvinoiswa mubhokisi rimwe, uye kunyange mabhokisi achisara anoiswa papallet imwe. Mapallet anodiwa semuduku ngani? (Nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Kana kupatsanura kusingakwani, kunodiwa bhokisi (pallet) rimwe rekuisa zvasara.
Tanga watsvaga huwandu hwemabhokisi anodiwa, wobva watsvaga huwandu hwemapallet nenzira imwe chete.
job_boxesCeil.explanation: Mabhokisi anodiwa ndi ${bx}$, iyo ndiyo kukosha kwe ${n}\div{k}$ kwakakwidzirwa kumusoro, uye mapallet anodiwa ndi ${ans}$, kukosha kwe ${bx}\div{m}$ kwakakwidzirwa kumusoro.

job_chanceDraw.prompt: Bhokisi rine zvikamu ${n}$, ${d}$ pazvo zvakaremara. Kana zvikamu zviviri zvikatorwa panguva imwe chete zvisina kurongwa, mukana wekuti chimwe chete chakaremara kana kupfuura ndeupi? (Nyora segumi risingaite kuita zvidimbu zvidiki (irreducible fraction). Kana iri nhamba yose, nyora nhamba yose. Muenzaniso: 3/4)
hints: Nzira dzese dzekutora ndiko kuwanda kwemaitiro ekusarudza 2 pa ${n}$.
Zvakapesana ne 'chimwe chete chakaremara kana kupfuura' ndi 'zviviri zvose zvakanaka'.
job_chanceDraw.explanation: Nzira dzese ndi $_{{n}}\mathrm{C}_{2}={tot}$, uye apo zviviri zvose zvakanaka ndi $_{{g}}\mathrm{C}_{2}={good}$. Mukana unotsvakwa ndi $1-\frac{{good}}{{tot}}={fr}$.

job_floorPlan.prompt: Rumu rine chimiro che rectangle rine kureba ${a}$ m, upamhi ${b}$ m. Pakati pedziro rimwe rekureba, pane nzvimbo ine chimiro che rectangle yehupamhi ${d}$ m, kudzika ${c}$ m yakabatanidzwa kunze (${d}<{a}$ uye haibatani nekona dzerumu). Skirting board inoiswa kutenderera madziro ose emukati merumu, asi haiiswe panzvimbo yemusuwo wehupamhi ${w}$ m. Urefu hweskirting board hunodiwa ndi mamita mangani? (Nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Fungai nekudhirowa kuti perimeter yechimiro chakabatanidzwa nenzvimbo inosiyana sei neyerectangle.
Divi rimwe rehupamhi ${d}$ m rinoenda, asi mativi maviri ekudzika ${c}$ m nedivi rimwe rehupamhi ${d}$ m anowedzerwa.
job_floorPlan.explanation: Perimeter yerumu yose ndi $2({a}+{b})+2\times{c}={per}$ m (divi rehupamhi ${d}$ m rinotsiviwa nemativi maviri ekudzika ${c}$ m nedivi rehupamhi ${d}$ m, saka kuwedzera mativi maviri e ${c}$ m). Bvisa ${w}$ m yemusuwo, saka ${per}-{w}={ans}$ m.

job_flowUnits.prompt: Kubva pa nozzle yepurifier yemvura, ${r}$ mL yemvura inobuda pamunminiti nenzira yakaenzana. Kana nozzle iyi ikasiiwa yakavhurika kwe ${h}$ maawa ${m}$ maminetsi, mvura yose inobuda ndi mangani L? (1 L = 1000 mL, nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Shandura nguva yese kuita maminetsi kuti utsvage nguva yakavhurika.
Tsvaga mL nepo (huwandu pamunminiti)×(maminetsi), wobva wapatsanura ne 1000 kuti ushandure kuita L.
job_flowUnits.explanation: Nguva yakavhurika ndi ${h}\times60+{m}={tot}$ maminetsi, uye mvura inobuda ndi ${r}\times{tot}={ml}$ mL. ${ml}\div1000={ans}$ L.

job_markupProfit.prompt: Muchitoro, chinhu chine mutengo wekutanga ${c}$ won chinoiswa purofiti ye ${u}$% yemutengo wekutanga kuti ugadzire mutengo wakanyorwa, wobva waderedzwa ne ${d}$% yemutengo wakanyorwa, uye zvose ${n}$ zvinotengeswa. Purofiti yose pamutengo wekutanga ndi mangani won? (Nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Mutengo wakanyorwa ndi $(100+{u})$% yemutengo wekutanga.
Mutengo wekutengesa ndi $(100-{d})$% yemutengo wakanyorwa, uye purofiti yechinhu chimwe ndi (mutengo wekutengesa)−(mutengo wekutanga).
job_markupProfit.explanation: Mutengo wakanyorwa ndi ${c}\times\frac{{100+u}}{100}={lp}$ won, mutengo wekutengesa ndi ${lp}\times\frac{{100-d}}{100}={sp}$ won. Purofiti yechinhu chimwe ndi ${sp}-{c}={g}$ won, saka purofiti ye ${n}$ ndi ${g}\times{n}={ans}$ won.

job_outfitCount.prompt: Pane mhando ${s}$ dzemajasi ebasa nemhando ${p}$ dzebhurugwa, uye mhando ${h}$ dzengowani. Unosarudza chimwe chembhurugwa nechimwe chebhurugwa pamusoro, uye ngowani unogona kupfeka imwe yemhando dza${h}$ kana kusapfeka. Pane mapeya (pamusoro, pazasi) ${f}$ asingabvumirwi kupfekwa pamwe nokuda kwemitemo yekuchengetedza. Zvipfeko zvakasiyana zvinogona kupfekwa zviri zvingani? (nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Tanga wawana huwandu hwemapeya (pamusoro, pazasi) anogona kupfekwa.
Verenga nzira dzose dzokusarudza ngowani imwe yemhando dza${h}$ kana kusapfeka, wobva wakwidza.
job_outfitCount.explanation: Mapeya (pamusoro, pazasi) ndi${s}\times{p}-{f}={ok}$, ngowani ndi${h}+1={hh}$ pamwe nokusapfeka. Nomutemo wokuwanza, ${ok}\times{hh}={ans}$.

job_planCompare.prompt: Chirongwa A chine mutengo wemwedzi wakatarwa we${f1}$ won pamwe ne${p1}$ won pakushandisa kumwe nokumwe, Chirongwa B chine mutengo wemwedzi we${f2}$ won pamwe ne${p2}$ won pakushandisa kumwe nokumwe. Kana huwandu hwokushandisa pamwedzi ari $x$ (ino $x$ inhamba yechisikigo), $x$ diki kwazvo apo mutengo wemwedzi weChirongwa B unodzika pasi pewaChirongwa A ndeipi? (nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Ratidza mitengo yemwedzi yezvirongwa zvose zviviri sechirevo che$x$.
Gadzirisa kusaenzana (mutengo waB)<(mutengo waA) kuti uwane huwandu hwe$x$.
job_planCompare.explanation: Mutengo waA ndi${f1}+{p1}x$, mutengo waB ndi${f2}+{p2}x$. Kubva ku${f2}+{p2}x<{f1}+{p1}x$, ${dl}x>{df}$, ndiko kuti $x>\frac{{df}}{{dl}}$. Nhamba yechisikigo diki kwazvo inogutsa izvi ndi${ans}$.

job_ratioChain.prompt: Panhanho dzakasiyana A, B, C, chiyero chekugadzirwa kwezuva rimwe chete ndi A : B $={a}:{b}$, B : C $={c}:{d}$. Kana huwandu hwose hwekugadzirwa kwezuva rimwe chete huri ${T}$, hwekugadzirwa kwaC pazuva ndehungani? (nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Batanidza zvikamu zviviri zvichishandisa B kuti uite A : B : C.
Chikamura huwandu hwose ${T}$ nehuwandu hwezvikamu zveA : B : C kuti uwane saizi yechikamu chimwe.
job_ratioChain.explanation: Kana tafananidza kukosha kwaB, A : B : C $={pa}:{pb}:{pc}$. Huwandu hwezvikamu ndi${S}$, saka chikamu chimwe ndi${T}\div{S}={u}$, uye C ndi${pc}\times{u}={ans}$.

job_scaleDrawing.prompt: Mudhirowingi une chiyero $1:{k}$, imba yakaita samakona mana ainge zvakadhirowewa ine upamhi ${w}$ cm uye kureba ${h}$ cm. Nzvimbo chaiyo yeimba ndeyemamita masikweya mangani? (1 m = 100 cm, nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Kana chiyero chiri $1:{k}$, wedzera kureba kwemudhirowingi ${k}$ nguva kuti uwane kureba chaiko.
Wana upamhi nokureba chaiko mu cm, wobva wasanduka kuva m wokwidza.
job_scaleDrawing.explanation: Upamhi chaiko ndi${w}\times{k}={rw}$ cm$={rwm}$ m, kureba chaiko ndi${h}\times{k}={rh}$ cm$={rhm}$ m, saka nzvimbo ndi${rwm}\times{rhm}={ans}$ m².

job_tableRule.prompt: Iyi ndiyo tebhuru yemitengo yokurenda midziyo. Awa imwe neimwe inowedzerwa, mutengo unowedzera nehuwandu hwakafanana. ${x1}$ maawa i${y1}$ won, ${x2}$ maawa i${y2}$ won, ${x3}$ maawa i${y3}$ won. Mutengo wokurenda kwemaawa ${N}$ ndewa won ingani? (nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Wana kuti mutengo unowedzera sei pawawa imwe neimwe inowedzerwa patebhuru.
Ratidza mutengo se(huwandu hunowedzera pawawa)×(maawa)+(huwandu hwekutanga) uye wana huwandu hwekutanga.
job_tableRule.explanation: Inowedzera ${k}$ won pawawa imwe neimwe, saka mutengo ndewe$y={k}x+{b}$ (huwandu hwekutanga ${b}$ won, kuitira kuti ${x1}$ maawa ave ${y1}$ won). Maawa ${N}$ ndi${k}\times{N}+{b}={ans}$ won.

job_workTogether.prompt: Mushandi A anogadzira zvinhu ${a}$ paawa nekumhanya kwakatarwa, mushandi B anogadzira ${b}$ paawa. A anotanga basa kutanga, uye B anobatana naye mushure memaawa ${h}$. Kudzamara huwandu hwezvinhu zvavakagadzira hwave ${N}$ chaizvo, A akashanda maawa mangani ose pamwe chete? (nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Kana A akashanda maawa $t$, B akashanda maawa $t-{h}$.
Gadzira mutsauko wemutsetse unoti (huwandu hwakagadzirwa naA)+(huwandu hwakagadzirwa naB)$={N}$.
job_workTogether.explanation: Kana A akashanda $t$ maawa, B anoshanda $t-{h}$ maawa, saka ${a}t+{b}(t-{h})={N}$. Kupfupisa kunopa ${ab}t={tot}$, saka $t={ans}$ maawa.

pst_atLeast.prompt: Muhomwe mune mabhora machena ${w}$ nemabhora matema ${bk}$, kana mabhora ${k}$ akatorwa panguva imwe chete, tsvaga mukana wekuti pabuda mabhora machena ${r}$ kana kupfuura. (Nyora sechikamu chisingaderedzwi. Kana iri nhamba yakazara, nyora nhamba yakazara. Muenzaniso: 3/4)
hints: Chiitiko chinopikisa che '${r}$ kana kupfuura' ndiko kuva nemabhora machena ${zs}$.
Nzira dzose dzekutora ndi $\binom{{nn}}{{k}}={tot}$.
pst_atLeast.explanation: Chiitiko chinopikisa ndiko kuva nemabhora machena ${zs}$, uye huwandu hwenzira dzacho ndi ${bx}={bad}$. Huwandu hwose ndi $\binom{{nn}}{{k}}={tot}$, saka mukana unotsvakwa ndi $1-\frac{{bad}}{{tot}}={fr}$.

pst_bayes.prompt: Dhayisi isina rusaruro inokandwa kamwe; kana ichiratidza ${t}$ kana pasi, bhora rimwe rinotorwa mubhokisi A, kana zvisina kudaro mubhokisi B. Bhokisi A rine mabhora machena ${w1}$ nematema ${b1}$, bhokisi B rine mabhora machena ${w2}$ nematema ${b2}$. Kana bhora ratorwa richiva jena, tsvaga mukana wekuti rakabva mubhokisi A. (Nyora sechikamu chisingaderedzwi. Kana iri nhamba yakazara, nyora nhamba yakazara. Muenzaniso: 3/4)
hints: $P(A\mid \text{bhora jena})=\frac{P(A\cap \text{bhora jena})}{P(\text{bhora jena})}$.
Denominator ndiwo muwayo wemukana wekuwana bhora jena kubva ku A nemukana wekuwana bhora jena kubva ku B.
pst_bayes.explanation: Mukana wekuwana bhora jena kubva ku A ndi${tA}$ uye kubva ku B ndi${tB}$, saka mukana unotsvakwa ndi $\frac{{tA}}{{tA}+{tB}}={fr}$.

pst_bestOf.prompt: Zvikwata zviviri A ne B zvinotamba, uye chikwata chinotanga kukunda mitambo ${w}$ chinokunda. Mukana wekuti chikwata A chikunde mutambo wega wega ndi${fp}$, mitambo yacho haitsamiri imwe neimwe uye hapana mutambo unopera pakaenzana. Tsvaga mukana wekuti chikwata A chikunde. (Nyora sechikamu chisingaderedzwi. Kana iri nhamba yakazara, nyora nhamba yakazara. Muenzaniso: 3/4)
hints: Fungidzira zvichienderana nemutambo wechii umo chikwata A chinowana kukunda kwe ${w}$.
Kuti ukunde mumutambo we ${w}+j$, pamitambo ${wm1}+j$ yakapfuura pamafanira kuva nekukunda ${wm1}$ nekukundwa $j$.
pst_bestOf.explanation: Mukana wekuti chikwata A chikunde mumutambo we ${w}+j$ ($j={jr}$) ndi $\binom{{wm1}+j}{j}\left({fp}\right)^{{w}}\left(1-{fp}\right)^{j}$. Mitengo iyi yakateedzana ndi${tm}$, saka muwayo wavo ndi${fr}$.

pst_binomCoef2.prompt: Tsvaga coefficient ye $x^{{k}}$ mukuwedzera kwe $({ax}{bs})^{{n}}$. (Nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Izwi rakajairika retheorem yebinomial ndiro rechimiro $\binom{N}{j}A^{N-j}B^{j}$.
Tsvaga izwi umo $x$ inowanzwa ${k}$ nguva.
pst_binomCoef2.explanation: Ndiro izwi rinosarudza $x$ ${k}$ nguva uye mwero wakasimba ${nk}$ nguva, saka coefficient ndi $\binom{{n}}{{k}}\cdot{a}^{{k}}\cdot({b})^{{nk}}={ans}$.

pst_binomFindN.prompt: Kana musiyano wemukana $X$ unotevera binomial distribution $B(n,\ p)$ uye $E(X)={mu}$, $V(X)={vr}$, tsvaga mutengo we $n$. (Nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Kugovanisa $V(X)$ ne $E(X)$ kunopa $1-p$.

pst_binomNormal.prompt: Musiyano wemukana $X$ unotevera binomial distribution $B({n},\ {pf})$. Kutora $X$ semuyero we normal distribution (pasina continuity correction), tsvaga mutengo we $P({ev})$. Kune musiyano $Z$ unotevera standard normal distribution, $P(0\le Z\le 0.5)=0.1915$, $P(0\le Z\le 1)=0.3413$, $P(0\le Z\le 1.5)=0.4332$, $P(0\le Z\le 2)=0.4772$, $P(0\le Z\le 2.5)=0.4938$, $P(0\le Z\le 3)=0.4987$. (Nyora kusvika pamadhijiti mana mushure mepoindi redhesimali)
hints: Kana $n$ yakakura, binomial distribution $B(n,\ p)$ inogona kuyerwa ne $N(np,\ np(1-p))$.
Standardize uchishandisa (mean, standard deviation)=$({mu},\ {sg})$.
pst_binomNormal.explanation: $E(X)={mu}$, $\sigma(X)=\sqrt{{vr}}={sg}$, saka $X$ inotevera zvakapoteredza $N({mu},\ {sg}^{2})$. Kana tikashandisa $Z=\frac{X-{mu}}{{sg}}$, tinowana ${zs}$, saka $P({ev})\approx P({zev})={expr}$.

pst_binomPmfEq.prompt: Kana shanduko isina kujeka $X$ ichitevera kugoverwa kwebinomial $B({n},\ p)$ uye $P(X={r})=P(X={r1})$, wana kukosha kwe $p$. (Kana $0<p<1$) (Nyora semuparadzaniso usingaderedzwi. Kana ari nhamba yakazara, nyora nhamba yakazara. Muenzaniso: 3/4)
hints: Nyora huwandu hwacho zviviri muchimiro che $\binom{N}{j}p^{j}(1-p)^{N-j}$ wozovakamura mativi ose maviri nechinhu chakafanana.
Mushure mekurongedza, uchawana kukosha kwe $\frac{p}{1-p}$.
pst_binomPmfEq.explanation: Kubva ku $\binom{{n}}{{r}}p^{{r}}(1-p)^{{nr}}=\binom{{n}}{{r1}}p^{{r1}}(1-p)^{{nr1}}$ tinowana $\binom{{n}}{{r}}(1-p)=\binom{{n}}{{r1}}p$, ndiko kuti $\frac{p}{1-p}=\frac{{r1}}{{nr}}$. Saka $p={fe}$.

hints: Kubva kubinomial theorem $(1+x)^{N}=\sum_{k=0}^{N}\binom{N}{k}x^{k}$, isa nhamba inokodzera panzvimbo ye $x$.
Sarudza kukosha kwe $x$ kuti $(1+x)^{N}$ ienzane nehuwandu.

pst_binomTail.prompt: Kana shanduko isina kujeka $X$ ichitevera kugoverwa kwebinomial $B({n},\ {pf})$, wana kukosha kwe $P(X{rel}{t})$. (Nyora semuparadzaniso usingaderedzwi. Kana ari nhamba yakazara, nyora nhamba yakazara. Muenzaniso: 3/4)
hints: $P(X=j)=\binom{N}{j}p^{j}(1-p)^{N-j}$ ($N$ ihuwandu hwemiedzo). Kana mazwi ekuwedzera ari mazhinji, funga nezvechiitiko chinopesana.
Wedzera mazwi ane $j=$ ${js}$.
pst_binomTail.explanation: $P(X=j)=\binom{{n}}{j}\left({pf}\right)^{j}\left(1-{pf}\right)^{{n}-j}$, uye mukana unotsvagwa ndiyo huwandu hwezvose zvinoenderana ne $j={js}$, ndiko $\frac{{tm}}{{D}}=\frac{{num}}{{D}}={fe}$.

pst_binomUnknown.prompt: Mukuwedzera kwe $(x+a)^{{n}}$, coefficient ye $x^{{k}}$ ndeye ${V}$. Wana kukosha kwe $a$ yakanaka. (Nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Taura coefficient ye $x^{{k}}$ uchishandisa $a$.
Nokuti $\binom{{n}}{{k}}={C}$, tanga wawana kukosha kwe $a^{{nk}}$.
pst_binomUnknown.explanation: Coefficient ye $x^{{k}}$ ndeye $\binom{{n}}{{k}}a^{{nk}}={C}a^{{nk}}$, saka ${C}a^{{nk}}={V}$, ndiko kuti $a^{{nk}}={q}$. Nokuti $a>0$, $a={ans}$.

pst_ciBounds.prompt: Kubva muhuwandu hunotevera kugoverwa kwenormal ine population standard deviation ye ${s}$, tora muenzaniso wehukuru ${n}$ nenzira isina kurongwa, mean yemuenzaniso ndeye ${xb}$. Kana confidence interval yepopulation mean $m$ pa confidence ye ${cl}\%$ iri $a\le m\le b$, wana kukosha kwe $b$. (Kukosha kunoenderana ne confidence ye ${cl}\%$ ndeye $z={z}$.) (Nyora sedecimal)
hints: Confidence interval ndeye $\overline{x}-z\frac{\sigma}{\sqrt{{n}}}\le m\le \overline{x}+z\frac{\sigma}{\sqrt{{n}}}$.
Nokuti $\sqrt{{n}}={rt}$, tanga wawana $\frac{\sigma}{\sqrt{{n}}}$.

pst_ciSampleSize.prompt: Kana sampuli yakatorwa pasina kutarisa kubva mupopulation inotevera normal distribution ine population standard deviation ${s}$, uye population mean inofungidzirwa nekuvimba kwe ${cl}\%$, tsvaga mutengo mudiki wehukuru hwesampuli $n$ unoita kuti kureba kwe confidence interval kuve ${L}$ kana kupfuura pasi. (Mutengo unoenderana nekuvimba kwe ${cl}\%$ ndi $z={z}$, uye $n$ inhamba yechisikigo.) (Nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Kureba kwe confidence interval ndi $2z\frac{\sigma}{\sqrt{n}}$.
Gadzirisa inequality inotevera ye $\sqrt{n}$ wobva wapfurikidza mativi ose maviri. $2z\frac{\sigma}{\sqrt{n}}\le {L}$
pst_ciSampleSize.explanation: Kureba kwe confidence interval ndi $2\times{z}\times\frac{{s}}{\sqrt{n}}\le {L}$, saka $\sqrt{n}\ge\frac{2\times{z}\times{s}}{{L}}$, kureva kuti $n\ge\left(\frac{2\times{z}\times{s}}{{L}}\right)^{2}{eq}{nq}$. Nhamba yechisikigo diki inogutsa izvi ndi${ans}$.

pst_condDice.prompt: Madhayisi maviri asina rusaruro anosiyanisika anokandwa panguva imwe chete, uye nhamba dzinoratidzwa ndi $a,\ b$. Kana chiitiko $A$ chiri '$a+b{rel}{t}$' uye chiitiko $B$ chiri '$a{relb}b$', tsvaga conditional probability $P(B\mid A)$. (Nyora sechikamu chisingaderedzwi. Kana iri nhamba yakazara, nyora nhamba yakazara. Muenzaniso: 3/4)
hints: Tanga watsvaga nzira dzese dziri muchiitiko $A$.
$P(B\mid A)=\frac{n(A\cap B)}{n(A)}$.
pst_condDice.explanation: Huwandu hwenzira dzechiitiko $A$ ndi${nA}$, uye dze $A\cap B$ ndi${nAB}$. Naizvozvo $P(B\mid A)={fe}$.

pst_condTable.prompt: Pavadzidzi ${N}$ vemukirabhu imwe, vakomana ndi${m}$, vanopfeka magirazi ndi${g}$, uye vakomana vanopfeka magirazi ndi${x}$. Kana mudzidzi mumwe akatorwa pasina kutarisa mukirabhu iyi asingapfeki magirazi, tsvaga mukana wekuti ndimusikana. (Nyora sechikamu chisingaderedzwi. Kana iri nhamba yakazara, nyora nhamba yakazara. Muenzaniso: 3/4)
hints: Gadzira tafura wozadza huwandu hwevanhu mumabhokisi mana: vakomana/vasikana, vanopfeka magirazi/vasingapfeki.
Mu conditional probability $P(B\mid A)=\frac{n(A\cap B)}{n(A)}$, $A$ ndi 'asingapfeki magirazi'.
pst_condTable.explanation: Vasikana ndi${f}$ uye vasikana vanopfeka magirazi ndi${g}-{x}={gy}$, saka vasikana vasingapfeki magirazi ndi${f}-{gy}={fn}$. Vadzidzi vasingapfeki magirazi ndi${N}-{g}={ng}$, saka mukana ndi${fe}$.

pst_deMorgan.prompt: Kune zviitiko zviviri $A,\ B$, kana ${gv}$, tsvaga mutengo we $P({ev})$. (Nyora sedhesimali)
hints: Dhora Venn diagram wokamura kuita nzvimbo ina: $A\cap B$, $A\cap B^{c}$, $A^{c}\cap B$, $A^{c}\cap B^{c}$.
$P(A\cap B^{c})=P(A)-P(A\cap B)$, $P(A^{c}\cap B)=P(B)-P(A\cap B)$. Unogonawo kushandisa mitemo ye De Morgan $(A\cup B)^{c}=A^{c}\cap B^{c}$, $(A\cap B)^{c}=A^{c}\cup B^{c}$ ne $P(E^{c})=1-P(E)$.
pst_deMorgan.explanation: $P(A\cap B)$ ndi${der}$. Mikana yenzvimbo ina ndi $P(A\cap B)={pab}$, $P(A\cap B^{c})={ao}$, $P(A^{c}\cap B)={bo}$, $P(A^{c}\cap B^{c})={ne}$ uye muwayo wacho ndi $1$. $P({ev})$ ndiwo muwayo wenzvimbo dzinoenderana, saka ${sumx}$.

pst_diceQuad.prompt: Dhayisi isina rusaruro ine mhando kubva ku $1$ kusvika ku ${s}$ inokandwa kaviri, uye nhamba dzinoratidzwa zvichitevedzana ndi $a,\ b$. Tsvaga mukana wekuti quadratic equation $x^{2}-{pa}x+{qb}=0$ ive nemidzi miviri yechokwadi yakasiyana. (Nyora sechikamu chisingaderedzwi. Kana iri nhamba yakazara, nyora nhamba yakazara. Muenzaniso: 3/4)
hints: Mamiriro emidzi miviri yechokwadi yakasiyana ndi discriminant $D>0$.
$D={d1}-4\times{qb}$, uye sarudza $a$ imwe neimwe uverenge $b$ dzinogutsa mamiriro.
pst_diceQuad.explanation: $(a,\ b)$ dzinogutsa discriminant $D={d1}-4\times{qb}>0$ ndi${cnt}$, uye dzose ndi${tot}$, saka mukana ndi${fe}$.

pst_diceSum.prompt: Madhayisi maviri asina rusaruro, rimwe nerimwe rine mhando kubva ku $1$ kusvika ku ${s}$, anokandwa panguva imwe chete, uye nhamba dzinoratidzwa ndi $a,\ b$. Tsvaga mukana wekuti $a+b{rel}{t}$. (Nyora sechikamu chisingaderedzwi. Kana iri nhamba yakazara, nyora nhamba yakazara. Muenzaniso: 3/4)
hints: Kana madhayisi maviri akasiyaniswa, nzira dzose ndi ${s}\times{s}$.
Chinja $a$ kubva ku $1$ kusvika ku ${s}$, uverenge huwandu hwe $b$ hunogutsa mamiriro, wobva wawedzera.
pst_diceSum.explanation: Nzira dzose ndi ${tot}$ uye $(a,\ b)$ dzinogutsa mamiriro ndi ${cnt}$. Naizvozvo mukana ndi${fe}$.

pst_expectTable.prompt: Kana musiyano wemukana $X$ ungatora mitengo $1,\ 2,\ \ldots,\ {n}$ uye $P(X=x)=k(x+{c})$ ($x=1,\ 2,\ \ldots,\ {n}$), tsvaga mutengo wemean $E(X)$ we $X$. (Apa, $k$ ikonsitanti.) (Nyora sechikamu chisingaderedzwi. Kana iri nhamba yakazara, nyora nhamba yakazara. Muenzaniso: 3/4)
hints: Tanga watsvaga $k$ uchishandisa mamiriro ekuti muwayo wemikana ndi $1$.
$E(X)=\sum x\,P(X=x)$.
pst_expectTable.explanation: Nekuti muwayo wemikana ndi $1$, $k({t1})={S1}k=1$, kureva kuti $k=\frac{1}{{S1}}$. $E(X)=\frac{1}{{S1}}({t2})=\frac{1}{{S1}}\times{S2}={fe}$.

pst_indepFindN.prompt: Kubva pamakadhi $n$ ane nhamba dzechisikigo kubva ku $1$ kusvika ku $n$ imwe neimwe, kadhi rimwe rinotorwa pasina kutarisa. Rega chiitiko $A$ chive 'nhamba yekadhi ndiyo yakawanda ye ${p}$', uye chiitiko $B$ chive 'nhamba yekadhi ndiyo yakawanda ye ${q}$'. Pakati penhamba dzechisikigo $n$ dzine $2\le n\le {M}$, tsvaga mutengo mukuru we $n$ unoita kuti zviitiko zviviri $A,\ B$ zvisatsamirana. (Nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Kana zvisingatsamiri, $P(A\cap B)=P(A)P(B)$, uye $A\cap B$ ndiyo yakawanda ye ${l}$. Kana pane $a$ yakawanda ye ${p}$, $b$ yakawanda ye ${q}$, ne $c$ yakawanda ye ${l}$, mamiriro ekusatsamirana ndi $ab=cn$.
Tarisa zvinoitika kana $n$ iri yakawanda ye ${l}$.
pst_indepFindN.explanation: Kana $n={l}t$ ($t$ inhamba yechisikigo), $P(A)=\frac{1}{{p}}$, $P(B)=\frac{1}{{q}}$, $P(A\cap B)=\frac{1}{{l}}$, saka zvinosatsamirana. Yakawanda huru ye ${l}$ iri pasi pe ${M}$ ndi${ans}$. Kune $n$ yakakura kupfuura iyi, tarisa kana mamiriro ekusatsamirana $\frac{c}{n}=\frac{a}{n}\cdot\frac{b}{n}$, kureva kuti $ab=cn$, achigutsikana panguva iyo pane $a$ yakawanda ye ${p}$, $b$ yakawanda ye ${q}$, ne $c$ yakawanda ye ${l}$. Nekuti ${chk}$, hazvisatsamiri. Naizvozvo ${ans}$.

pst_indepUnknown.prompt: Kana zviitiko zviviri $A,\ B$ zvisingatsamiriri uye $P(A)={fa}$, $P(A\cup B)={fu}$, tsvaga mutengo we $P(B)$. (Nyora sechikamu chisingaderedzwi. Kana iri nhamba yakazara, nyora nhamba yakazara. Muenzaniso: 3/4)
hints: Kana zvisingatsamiri, $P(A\cap B)=P(A)P(B)$.
Gadzirisa theorem yekuwedzera $P(A\cup B)=P(A)+P(B)-P(A)P(B)$ kuti uwane $P(B)$.
pst_indepUnknown.explanation: Nekuti zvisingatsamiriri, $P(A\cup B)=P(A)+P(B)-P(A)P(B)$, kureva kuti $P(B)\{1-P(A)\}=P(A\cup B)-P(A)$. $1-{fa}={d1}$ uye ${fu}-{fa}={d2}$, saka $P(B)={d2}\div{d1}={fr}$.

pst_latticePath.prompt: Munzira dzipfupi dzinobva papoindi $(0,\ 0)$ pa coordinate plane kuenda papoindi $({m},\ {n})$ uchifamba chikwere chimwe chete kurudyi kana kumusoro, pane nzira dzakawanda sei dzisingadarike papoindi $\mathrm{P}({p},\ {q})$? (Nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Shandisa permutations dzine zvinhu zvakafanana kuverenga nzira dzose. Nzira dzisingadarike = dzose - dzinodarika.
Verenga nzira dzinodarika papoindi $\mathrm{P}$ se (kubva pakutanga kusvika ku $\mathrm{P}$)×(kubva ku $\mathrm{P}$ kusvika pakupedzisira).
pst_latticePath.explanation: Nzira dzose ndi${tot}$. Kubva pakutanga kusvika ku $\mathrm{P}$ ndi${via1}$, kubva ku $\mathrm{P}$ kusvika pakupedzisira ndi${via2}$, saka nzira dzinodarika $\mathrm{P}$ ndi ${via1}\times{via2}={via}$. Naizvozvo ${tot}-{via}={ans}$.

pst_linTransform.prompt: Kana mean yerandom variable $X$ iri ${m}$ uye standard deviation iri ${s}$, tsvaga kukosha kwe $E(Y^{2})$ kune random variable $Y={ya}$. (Nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Shandisa $E(Y)=aE(X)+b$, $V(Y)=a^{2}V(X)$.

pst_lineUp.prompt: Kana vakomana ${m}$ nevasikana ${w}$ vachimira mumutsetse, tsvaga mukana wekuti pasina vasikana vaviri vakamira vakabatana. (Nyora semuchikamu chakareruka. Kana iri nhamba yakazara, nyora senhamba yakazara. Muenzaniso: 3/4)
hints: Mukana wakafanana kunyange tikafunga nezvekurongeka kwehurume nehukadzi chete tisingaparadzanisi vaya vehurume kana vehukadzi chete. Tanga wamisa vakomana, wobva wafunga nezvekumisa vasikana pakati pavo nemiganhu miviri.
Nzvimbo dzinogona kumira vasikana ndedzi ${m1}$.
pst_lineUp.explanation: Huwandu hwose hwekurongeka kwehurume nehukadzi ndi $\binom{{nn}}{{w}}={tot}$. Kana tikasarudza nzvimbo ${w}$ pakati penzvimbo ${m1}$ dziri pakati pevakomana nemiganhu miviri tomisa vasikana, havabatani, saka pane nzira $\binom{{m1}}{{w}}={good}$. Mukana ndi ${fe}$.

pst_monotoneSeq.prompt: Tsvaga huwandu hwemaparera akarongeka $(a,\ b,\ c,\ d)$ anoita $a{r1}b{r2}c{r3}d$ kune zvinhu $a,\ b,\ c,\ d$ zveseti $\{1,\ 2,\ \ldots,\ {m}\}$. (Nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Panenge pane chiratidzo $<$, nhamba mbiri dzinofanira kusiyana. Deredza renji yenhamba dzinogona kusarudzwa nenzira iyi.
Kana pane $\le$ chete, kusarudza nhamba ina kwakafanana ne combination ine kudzokorora.
pst_monotoneSeq.explanation: $a<b$ yakafanana ne $a+1\le b$, saka kana ukabvisa $1$ panhamba inotevera pa $<$ imwe neimwe, chiratidzo ichocho chinova $\le$. Pano pane zviratidzo $<$ ${s}$, saka zviratidzo zvose zvinova $\le$ uye renji yenhamba inova kubva ku $1$ kusvika ku ${ms}$. Iyi ndiyo huwandu hwenzira dzekusarudza $4$ munyika iyi uchibvumira kudzokorora, saka ${}_{{ms}}\mathrm{H}_{4}=\binom{{top}}{4}={ans}$.

pst_multiplesUnion.prompt: Pakati pemakadhi ${N}$ ane nhamba dzechisikigo kubva ku $1$ kusvika ku ${N}$ imwe neimwe, kana tikasarudza rimwe kadhi zvisina chirongwa, tsvaga mukana wekuti nhamba iri pakadhi ive multiple ye ${p}$ kana multiple ye ${q}$. (Nyora semuchikamu chakareruka. Kana iri nhamba yakazara, nyora senhamba yakazara. Muenzaniso: 3/4)
hints: Tanga wawana huwandu hwema multiple e ${p}$ nema multiple e ${q}$. Ma multiple ezvose zviviri ndiwo ma multiple eleast common multiple yenhamba mbiri idzi.
Huwandu hwema element eunion = (huwandu) - (intersection).
pst_multiplesUnion.explanation: Ma multiple e ${p}$ ndi ${np}$, ma multiple e ${q}$ ndi ${nq}$, uye ma multiple eleast common multiple ${l}$ ndi ${nl}$. Saka ${np}+{nq}-{nl}={cnt}$ uye mukana ndi ${fe}$.

pst_normalBetween.prompt: Kana random variable $X$ ichitevera normal distribution $N({m},\ {s}^{2})$, tsvaga kukosha kwe $P({a}\le X\le {b})$. Kune random variable $Z$ inotevera standard normal distribution, $P(0\le Z\le 0.5)=0.1915$, $P(0\le Z\le 1)=0.3413$, $P(0\le Z\le 1.5)=0.4332$, $P(0\le Z\le 2)=0.4772$, $P(0\le Z\le 2.5)=0.4938$, $P(0\le Z\le 3)=0.4987$. (Nyora kusvika pamadecimal mana)
hints: Standardize ne $Z=\frac{X-m}{\sigma}$ wobva washandura kuita chimiro che $P(z_1\le Z\le z_2)$.
Graph ye standard normal distribution iri symmetric pamusoro pe $Z=0$.

pst_normalFindParam.prompt: Kana random variable $X$ ichitevera normal distribution $N(m,\ {s}^{2})$ uye $P(X\ge {c})={pv}$, tsvaga kukosha kwe constant $m$. Kune random variable $Z$ inotevera standard normal distribution, $P(0\le Z\le 0.5)=0.1915$, $P(0\le Z\le 1)=0.3413$, $P(0\le Z\le 1.5)=0.4332$, $P(0\le Z\le 2)=0.4772$, $P(0\le Z\le 2.5)=0.4938$, $P(0\le Z\le 3)=0.4987$. (Nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Shandura $P(X\ge {c})$ kuita mukana we $Z$ wobva wauenzanisa ne $0.5$.
Patafura tsvaga $z_0$ inoenderana nekukosha kwe $P(0\le Z\le z_0)$.
pst_normalFindParam.explanation: $P(X\ge {c})=P\left(Z\ge \frac{{c}-m}{{s}}\right)={pv}$. Patafura $P(0\le Z\le |z_0|)=|{pv}-0.5|={tv}$, saka $|z_0|={az}$. Nokuti ${cmp}$, ${zsg}$, uye $\frac{{c}-m}{{s}}={zz}$. Nokudaro $m={ans}$.

pst_normalSymmetric.prompt: Kana random variable $X$ ichitevera normal distribution $N({m},\ {s}^{2})$ uye $P(X\le {L})=P(X\ge {R})$, tsvaga kukosha kwe constant $k$. (Nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Curve ye normal distribution iri symmetric pamusoro pe mean $m$.
Kukosha kuviri kuri kumativi akapesana kubva pamean pakureba kwakaenzana. Ndiko kuti huwandu hwekukosha kuviri ndi $2m$.
pst_normalSymmetric.explanation: Nokuti curve ye normal distribution iri symmetric pa $x={m}$, $({L})+({R})=2\times{m}$. Kana tikarongedza, ${A}k+({BD})={m2}$, saka $k={ans}$.

pst_repCombEq.prompt: Kune nhamba dzizere dzisiri negative $x,\ y,\ z,\ w$, tsvaga huwandu hwemaparera akarongeka $(x,\ y,\ z,\ w)$ anoita $x+y+z+w={n}$ uye ${cond}$. (Nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Kune variable ine lower bound inopfuura $0$, bvisa lower bound kuti ive $0$ kana kupfuura.
Equation yakashandurwa ine chimiro che $x'+y'+z'+w'={m2}$.
pst_repCombEq.explanation: Tinosarudza ma variable matsva seizvi. ${subs}$. (Kana pane variable ine lower bound $0$, inongorangarirwa se $x'=x$.) Ipapo $x'+y'+z'+w'={m2}$ uye variable imwe neimwe inhamba yakazara ye $0$ kana kupfuura. Combination ine kudzokorora ${}_{4}\mathrm{H}_{{m2}}=\binom{{m3}}{{m2}}={ans}$.

pst_repPermCond.prompt: Pakati penhamba dzechisikigo dzine nhamba ${k}$ dzakagadzirwa kubva pamadhijiti $0,\ 1,\ 2,\ \ldots,\ {m}$ uchibvumira kudzokorora (dhijiti yekutanga haisi $0$), dziri mbani dzinoshandisa dhijiti ${t}$ kamwe chete kana kupfuura? (Nyora nhamba chete)
hints: 'Kamwe chete kana kupfuura' zviri nyore kana ukashandisa chiitiko chinopesana ('hapana kana imwe'). Dhijiti yekutanga haigone kuva 0.
Huwandu hwenhamba dzechisikigo dzose dzine nhamba ${k}$ ndi ${tot}$.
pst_repPermCond.explanation: Nhamba dzose dzechisikigo dzine nhamba ${k}$ ndi ${tot}$, uye nhamba dzisingashandisi dhijiti ${t}$ pakadini ndi ${noExpr}={no}$. Saka ${tot}-{no}={ans}$.

pst_sampleMeanDist.prompt: Mubhegi mune mabhora matatu, uye nhamba dziri pamabhora imwe neimwe ndi ${lst}$. Tinodzokorora kubudisa bhora rimwe mubhegi, kutarisa nhamba, wobva waridzorera, ${nt}$ nguva. Kana avhareji yenhamba ${nt}$ dzakatariswa iri $\overline{X}$, tsvaga $P(\overline{X}\ge {t})$. (Nyora semuchikamu chakareruka. Kana iri nhamba yakazara, nyora senhamba yakazara. Muenzaniso: 3/4)
hints: Nokuti ndiko kusarudza nekudzosera, maparera akarongeka ose anogona kuitika ane mukana wakaenzana.
Verenga maparera akarongeka ose ane avhareji ye ${t}$ kana kupfuura.
pst_sampleMeanDist.explanation: Nzira dzose dzine kurongeka ndi ${tot}$, uye dzine avhareji ye ${t}$ kana kupfuura ndi ${cnt}$. Saka mukana ndi ${fe}$.

pst_sampleMeanNormal.prompt: Kubva pakuwanda kunotevera normal distribution ine population mean ${m}$ uye population standard deviation ${s}$, sample yehukuru ${n}$ inosarudzwa nenzira yekusarudza zvisina urongwa, uye sample mean ndi$\overline{X}$. Wana kukosha kwe$P({ev})$. Kune random variable $Z$ inotevera standard normal distribution, $P(0\le Z\le 0.5)=0.1915$, $P(0\le Z\le 1)=0.3413$, $P(0\le Z\le 1.5)=0.4332$, $P(0\le Z\le 2)=0.4772$, $P(0\le Z\le 2.5)=0.4938$, $P(0\le Z\le 3)=0.4987$. (Nyora kusvika pachinzvimbo chechina chedhesimali.)
hints: Sample mean $\overline{X}$ inotevera normal distribution $N\left(m,\ \left(\frac{\sigma}{\sqrt{{n}}}\right)^{2}\right)$.
Standard deviation inoshandiswa pakuita standardization inowanikwa seizvi: $\frac{\sigma}{\sqrt{{n}}}={h}$
pst_sampleMeanNormal.explanation: $\overline{X}$ inotevera normal distribution $N({m},\ {h}^{2})$ ($\frac{{s}}{\sqrt{{n}}}={h}$). Pakuita standardization ne$Z=\frac{\overline{X}-{m}}{{h}}$, ${zs}$, saka $P({ev})=P({zev})={expr}$.

pst_sampleSd.prompt: Kubva pakuwanda kune population mean ${m}$ uye population variance ${v}$, sample yehukuru ${n}$ inosarudzwa nenzira yekusarudza zvisina urongwa, uye sample mean ndi$\overline{X}$. Wana kukosha kwe$E(\overline{X}^{2})$. (Nyora sedhesimali.)
hints: Mean yesample mean ndi$E(\overline{X})=m$, variance ndi$V(\overline{X})=\frac{\sigma^{2}}{{n}}$.
$E(\overline{X}^{2})=V(\overline{X})+\{E(\overline{X})\}^{2}$.

pst_stratified.prompt: Vagari vedunhu vakakamurwa kuita mapoka matatu A, B, C ane vanhu ${na}$, ${nb}$, ${nc}$ zvichiteerana. Sample yakasarudzwa nestratified sampling ine proportional allocation, uko hukuru hwesample hunosarudzwa zvichienderana nehuwandu hwevanhu pagoka rimwe nerimwe, uye vanhu ${sa}$ vakasarudzwa kubva pagoka A. Vanhu vangani vakasarudzwa kubva pagoka C? (Nyora nhamba chete.)
hints: Pakuwiriranisa nereshiyo, reshiyo yakasarudzwa pagoka rimwe nerimwe (nhamba yesample ÷ huwandu hwegoka) yakaenzana.
Tanga wawana reshiyo yegoka A.
pst_stratified.explanation: Reshiyo yakasarudzwa kubva pagoka A ndi$\frac{{sa}}{{na}}$. Nokuti reshiyo iyi yakaenzana mumapoka ose, pagoka C ndi${nc}\times\frac{{sa}}{{na}}={ans}$ vanhu.

pst_totalProb.prompt: Dhayisi rakaenzana rinokandwa kamwe. Kana nhamba inobuda iri ${t}$ kana pasi, bhora rimwe rinotorwa mubhokisi A, kana zvisiri izvo, mubhokisi B. Bhokisi A rine mabhora machena ${w1}$ nemabhora matema ${b1}$, bhokisi B rine mabhora machena ${w2}$ nemabhora matema ${b2}$. Wana mukana wekuti bhora ratorwa ichena. (Nyora sechikamu chisingaderedzwi. Kana iri nhamba yakazara, nyora sanhamba yakazara. Muenzaniso: 3/4)
hints: Mikana yekuti bhora ratorwa ichena yakakamurwa kuita 'chena kubva ku A' kana 'chena kubva ku B'.
Imwe neimwe inowanikwa se (mukana wekusarudza bhokisi)×(mukana wekuti ichena mubhokisi iro).
pst_totalProb.explanation: Chena kubva ku A: $\frac{{t}}{6}\times{pw1}={tA}$, chena kubva ku B: $\frac{{t6c}}{6}\times{pw2}={tB}$ (apa $\frac{{t6c}}{6}$ mukana wekusarudza B). Kuwedzera nhamba mbiri idzi, $\frac{{t}}{6}\times{pw1}+\frac{{t6c}}{6}\times{pw2}={fr}$.

pst_urnChain.prompt: Kubva muhomwe ine mabhora machena ${w}$ nemabhora matema ${bk}$, mabhora anotorwa rimwe nerimwe zvichitevedzana, uye bhora ratorwa haridzoserwi. Wana mukana wekuti mabhora ekutanga ${r}$ ose ave machena, uye rechi${r1}$ rive dema. (Nyora sechikamu chisingaderedzwi. Kana iri nhamba yakazara, nyora sanhamba yakazara. Muenzaniso: 3/4)
hints: Mutemo wekuvhiya mikana: nhamba yemabhora asara inochinja nhanho imwe neimwe.
Mukana wekuti rekutanga ribe jena ndi$ rac{{w}}{{nn}}$.
pst_urnChain.explanation: Kuvhiya mikana (yakaitwa pashure pechimwe) yenhanho imwe neimwe, ${prod}={fe}$.

pst_varTable.prompt: Kana kugoverwa kwekuitika kwe random variable $X$ kuri $P(X={x1})=\frac{{a1}}{{d}}$, $P(X={x2})=\frac{{a2}}{{d}}$, $P(X={x3})=\frac{{a3}}{{d}}$, wana variance $V(X)$. (Nyora sechikamu chisingadzikiswi. Kana iri nhamba yakazara, nyora nhamba yakazara. Semuenzaniso: 3/4)
hints: Tanga wawana $E(X)$ ne $E(X^{2})$.

stat_ciMean.prompt: Kubva pahuwandu hunotevera normal distribution, {cnt} vakasarudzwa zvisina kurongwa. Sample mean ndi $\bar{x}={xbar}$ uye population standard deviation ndi $\sigma={sig}$. Confidence interval ye ${cl}\%$ yepopulation mean ndi $\bar{x}-z\dfrac{\sigma}{\sqrt{n}}\le m\le\bar{x}+z\dfrac{\sigma}{\sqrt{n}}$, uye kukosha kwe $z$ ndi ${z}$. Upper limit yeconfidence interval iyi ndeipi? (nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Tanga wawana standard error $\dfrac{\sigma}{\sqrt{n}}$. $n$ isquare, saka inokamurwa zvakakwana.
Margin of error ndi $z\times$(standard error), upper limit ndi $\bar{x}$ yakawedzerwa nazvo.
stat_ciMean.explanation: Standard error ndi $\frac{{sig}}{\sqrt{{cnt}}}={se}$, margin of error ndi ${z}\times{se}={moe}$, saka upper limit ndi ${xbar}+{moe}={ans}$.

stat_ciProp.prompt: Pamusoro pemutemo wakati, {cnt} vakasarudzwa zvisina kurongwa nokubvunzwa, uye {ag} vakabvuma. Kana sample proportion iri $\hat{p}$, confidence interval ye ${cl}\%$ yepopulation proportion ndi $\hat{p}-z\sqrt{\dfrac{\hat{p}(1-\hat{p})}{n}}\le p\le\hat{p}+z\sqrt{\dfrac{\hat{p}(1-\hat{p})}{n}}$, uye kukosha kwe $z$ ndi ${z}$. Upper limit yeinterval iyi inoratidzwa nepesenti (%) ndeipi? (nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Tanga wawana sample proportion $\hat{p}=\dfrac{{ag}}{{cnt}}$.
$\sqrt{\dfrac{\hat{p}(1-\hat{p})}{n}}$ inoita nhamba yakajeka. Zvakaringana kushandura kuita pesenti usati wakwanisa.
stat_ciProp.explanation: $\hat{p}={ph}\%$, $\sqrt{\frac{\hat{p}(1-\hat{p})}{{cnt}}}={sdp}\%$, saka margin of error ndi ${z}\times{sdp}={moe}$(%), upper limit ndi ${ph}+{moe}={ans}$(%).

stat_linReverse.prompt: Variable itsva $y$ yakagadzirwa kubva ku $x$ ($y={eq}$). Mean ye $y$ yaiva ${my}$, standard deviation yaiva ${sy}$. Standard deviation ye $x$ ndeipi? (nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Kana $y=ax+b$, standard deviation inova $|a|$ nguva.
Constant inowedzerwa $b$ nemean hazvina chekuita ne standard deviation. Kamura standard deviation ye $y$ ne $|a|$.
stat_linReverse.explanation: Mutengo chaiwo we coefficient ye $x$ ndi ${aa}$, saka standard deviation ye $y$ ndi ${aa}$ nguva ye $x$. Saka standard deviation ye $x$ ndi ${sy}\div{aa}={ans}$.

stat_linTransform.prompt: Mean ye variable $x$ ndi ${m}$, variance ndi ${vx}$. Kana variable itsva $y$ iri $y={eq}$, variance ye $y$ ndeipi? (nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Kana $y=ax+b$, variance inova $a^2$ nguva.
Constant $b$ haishandure kupararira, saka haina simba pa variance.
stat_linTransform.explanation: Muna $y={eq}$, coefficient ye $x$ ndi ${ap}$, saka variance ndi ${vx}\times{ap}^{2}={vx}\times{a2}={ans}$ (constant nemean hazvikanganise variance).

stat_quartileIqr.prompt: Rongedza data {data} nokuenzana kubva kudiki, wobva watora median yehafu yepasi se first quartile $Q_1$ nemedian yehafu yepamusoro se third quartile $Q_3$. (Kana huwandu hwedata hwakashamisa, median pachayo haiiswi mune hafu.) Kukosha kwe interquartile range $Q_3-Q_1$ ndekupi? (nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Tanga wanyora zvakare data kubva kudiki kusvika guru.
Kamura data nemedian yose kuita hafu yepasi neyepamusoro, wobva wawana median yehafu imwe neimwe.

stat_rejectN.prompt: Tiri kuyedza dzidziso inotevera. $H_0: m={mu0}$, $H_1: m>{mu0}$. Standard deviation yepopulation ndi $\sigma={sig}$ uye sample mean inofungidzirwa kuti ndi $\bar{x}={xbar}$. Kana test statistic $Z=\dfrac{\bar{x}-{mu0}}{\sigma/\sqrt{n}}$ ichipfuura ${crit}$, null hypothesis inoramba. Kana sample mean yakafanana ikawanikwa, huwandu hudiki hwesample $n$ huchaita kuti null hypothesis iramwe ndehupi? (Nhamba yechisikigo, nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Shandura kusaenzana uku kuita mutauro we $\sqrt{n}$. $Z>{crit}$
Sikweya mativi ose kuti uwane renji ye $n$, wobva wawana nhamba yechisikigo diki inoita mamiriro. Kuenzana hakusi kuramba.
stat_rejectN.explanation: Kubva ku $Z=\dfrac{{xbar}-{mu0}}{{sig}}\sqrt{n}>{crit}$, $\sqrt{n}>{rt}$, ndiko kuti $n>{lim}$ (kukosha kuri kuratidzwa kusvika pamadecimal maviri). Nhamba yechisikigo diki inoita izvi ndi ${ans}$.

stat_sdFreq.prompt: Pane frequency table ine kukosha kwe $x$ kuri {xs}, uye frequency yekukosha kwega kwega ichiteverana ari {fs}. Funga data iyi seyose population (denominator yevariance ndiyo huwandu hwefrequency), standard deviation ndeipi? (Nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Tanga wawana huwandu hwefrequency $N$ ne mean $m=\dfrac{\sum f x}{N}$.
Variance $=\dfrac{\sum f x^2}{N}-m^2$, uye standard deviation ndiyo square root yayo yakanaka.
stat_sdFreq.explanation: $N={tot}$, mean $m={mean}$, $\dfrac{\sum f x^2}{N}={msq}$, saka variance ndi ${var}$, uye standard deviation ndi ${ans}$.

stat_stratified.prompt: Tinoda kuita stratified sampling yevadzidzi vose {ns} kubva pamakirasi matatu ane vadzidzi {n1}, {n2}, {n3} zvichiteverana. Kana tikagovera zvakaenzana nehukama hwegiredhi rega rega kuhuwandu hwevadzidzi vose, vadzidzi vanosarudzwa mugiredhi rechi{i} ndevangani? (Nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Tanga wawana huwandu hwevadzidzi vose $N$.
Huwandu hunosarudzwa mugiredhi rechi{i} ndi (huwandu hwevadzidzi vanosarudzwa vose)$\times\dfrac{{ni}}{N}$.
stat_stratified.explanation: Huwandu hwevadzidzi vose ndi ${pop}$, saka ${ns}\times\dfrac{{ni}}{{pop}}={ans}$ vadzidzi.

stat_tCiLower.prompt: Takasarudza zvinhu {cnt} zvisina chirongwa kubva papopulation ine normal distribution. Sample mean ndi $\bar{x}={xbar}$, sample standard deviation ndi $s={sd}$. Nokuti standard deviation yepopulation haizivikanwi, tinoshandisa $t$ distribution, uye patafura ye $t$ distribution ine degrees of freedom ${df}$, $P(T\le {t0})=0.975$. Kukosha kwepasi (lower limit) kwe $95\%$ confidence interval yepopulation mean $m$, $\bar{x}-t_0\dfrac{s}{\sqrt{n}}\le m\le\bar{x}+t_0\dfrac{s}{\sqrt{n}}$ ($t_0={t0}$), ndekupi? (Nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Degrees of freedom ndi $n-1$, uye standard error ndi $\dfrac{s}{\sqrt{n}}$.
Lower limit ndi $\bar{x}-t_0\times$(standard error).
stat_tCiLower.explanation: Standard error ndi $\frac{{sd}}{\sqrt{{cnt}}}={se}$, margin of error ndi ${t0}\times{se}={moe}$, saka lower limit ndi ${xbar}-{moe}={ans}$.

stat_zStat.prompt: Zvinozikanwa kuti hupenyu hwepakati hwechigadzirwa chimwe ndi maawa ${mu0}$. Takasarudza zvigadzirwa {cnt} zvakagadzirwa nenzira itsva zvisina chirongwa, tikawana hupenyu hwepakati $\bar{x}={xbar}$ maawa. Kana hupenyu huchitevera normal distribution uye standard deviation yepopulation $\sigma={sig}$ maawa isina kushanduka, kukosha kwe test statistic $Z=\dfrac{\bar{x}-{mu0}}{\sigma/\sqrt{n}}$ yenull hypothesis $H_0: m={mu0}$ ndekupi? (Nyora nhamba chete)
hints: Tanga wawana $\dfrac{\sigma}{\sqrt{n}}$.
Govanisa musiyano wesample mean ne ${mu0}$ nekukosha uku. Inogona kuva negative.
